Bekhorot 12b:18-13a:3: Gemara amar rav yosef: may tama derabbi eliezer? dichtiv: "ach pado tifde vegomer", ma bechor adam chayyayv beachrayuto, af bechor behema temea chayyayv beachrayuto.
Amar leh abbaye: i ma bechor adam muttar bahanaa, af bechor behema temea muttar! vechi tema hachi name, vehatnan: met peter chamor, rabbi eliezer omer: yikkaver. may yikkaver? lav deasur bahanaa?
La, yikkaver kivchor adam. ella, adam bechor hu devae kevura, pashut la bae kevura?
Veod tanya: mode rabbi eliezer beyisrael sheyyesh lo sefek peter chamor betoch beto — shemmafrish tale alav, vehu shello!
Ella amar rava: amar kera "ach pado tifde", lifdiyyay hikkashytiv, velo ledavar acher.
Tenan hatam: haarachin — bishatan, ufidyon habben — achar sheloshim yom, pidyon peter chamor — lealtar.
Ufidyon peter chamor lealtar? ureminhi: en baarachin, uvefidyon habben, uvinzirut, uvefeter chamor — pachot mishsheloshim.
Amar rav nachman: lomar sheim pedao — paduy, mikkelal divno im pedao eno paduy? vehaittemar: happode et beno betoch sheloshim yom, rav amar: beno paduy!
Lav ittemar ala, amar rava: dechulle alma "meachshav" — en beno paduy.
Rav sheshet amar: lomar sheeno over alav.
Metiv rame bar chama: mitzvato kol sheloshim yom, mikkan veelach — o podehu o orfo. may lav mitzva leshahoto kol sheloshim yom? la, mitzva lifdoto kol sheloshim yom.
I hachi, "mikkan veelach o podehu o over alav" mibbee leh! ella amar rava: la kashya, ha rabbi eliezer demakkeshoy, ha rabbanan dela makkeshi.
Berakhot 39b:3-11: Ittemar: heviu lifnehem petitin ushelemin, amar rav huna: mevarech al happetitin ufoter et hashshelemin. verabbi yochanan amar: shelema mitzva min hammuvechar. aval perusa shel chittin ushelema min hasseorin, divre hakkol mevarech al happerusa shel chittin, ufoter et hashshelema shel seorin.

Amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba ketannae: tormin batzal katan shalem, aval lo chatzi batzal gadol. rabbi yehuda omer: lo chi, ella chatzi batzal gadol. may lav beha kamippalgi, demar savar chashuv adif, umar savar shalem adif.

Hecha deikka kohen, kulle alma la peligi dechashuv adif. ki peligi delekka kohen. ditnan: kol makom sheyyesh kohen — torem min hayyafe, vechol makom sheen kohen — torem min hammitkayyem. rabbi yehuda omer: en torem ella min hayyafe.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: vire shamayim yotze yede shenehen, umannu? — mar bereh deravina, demar bereh deravina manniach perusa betoch hashshelema uvotzea.

Tane tanna kammeh derav nachman bar yitzchak: manniach happerusa betoch hashshelema uvotzea umevarech. amar leh: ma shimcha? amar leh: shalman. amar leh: shalom atta ushelema mishnatcha, shessamta shalom ben hattalmidim.
Amar rav pappa: hakkol modim befesach, shemmanniach perusa betoch shelema uvotzea. may tama? — "lechem oni" ketiv.
Amar rabbi abba uveshabbat chayyayv adam livtzoa al shete chikkarot. may tama? — "lechem mishne" ketiv.

Amar rav ashe: chazena leh lerav kahana denaket tarte uvatza chada. rabbi zera hava batza akkolla sheruta. amar leh ravina lerav ashe: veha ka mitchaze keraavtanuta. amar [leh]: kevan dechol yoma la kaaved hachi, vehaiddana ka aved — la mitchaze keraavtanuta.
Rav amme verav assi ki hava mitreme lehu rifta deeruva mevarchin aleh "hammotzi lechem min haaretz". amri: hoil veitavid beh mitzva chada, naaved beh mitzva achariti.
Gittin 36a:11-36b:7: Hillel hitkin perosbul vechulei: tenan hatam, perosbul eno meshammet. ze echad min haddevarim shehitkin hillel hazzaken; sheraa et haam shennimneu millehalvot ze et ze, veavru al ma shekkatuv battora "hishshamer lecha pen yihye davar im levavcha veliyyaal vegomer", amad vehitkin perosbul.

Veze hu gufo shel perosbul: "mosrani lachem peloni [ufeloni] dayyaynin shebbemakom peloni, shekkol chov sheyyesh li etzel peloni, sheegbennu kol zeman sheertze". vehaddayyaynim chotmim lematta, o haedim.
Umi ikka midde demiddeorayyta meshammeta sheviit, vehitkin hillel dela meshammeta?! amar abbaye: bashsheviit bizman hazze, verabbi hi –

Detanya, rabbi omer: "veze devar hashshemitta shamot" – bishte shemitot hakkatuv medabber: achat shemittat karka veachat shemittat kesafim. bizman sheatta meshammet karka – atta meshammet kesafim, bizman shei atta meshammet karka, i atta meshammet kesafim.
Vetakkinu rabbanan ditshammet, zecher lashsheviit; raa hillel shennimneu haam millehalvot ze et ze, amad vehitkin perosbul.
Umi ikka midde demiddeorayyta la meshammeta sheviit, vetakkinu rabbanan ditshammet?!

Amar abbaye: shev veal taase hu. rava amar: hefker bet din – hefker. deamar rabbi yitzchak: minnayin shehefker bet din – hefker? shenneemar: "vechol asher lo yavo lishloshet hayyamim kaatzat hassarim vehazzekenim, yochoram kol rechusho vehu yibbadel mikkehal haggola".

Rabbi eliezer amar, mehacha: "elle hannechalot asher nichalu elazar hakkohen vihoshua bin nun verashe haavot vegomer". vechi ma inyan rashim etzel avot? lomar lach: ma avot manchilin et benehem kol ma sheyyirtzu, af rashim manchilin haam kol ma sheyyirtzu.
Ibbaya lehu: ki hitkin hillel perosbul – ledareh hu detakken, o dilma ledare alma name takken?

Lemay nafka minna? levattoleh. i amrat ledareh hu detakken – mevattelinan leh; ella i amrat ledare alma name takken, ha en bet din yachol levattel divre bet din chavero, ella im ken gadol hemennu bechochma uveminyan. may?
Ta shema, deamar shemuel: la katvinan perosbul ella i beve dina desura i beve dina dinhardea. vei salka datach ledare alma name takken, bishar be dina name lichtevu!
Micah 5:12-6:1: Vehichratti fesilecha umatztzevotecha mikkirbecha velo-tishtachave od lemaase yadecha
Veasiti beaf uvechema nakam et-haggoyim asher lo shameu {p}
Shimu-na et asher-Adonai omer kum riv et-heharim vetishmana haggevaot kolecha
Micah 5:6-11: Vehaya ׀ sheerit yaakov bekerev ammim rabbim ketal meet Adonai kirvivim ale-esev asher lo-yekavve leish velo yeyachel livne adam {p}
Vehaya sheerit yaakov baggoyim bekerev ammim rabbim kearye bevahamot yaar kichfir beedre-tzon asher im-avar veramas vetaraf veen matztzil
Vehaya vayyom-hahu neum-Adonai vehichratti susecha mikkirbecha vehaavadti markevotecha
Vehichratti cheshafim miyyadecha umeonnim lo yihyu-lach
Micah 6:13-7:1: Atta tochal velo tisba veyeshchacha bekirbecha vetasseg velo taflit vaasher tefallet lacherev etten
Atta tizra velo tiktzor atta tidroch-zayit velo-tasuch shemen vetirosh velo tishte-yayin
Veyishtammer chukkot omri vechol maase vet-achav vattelchu bemoatzotam lemaan titti otcha leshamma veyoshveha lishreka vecherpat ammi tissau {p}
Allay li ki hayiti keospe-kayitz keollot batzir en-eshkol leechol bikkura ivveta nafshi
Micah 6:2-6: Shimu harim et-riv Adonai vehaetanim mosde aretz ki riv laAdonai im-ammo veim-yisrael yitvakkach
Ammi me-asiti lecha uma heleticha ane vi
Ki heeliticha meeretz mitzrayim umibbet avadim pediticha vaeshlach lefanecha et-moshe aharon umiryam
Ammi zechor-na ma-yaatz balak melech moav ume-ana oto bilam ben-beor min-hashshittim ad-haggilgal lemaan daat tzidkot Adonai
Bamma akaddem Adonai ikkaf lelohe marom haakaddemennu veolot baagalim bene shana
Micah 6:7-12: Hayirtze Adonai bealfe elim berivvot nachale-shamen haetten bechori pishi peri vitni chattat nafshi
Higgid lecha adam ma-tov uma-Adonai doresh mimmecha ki im-asot mishpat veahavat chesed vehatzenea lechet im-elohecha {s}
Kol Adonai lair yikra vetushiyya yire shemecha shimu matte umi yeadah
Od haish bet rasha otzrot resha veefat razon zeuma
Haezke bemozne resha uvechis avne mirma
Asher ashireha malu chamas veyoshveha dibberu-shaker uleshonam remiyya befihem
Mishnah Avodah Zarah 1:1-2:
Lifne edehen shel goyim shelosha yamim asur laset velatet immahen, lehasheilan velishol mehen, lehalevotan velilvot mehen, lefaran velippara mehen. rabbi yehuda omer, nifrain mehen mippene shehu metzer lo. amru lo, af al pi shemmetzer hu achshav, sameach hu leachar zeman: 
Rabbi yishmael omer, shelosha yamim lifnehem ushelosha yamim leacharehem, asur. vachachamim omrim, lifne edehen asur, leachar edehen muttar:
Mishnah Avodah Zarah 1:3-7:
Veellu edehen shel goyim, kalenda, usetarnura, ukeratesim, veyom genusya shel melachim, veyom halleda, veyom hammita, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, kol mita sheyyesh bah serefa, yesh bah avoda zara. vesheen bah serefa, en ba avoda zara. yom tiglachat zekano uvelorito, yom sheala vo min hayyam, veyom sheyyatza vo mibbet haasurim, vegoy sheasa mishte livno, eno asur ella oto hayyom veoto haish bilvad: 
Ir sheyyesh bah avoda zara, chutza lah muttar. haya chutza lah avoda zara, tochah muttar. mahu lelech lesham. bizman shehadderech meyuchedet leoto makom, asur. veim haya yachol lehallech bah lemakom acher, muttar. ir sheyyesh bah avoda zara vehayu vah chanuyyot meuttarot vesheenan meuttarot, ze haya maase bevet shean, veamru chachamim, hameuttarot asurot vesheenan meuttarot muttarot: 
Ellu devarim asurim limkor legoyim, itzterobbalin, uvenot shuach ufetotrotehen, ulevona, vetarnegol hallavan. rabbi yehuda omer, muttar limkor lo tarnegol lavan ben hattarnegolin. uvizman shehu vifne atzmo, kotea et etzbao umochro lo, lefi sheen makrivin chaser laavoda zara. ushear kol haddevarim, setaman muttar, uferushan asur. rabbi meir omer, af dekel tav vachatzav veniklivam asur limkor legoyim: 
Mekom shennahagu limkor behema dakka legoyim, mochrin. mekom shennahagu shello limkor, en mochrin. uvechol makom en mochrin lahem behema gassa, agalim useyachim, shelemim ushevurin. rabbi yehuda mattir bishvura. uven betera mattir besus: 
En mochrin lahem dubbin vaarayot vechol davar sheyyesh bo nezek larabbim. en bonin immahem basilki, gardom, veitztadya, uvima. aval bonim immahem bimosyaot uvet merchatzaot. higgiu lakkippa shemmaamidin bah avoda zara, asur livnot:
Mishnah Avodah Zarah 1:8-2:2:
Veen osin tachshitin laavoda zara, kutlaot unezamim vetabbaot. rabbi eliezer omer, besachar muttar. en mochrin lahem bimchubbar lakkarka, aval mocher hu mishsheyyikkatzetz. rabbi yehuda omer, mocher hu lo al menat lakotz. en maskirin lahem battim beeretz yisrael, veen tzarich lomar sadot. uvesureya maskirin lahem battim, aval lo sadot. uvechutz laaretz mochrin lahem battim umaskirin sadot, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer, beeretz yisrael maskirin lahem battim, aval lo sadot. uvesureya mochrin battim umaskirin sadot. uvechutza laaretz mochrin ellu vaellu: 
Af bimkom sheamru lehasekir, lo levet dira amru, mippene shehu machnis letocho avoda zara, shenneemar (Devarim 7) velo tavi toeva el betecha. uvechol makom lo yaskir lo et hammerchatz, mippene shehu nikra al shemo: 
En maamidin behema befundekaot shel goyim, mippene shechashudin al harvia. velo tityached ishsha immahen, mippene shechashudin al haarayot. velo yityached adam immahen, mippene shechashudin al shefichat damim. bat yisrael lo teyalled et hannachrit, mippene shemmeyalledet ben laavoda zara. aval nachrit meyalledet bat yisrael. bat yisrael lo tanik benah shel nachrit, aval nachrit menika venah shel yisreelit birshutah: 
Mitrappein mehen rippuy mamon, aval lo rippuy nefashot. veen mistapperin mehen bechol makom, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, birshut harabbim muttar, aval lo veno leveno:
Mishnah Eduyot 7:2-5:
Heid rabbi tzadok al tzir chagavim temeim, shehu tahor. shemmishna rishona, chagavim temeim shennichbeshu im chagavim tehorim, lo faslu tziran: 
Heid rabbi tzadok al zochalin sherabbu al hannotfim, shehem kesherim. maase haya bevirat happilya, uva maase lifne chachamim vehichshiruhu: 
Heid rabbi tzadok al zochalin shekkillechan baale egoz, shehen kesherim. maase haya veoholya, uva maase lifne lishkat haggazit, vehichshiruhu: 
Heid rabbi yehoshua verabbi yakim ish hadar al kalal shel chattat shennetano al gabbe hashsheretz, shehu tame. sherabbi eliezer metaher. heid rabbi pappeyas al mi shennazar shete nezirut, sheim gillach et harishona yom sheloshim, shemmegalleach hashsheniyya yom shishshim. veim gillach yom shishshim chaser echad, yatza, sheyyom sheloshim ole lo min hamminyan:
Mishnah Eduyot 7:6-8:1:
Heid rabbi yehoshua verabbi pappeyas al valad shel shelamim, sheyyikrav shelamim. sherabbi eliezer omer shevvelad shelamim lo yikrav shelamim. vachachamim omrim, yikrav. amar rabbi pappeyas, ani meid shehayta lanu fara zivche shelamim, vaachalnuha vappesach veachalnu veladah shelamim bechag: 
Hem heidu al aruchot shel nachtomim, shehen temeot. sherabbi eliezer metaher. hem heidu al tannur shechittecho chulyot venatan chol ben chulya lechulya, shehu tame. sherabbi eliezer metaher. hem heidu shemmeabberin et hashshana bechol adar. shehayu omrim ad happurim. hem heidu shemmeabberim et hashshana al tenay. umaase verabban gamliel shehalach littol reshut mehegmon besureya veshaha lavo, veibberu et hashshana al tenay lichsheyyirtze rabban gamliel, ucheshebba amar rotze ani, venimtzet hashshana meubbaret: 
Heid menachem ben signay al musaf hayyora shel sholke zetim shehu tame, veshel tzabbaim shehu tahor. shehayu omrim chilluf haddevarim: 
Heid rabbi nechuneya ven gudgeda al hachereshet shehissiah aviha, shehi yotza veget. veal ketanna vat yisrael shennisset lechohen, shehi ochelet batteruma, veim meta, balah yorshah. veal hammarish haggazul shebbenao vabbira, sheyyitten et damav. veal hachattat haggezula shello noda larabbim, shehi mechapperet, mippene tikkun hammizbeach: 
Heid rabbi yehoshua ben betera al dam nevelot shehu tahor. heid rabbi shimon ben betera al efer chattat shennaga tame vemiktzato, shettimme et kullo. hosif rabbi akiva, al hassolet veal hakketoret vehallevona vehaggechalim shennaga tevul yom bemiktzatam, sheppasal et kullam:
Mishnah Eduyot 8:2-5:
Heid rabbi yehuda ven bava verabbi yehuda hakkohen al ketanna vat yisrael shennisset lechohen, shehi ochelet batteruma kevan shennichnesa lachuppa af al pi shello nivala. heid rabbi yose hakkohen verabbi zecharya ven hakkatztzav al tinoket shehurhana veashkelon, verichakuha vene mishpachtah, veedeha meidim otah shello nistera veshello nitmaa. amru lahem chachamim, im maaminim attem shehurhana, haaminu, shello nistera veshello nitmaa. veim en attem maaminim shello nistera veshello nitmea, al taaminu shehurhana: 
Heid rabbi yehoshua verabbi yehuda ven betera al almanat issa, shehi cheshera lakkehunna, shehaissa cheshera letamme uletaher, lerachek ulekarev. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, kibbalnu edutechem, aval ma naase, sheggazar rabbi yochanan ben zakkay shello lehoshiv batte dinin al kach. hakkohanim shomim lachem lerachek, aval lo lekarev: 
Heid rabbi yose ben yoezer, ish tzereda, al ayil kamtza, dachan. veal mashke vet mitbechayya, deinnun dachyan. udeyikrav bemita, mistaav. vekaru leh, yose sharya: 
Heid rabbi akiva mishshum nechemya, ish bet deli, shemmassiim haishsha al pi ed echad. heid rabbi yehoshua al atzamot shennimtzeu vedir haetzim, amru chachamim, melakket etzem etzem vehakkol tahor:
Mishnah Eduyot 8:6-7:
Amar rabbi eliezer, shamati, keshehayu vonim bahechol, osim kelaim lahechol ukelaim laazarot, ella shebbahechol bonim mibbachutz, uvaazara bonim mibbifnim. amar rabbi yehoshua, shamati, shemmakrivin af al pi sheen bayit, veochlim kadshe kadashim af al pi sheen kelaim, kadashim kallim umaaser sheni, af al pi sheen choma, shekkedushsha rishona kiddesha lishatah vekiddesha leatid lavo: 
Amar rabbi yehoshua, mekubbal ani merabban yochanan ben zakkay, sheshshama merabbo verabbo merabbo, halacha lemoshe missinay, sheen eliyyahu va letamme uletaher, lerachek ulekarev, ella lerachek hamekoravin bizroa ulekarev hameruchakin bizroa. mishpachat bet tzerifa hayta veever hayyarden verichakah ben tziyyon bizroa, veod acheret hayta sham vekervah ben tziyyon bizroa. kegon ellu, eliyyahu va letamme uletaher, lerachek ulekarev. rabbi yehuda omer, lekarev, aval lo lerachek. rabbi shimon omer, lehashevot hammachaloket. vachachamim omrim, lo lerachek velo lekarev, ella laasot shalom baolam, shenneemar (Malachi 3) hinne anochi sholeach lachem et eliyya hannavi vegomer veheshiv lev avot al banim velev banim al avotam:
Mishnah Shekalim 5:6-6:3: Shete leshachot hayu bammikdash, achat lishkat chashaim, veachat lishkat hakkelim, lishkat chashaim yire chet notnim letocha bachashay, vaaniyyim bene tovim mitparnesim mitochah bachashay. lishkat hakkelim, kol mi shehu mitnaddev keli, zorko letochah. veachat lishloshim yom, gizbarin potchin otah. vechol keli shemmotzin bo tzorech levedek habbayit, mannichin oto. vehashshear nimkarin bidmehen venoflin lelishkat bedek habbayit:

Shelosha asar shofarot, shelosha asar shulchanot, shelosh esre hishtachavayot, hayu bamikdash. shel bet rabban gamliel veshel bet rabbi chananya segan hakkohanim hayu mishtachavin arba esre. vehechan hayta yetera, keneged dir haetzim, shekken masoret beyadam meavotehem sheshsham haaron nignaz:
Maase bechohen echad shehaya mitassek, veraa haritzpa shehi meshunna mechaveroteha. ba veamar lachavero. lo hispik ligmor et haddavar ad sheyyatzta nishmato, veyadu veyichud sheshsham haaron nignaz:

Vehechan hayu mishtachavim, arba batztzafon, vearba baddarom, shalosh bammizrach, ushetayim bammaarav, keneged shelosha asar shearim. shearim deromiyyim semuchin lammaarav, shaar haelyon, shaar haddelek, shaar habbechorot, shaar hammayim. velamma nikra shemo shaar hammayim, shebbo machnisin tzelochit shel mayim shel nissuch bechag. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, bo hammayim mefakkim vaatidin lihyot yotzin mittachat miftan habbayit. leummatan batztzafon semuchin lammaarav, shaar yechanya, shaar karban, shaar nashim, shaar hashshir. velamma nikra shemo shaar yechanya, shebbo yatza yechanya begaluto. bammizrach, shaar nikanor, ushene fishpeshin hayu lo, echad bimino veechad bismolo. ushenayim bammaarav shello haya lahem shem:
Mishnah Shekalim 6:4-7:1: Shelosha asar shulchanot hayu bammikdash, shemone shel shayish bevet hammitbechayim, shealehen medichin et hakkeravayim. ushenayim bemaarav hakkevesh, echad shel shayish veechad shel kesef al shel shayish hayu notnim et haevarim, al shel kesef kele sharet. ushenayim baulam mibbifnim al petach habbayit, echad shel shayish veechad shel zahav, al shel shayish notnin lechem happanim bichnisato, veal shel zahav bitziato, shemmaalin bakkodesh velo moridin. veechad shel zahav mibbifnim, shealav lechem happanim tamid:

Shelosha asar shofarot hayu bammikdash, vechatuv alehem, tiklin chadtin vetiklin attikin, kinnin vegozle ola, etzim, ulevona, zahav lakkapporet. shishsha, lindava. tiklin chadtin, shebbechol shana veshana. attikin, mi shello shakal eshtakad, shokel leshana habbaa. kinnin, hem torim. vegozle ola, hen bene yona. vechullan olot, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim, kinnin, echad chatat veechad ola. vegozle ola, kullan olot:

Haomer, hare alay etzim, lo yifchot mishshene gizrin. levona, lo yifchot mikkometz. zahav, lo yifchot middinar zahav, shishsha lindava, nedava me hayu osin bah, lokchin bah olot, habbasar lashshem, vehaorot lakkohanim. ze midrash darash yehoyada kohen gadol, (Vayikra 5) asham hu ashom asham laAdonai. (ze hakkelal), kol shehu ba mishshum chet umishshum ashma, yillakach bo olot, habbasar lashshem, vehaorot lakkohanim. nimtzeu shene ketuvim kayyamim, asham laAdonai, veasham lakkohanim, veomer, (Melachim b 12), kesef asham vechesef chataot lo yuva bet Adonai lakkohanim yihyu:

Maot shennimtzeu ben hashshekalim lindava, karov lashshekalim yippelu lashshekalim, lannedava yippelu lannedava, mechetza lemechetza yippelu lannedava. ben etzim lilvona, karov laetzim yippelu laetzim, lallevona yippelu lallevona, mechetza lemechetza yippelu lallevona. ben kinnin legozle ola, karov lakkinnin yippelu lakkinnin. legozle ola yippelu legozle ola, mechetza lemechetza yippelu legozle ola. ben chullin lemaaser sheni, karov lachullin yippelu lachullin, lemaaser sheni yippelu lemaaser sheni, mechetza lemechetza yippelu lemaaser sheni. ze hakkelal, holchim achar hakkarov (lehakel). mechetza lemechetza lehachemir:
Mishnah Shekalim 7:2-6:
Maot shennimtzeu lifne sochare behema, leolam maaser. behar habbayit, chullin. birushalayim bishat haregel, maaser. uvishar kol yemot hashshana, chullin: 
Basar shennimtza baazara, evarim, olot. vachatichot, chataot. birushalayim, zivche shelamim. ze vaze teubbar tzurato veyetze levet hasserefa. nimtza baggevulin, evarim, nevelot. chatichot, muttarot. uvishat haregel shehabbasar merubbe, af evarim muttarin: 
Behema shennimtzet mirushalayim vead migdal eder, uchemiddatah lechol ruach, zecharim, olot. nekevot, zivche shelamim. rabbi yehuda omer, harauy lifsachim, pesachim kodem laregel sheloshim yom: 
Barishona hayu memashkenin et motzeha, ad shehu mevi nesacheha. chazru lihyot mannichin otah uvorchin. hitkinu bet din sheyyehu nesacheha bain mishshel tzibbur: 
Amar rabbi shimon, shiva devarim hitkinu bet din, veze echad mehen, nachri sheshshillach olato mimmedinat hayyam veshillach immah nesachim, kerevin mishello. veim lav, kerevin mishshel tzibbur. vechen ger shemmet vehinniach zevachim, im yesh lo nesachim, kerevin mishshello. veim lav, kerevin mishshel tzibbur. utenay bet din hu al kohen gadol shemmet, shettehe minchato kereva mishshel tzibbur. rabbi yehuda omer, mishshel yorshin. ushelema hayta kereva:
Mishnah Shekalim 7:7-8:3:
Al hammelach veal haetzim sheyyihyu hakkohanim neotim bahen, veal happara shello yehu moalin beefrah, veal hakkinnin happesulot sheyyehu vaot mishshel tzibbur. rabbi yose omer, hamesappek et hakkinnin, mesappek et happesulot: 
Kol harukkin hannimtzaim birushalayim tehorin, chutz mishshel shuk haelyon, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer, bishar yemot hashshana, shebbaemtza temein veshebbatztzedadin tehorin. uvishat haregel, shebbaemtza tehorin veshebbatztzedadin temein, shemmippene shehen muatin mistallekin latztzedadin: 
Kol hakkelim hannimtzain birushalayim derech yerida levet hatevila temein. derech aliyya, tehorin, shello kederech yeridatan aliyyatan, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer, kullan tehorin, chutz min hassal vehammagrefa vehammeritztza hameyuchadin lakkevarot: 
Sakkin shennimtzet bearbaa asar, shochet bah miyyad. bishlosha asar, shone umatbil. vekofitz, ben baze uven baze shone umatbil. chal arbaa asar lihyot beshabbat, shochet bah miyyad. bachamishsha asar, shochet bah miyyad. nimtzet keshura lesakkin, hare zo kassakkin:
Mishnah Shekalim 8:4-7:
Parochet shennitmet bivlad hatuma, matbilin otah bifnim umachnisin otah miyyad. veet shennitmet beav hatuma, matbilin otah bachutz veshotchin otah bachel. veim hayta chadasha, shotchin otah al gag haitztabba, kede sheyyiru haam et melachtah shehi naa: 
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mishshum rabbi shimon ben hassegan, parochet avyah tefach, veal shivim ushetayim nimin neereget, veal kol nima venima esrim vearbaa chutin. arkah arbaim amma verachbah esrim amma, umishshemonim ushete ribbo naaset. ushetayim osin bechol shana, ushelosh meot kohanim matbilin otah: 
Besar kadshe kadashim shennitma, ben beav hatuma, ben bivlad hatuma, ben bifnim, ben bachutz, bet shammay omrim, hakkol yissaref bifnim, chutz mishshennitma beav hatuma bachutz. uvet hillel omrim, hakkol yissaref bachutz, chutz mishshennitma bivlad hatuma bifnim: 
Rabbi eliezer omer, et shennitma beav hatuma, ben bifnim ben bachutz, yissaref bachutz. veet shennitma bivlad hatuma, ben bifnim ben bachutz, yissaref bifnim. rabbi akiva omer, mekom tumato sham serefato:
Mishnah Shekalim 8:8: Evare hattamid, nittanin mechatzi kevesh ulemata bammizrach, veshel musafin nittanin mechatzi kevesh ulemata bammaarav, veshel rashe chodashim nittanin mittachat karkov hammizbeach millemata, hashshekalim vehabbikkurim en nohagin ella bifne habbayit, aval masar dagan umasar behema vehabbechorot nohagin ben bifne habbayit ben shello bifne habbayit. hammakdish shekalim uvikkurim, hare ze kodesh. rabbi shimon omer, haomer bikkurim kodesh, enan kodesh:
Mishnah Tahorot 2:7-3:3:
Rabbi eliezer omer, shelashtan shavin. haechad shebbakkodesh veshebbatteruma veshebbechullin, metamme shenayim ufosel echad bakkodesh, metamme echad ufosel echad batteruma, ufosel et hachullin. hashsheni shebbechullan, metamme echad ufosel echad bakkodesh, umetamme mashke chullin, ufosel leochale teruma. hashshelishi shebbechullan, metamme mashke kodesh ufosel leochale kodesh: 
Haochel ochel sheni, lo yaase bevet habbad. vechullin shennaasu al gav kodesh, hare ellu chechullin. rabbi elazar bar rabbi tzadok omer, hare ellu chitruma, letamme shenayim velifsol echad: 
Harotev vehaggerisim vehechalav, bizman shehen mashke tofeach, hare ellu techilla. karshu, hare ellu sheniyyim. chazru venimmochu, kabbetza mechuvvan, tahor. yoter mikkabbetza, tame, shekkevan sheyyatza tippa harishona, nitmet bechabbetza: 
Rabbi meir omer, hashshemen techilla leolam. vachachamim omrim, af haddevash. rabbi shimon shezuri omer, af hayyayin. vegush shel zetim shennafal letannur vehussak, kabbetza mechuvvan, tahor. yoter mikkabbetza, tame, shekkevan sheyyatzat tippa harishona, nitmet bechabbetza. im hayu ferudin, afillu hen sea, tahor: 
Teme met shessachat zetim vaanavim, kabbetza mechuvvan, tahor, uvilvad shello yigga bimkom hammashke. yoter mikkabbetza, tame, shekkevan sheyyatza tippa harishona, nitmet bechabbetza. im haya zav o zava, afillu garger yechidi, tame, shekkevan sheyyatza tippa harishona, nitmet bemassa. zav shechalav et haez, hechalav tame, shekkevan sheyyatza tippa harishona, nitmet bemassa:
Mishnah Tahorot 3:4-7:
Kabbetza ochalin shehinnichan bachamma venitmaatu, vechen kazzayit min hammet, vechazzayit min hannevela, vechaadasha min hashsheretz, kazzayit piggul, kazzayit notar, kazzayit chelev, hare ellu tehorim, veen chayyavin alehen mishshum piggul, notar vetame. hinnichan baggeshamim venitpechu, temein, vechayyavin alehem mishshum piggul, notar vetame: 
Kol hattumot, kishat metziatan. im temeot, temeot. veim tehorot, tehorot. im mechussot, mechussot. im megullot, megullot. machat shennimtzet melea chaludda o shevura, tehora, shekkol hattumot, kishat metziatan: 
Cheresh shote vekatan shennimtzeu vemavoy sheyyesh bo tuma, hare ellu vechezkat tohora. vechol happikkeach, bechezkat tuma. vechol sheen bo daat lehishshael, sefeko tahor: 
Tinok shennimtza vetzad bet hakkevarot vehashshoshannim beyado, veen hashshoshannim ella vimkom hattuma, tahor, sheani omer, acher likketan venatan lo. vechen chamor ben hakkevarot, kelav tehorin:
Mishnah Tahorot 3:8-4:3:
Tinok shennimtza vetzad haissa vehabbatzek beyado, rabbi meir metaher. vachachamim metammeim, shedderech hattinok letappeach. batzek sheyyesh bo nekirat tarnegolim, umashkin temein betoch habbayit, im yesh ben mashkin lakkikkarot kede sheyyenaggevu et pihem baaretz, hare ellu tehorin. uvefara uvechelev, kede sheyyelachachu et leshonam. ushear kol habbehema, kede sheyyitnaggev. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov metaher bechelev, shehu fikkeach, sheen darko lehanniach et hammazon velelech lammayim: 
Hazzorek tuma mimmakom lemakom, kikkar leven hammaftechot, mafteach leven hakkikkarot, tahor. rabbi yehuda omer, kikkar leven hammaftechot, tame. mafteach leven hakkikkarot, tahor: 
Hashsheretz befi hachulda umehallechet al gabbe chikkarot shel teruma, safek naga safek lo naga, sefeko tahor: 
Hashsheretz befi hachulda, vehannevela befi hakkelev, veavru ven hattehorim, o sheavru tehorim benehen, sefekan tahor, mippene sheen lattuma makom. hayu menakkerin bahen al haaretz veamar, halachti lammakom hallaz veeni yodea im nagati im lo nagati, sefeko tame, mippene sheyyesh lattuma makom:
Mishnah Tahorot 4:13-5:3:
Sefek karbanot, haishsha sheyyesh aleha sefek chamesh ledot usefek chamesh zivot, mevia karban echad, veochelet bazzevachim, veen hashshear aleha chova: 
Hashsheretz vehatztzefardea birshut harabbim, vechen kazzayit min hammet vechazzayit min hannevela, veetzem min hammet veetzem min hannevela, vegush meeretz tehora vegush mibbet happeras, gush meeretz tehora vegush meeretz haammim, shene shevilin, echad tame veechad tahor, halach beachad mehem veen yadua beeze mehen halach, heehil al achad mehem veen yadua al eze mehen heehil, hissit et achad mehem veen yadua eze mehem hissit, rabbi akiva metamme, vachachamim metaharim: 
Echad sheamar, nagati vaze veeni yodea im hu tame veim hu tahor, nagati veeni yodea beeze mishshenehem nagati, rabbi akiva metamme, vachachamim metaharim. rabbi yose metamme vechullan, umetaher bashshevil, shedderech bene adam lahaloch veen darkam ligga: 
Shene shevilim, echad tame veechad tahor, halach beachad mehem veasa tohorot veneechlu, hizza veshana vetaval vetahar, vehalach bashsheni veasa tohorot, hare ellu tehorot. im kayyamot harishonot, ellu vaellu teluyot. im lo tahar bentayim, harishonot teluyot vehashsheniyyot yissarefu:
Mishnah Tahorot 4:4-8:
Kazzayit min hammet befi haorev, safek heehil al haadam veal hakkelim birshut hayyachid, sefek adam, tame, sefek kelim, tahor. hamemalle vaasara delayim venimtza sheretz beachad mehen, hu tame vechullan tehorin. hameare mikkeli lichli venimtza sheretz battachton, haelyon tahor: 
Al shishsha sefekot sorfin et hatteruma. al sefek bet happeras, veal sefek afar habba meeretz haammim, al sefek bigde am haaretz, al sefek kelim hannimtzain, al sefek harukkin hannimtzain, al sefek me ragle adam shehen keneged me ragle vehema. al vadday maggaan shehu sefek tumatan, sorfin et hatteruma. rabbi yose omer, af al sefek maggaan birshut hayyachid. vachachamim omrim, birshut hayyachid, tolin. uvirshut harabbim, tahor: 
Shene rukkin, echad tame veechad tahor, tolin al maggaan veal massaan veal hessetan birshut hayyachid, veal maggaan birshut harabbim bizman shehen lachin, veal massaan ben lachin uven yeveshin. haya rok yechidi venaga bo unesao vehissito birshut harabbim, sorfin alav et hatteruma, veen tzarich lomar birshut hayyachid: 
Ellu sefekot shettiharu chachamim. sefek mayim sheuvim lammikve. sefek tuma tzafa al pene hammayim. sefek mashkin, littame, tame, uletamme, tahor. sefek yadayim, littame uletamme velittaher, tahor. sefek reshut harabbim. sefek divre sofrim. sefek hachullin. sefek sheratzim. sefek negaim. sefek nezirut. sefek bechorot. usefek karbanot: 
Sefek tuma tzafa al pene hammayim, ben bakkelim ben bakkarka. rabbi shimon omer, bakkelim, tame. uvakkarka, tahor. rabbi yehuda omer, sefek yeridato, tame. usefek aliyyato, tahor. rabbi yose omer, afillu en sham ella melo adam vetuma, tahor:
Mishnah Tahorot 4:9-12:
Sefek mashkin littame, tame. ketzad. tame sheppashat et raglo leven mashkin tehorin, safek naga safek lo naga, sefeko tame. hayta chikkar temea beyado uzerakah leven mashkin tehorin, safek naga safek lo naga, sefeko tame. uletamme, tahor. ketzad. hayta makkel beyado uveroshah mashkin temein uzerakah leven kikkarot tehorin, safek naga safek lo naga, sefeko tahor: 
Rabbi yose omer, sefek mashkin, leochalim, tame, ulechelim, tahor. ketzad. shete chaviyyot, achat temea veachat tehora, veasa issa meachat mehen, safek min hattemea asa, safek min hattehora asa, ze hu sefek mashkin leochalin tame ulechelim tahor: 
Sefek yadayim littame uletamme velittaher, tahor. sefek reshut harabbim, tahor. sefek divre sofrim, achal ochalim temeim, shata mashkim temeim, ba rosho verubbo vemayim sheuvin, o shennaflu al rosho verubbo shelosha luggin mayim sheuvim, sefeko tahor. aval davar shehu av hattuma vehu middivre sofrim, sefeko tame: 
Sefek hachullin, zo tohorat perishut. sefek sheratzim, kishat metziatan. sefek negaim, battechilla tahor, ad shello nizkak lattuma. mishshennizkak lattuma, sefeko tame. sefek nezirut, muttar. sefek bechorot, echad bechore adam veechad bechore vehema, ben temea ben tehora, shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya:
Mishnah Yoma 1:1-4:
Shivat yamim kodem yom hakkippurim mafrishin kohen gadol mibbeto lelishkat palhedrin, umatkinin lo chohen acher tachtav, shemma yeera bo fesul. rabbi yehuda omer, af ishsha acheret matkinin lo, shemma tamut ishto, shenneemar (Vayikra 16) vechipper baado uvead beto. beto, zo ishto. amru lo, im ken, en laddavar sof: 
Kol shivat hayyamim hu zorek et haddam umaktir et hakketoret umetiv et hannerot umakriv et harosh veet haregel. ushear kol hayyamim, im ratza lehakeriv, makriv, shekkohen gadol makriv chelek barosh venotel chelek barosh: 
Masru lo zekenim mizzikne vet din, vekorin lefanav beseder hayyom, veomrim lo, ishi chohen gadol, kera atta beficha, shemma shachachta o shemma lo lamadta. erev yom hakkippurim shacharit, maamidin oto beshaar mizrach, umaavirin lefanav parim veelim uchevasim, kede sheyyehe makkir veragil baavoda: 
Kol shivat hayyamim lo hayu monin mimmennu maachol umishte, erev yom hakkippurim im chashecha, lo hayu mannichim oto leechol harebe, mippene shehammaachol mevi et hashshena:
Mishneh Torah, Prayer and the Priestly B: Kol makom shehayyachid chozer umitpallel shatz chozer umitpallel im taa kemoto beet shemmitpallel bekol ram. chutz mishshacharit shel rosh chodesh sheim shachach shatz velo hizkir yaale veyavo ad shehishlim tefillato en machzirin oto mippene torach tzibbur. shehare tefillat hammusafin lefanav shehu mazkir bah rosh chodesh:

Asara yamim shemmerosh hashshana ad yom hakkippurim taa vechatam bahem bivracha shelishit hael hakkadosh chozer larosh. taa vechatam beashte esre melech ohev tzedaka umishpat chozer litchillat habberacha vechotem bah hammelech hammishpat umitpallel veholech al hasseder. veim lo nizkar ella ad shehishlim kol tefillato chozer larosh. echad yachid veechad sheliach tzibbur:

Taa velo hizkir havedala bechonen haddaat mashlim tefillato veeno tzarich lachazor. vechen mi shello hizkir al hannissim bachanukka uvefurim vaanenu bitfillat taanit eno chozer umitpallel. echad yachid veechad sheliach tzibbur. veim nizkar kodem sheyyaakor et raglav omer anenu ki atta shomea tefilla pode umatztzil bechol et tzara vetzuka <small>(Tehillim 19 15)</small> "yihyu leratzon imre fi" vegomer:

Shachach velo hitpallel mincha beerev shabbat yitpallel arvit shetayim shel shabbat. vechen beyom tov. shachach velo hitpallel mincha beshabbat o beyom tov mitpallel bemotzaehen arvit shetayim shel chol. mavdil barishona veeno mavdil bashsheniyya. veim hivdil bishtehen o lo hivdil beachat mehen yatza. aval im lo hivdil barishona vehivdil bashsheniyya chozer umitpallel tefilla shelishit mippene sheharishona lo alta lo mippene shehikdimah litfillat arvit. vechol hammitpallel shete tefillot afillu shacharit umusaf lo yitpallel zo achar zo ella yishhe ben tefilla litfilla kede shettitchonen dato alav:

Asur lo lammitpallel betzibbur sheyyakdim tefillato litfillat hatztzibbur. hannichnas levet hakkeneset umatza tzibbur shemmitpallelin belachash im yachol lehatechil veligmor ad shello yaggia sheliach tzibbur likdushsha yitpallel. veim lav yamtin ad sheyyatchil sheliach tzibbur lehitpallel bekol ram veyitpallel immo belachash milla bemilla ad sheyyaggia sheliach tzibbur likdushsha veone kedushsha im hatztzibbur umitpallel shear tefilla leatzmo. veim hitchil lehitpallel kodem sheliach tzibbur vehiggia sheliach tzibbur likdushsha lo yafsik velo yaane kedushsha immahen. vechen lo yaane amen yehe shemeh rabba mevorach vehu beemtza hattefilla veen tzarich lomar bishar habberachot:

Mi shettaa bimot haggeshamim velo amar morid haggeshem velo morid hattal chozer larosh. veim hizkir hattal eno chozer. veim taa bimot hachamma veamar morid haggeshem chozer larosh. veim lo hizkir tal en machzirin oto, sheen hattal neetzar veen tzarich bakkasha:

Mi sheshshachach sheela bevirkat hashshanim im nizkar kodem shomea tefilla shoel et haggeshamim beshomea tefilla. veim achar shebberech shomea tefilla chozer levirkat hashshanim. veim lo nizkar ad shehishlim kol tefillato chozer larosh umitpallel sheniyya:

Taa velo hizkir yaale veyavo im nizkar kodem sheyyashlim tefillato chozer laavoda umazkir. veim nizkar achar shehishlim tefillato chozer larosh. veim haya ragil lomar tachanunim achar tefillato venizkar achar shehishlim tefillato kodem sheyyaakor raglav chozer laavoda:
Bamme devarim amurim bechullo shel moed o beshacharit uvemincha shel rashe chodashim. aval arvit shel rosh chodesh im lo hizkir eno chozer:

Keshebbonin bet hakkeneset en bonin otah ella begavhah shel ir shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 1 21)</small> "berosh homiyyot tikra". umagbihin otah ad shettehe gevoha mikkol chatzrot hair shenneemar <small>(ezra 9 9)</small> "uleromem et bet elohenu". veen potchin pitche bet hakkeneset ella bammizrach shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 3 lach)</small> "vehachonim lifne hammishkan kedma". uvonin bo hechol shemmannichin bo sefer tora. uvonin hechol ze baruach shemmitpallelin kenegdo beotah hair. kede sheyyihyu penehem el mul hahechol kesheyyaamdu litfilla:

Umaamidin bima beemtza habbayit kede sheyyaale aleha hakkore battora o mi asher omer laam divre kibbushin kede sheyyishmeu kullam. ucheshemmaamidin hatteva sheyyesh bah sefer tora maamidin otah baemtza vaachore hatteva kelappe hahechol ufaneha kelappe haam:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 9:12-13:
Hamenappetz et hatztzemer o et happishtan o et hashshani vechayyotze bahen chayyav. vechamma shiuro kede litvot mimmennu chut echad arko arbaa tefachim. vehamenappetz et haggidim ad sheyyeasu ketzemer kede litvot otan hare ze toledet menappetz vechayyav: 
Hatztzovea chut shearko arbaa tefachim o davar sheefshar litvot mimmennu chut kaze chayyav. veen hatztzovea chayyav ad sheyyehe tzeva hammitkayyem. aval tzeva sheeno mitkayyem kelal kegon sheheevir sarak o shashar al gabbe barzel o nechoshet utzevao patur. shehare atta maaviro lishato veeno tzovea kelum. vechol sheen melachto mitkayyemet beshabbat patur:
Niddah 23b:7-9: Vachachamim omrim: kol sheen bo kulei. amar rav yirmeya bar abba amar rav: hakkol modim: gufo tayish ufanav adam — adam, gufo adam ufanav tayish — velo chelum.
Lo nechleku ella sheppanav adam, venivra beayin achat kivhema. sherabbi meir omer mitztzurat adam, vachachamim omrim kol tzurat adam.
(Amar lo) [amaru leh rabbanan] lerav yirmeya bar abba: veha ippecha tanya, rabbi meir omer: "kol tzurat", vachachamim omrim: "mitztzurat"! amar lehu: i tanya — tanya.
Pesachim 68b:7-69a:1: Amar rabbi eliezer uma im shechita vechulei. rabbi yehoshua letameh deamar simchat yom tov name mitzva hi.
Detanya, rabbi eliezer omer: en lo leadam beyom tov ella, o ochel veshote, o yoshev veshone. rabbi yehoshua omer: challekehu, chetzyo laachila ushetiyya, vechetzyo levet hammidrash.

Veamar rabbi yochanan: ushenehem mikra echad darshu, katuv echad omer: "atzeret laAdonai elohecha", vechatuv echad omer: "atzeret tihye lachem". rabbi eliezer savar: o kullo laAdonai, o kullo lachem. verabbi yehoshua savar: challekehu, chetzyo laAdonai vechetzyo lachem.

(112 Siman) amar rabbi elazar: hakkol modim baatzeret devaenan name lachem. may tama? yom shennittena bo tora hu. amar rabba: hakkol modim beshabbat devaenan name lachem. may tama? "vekarata lashshabbat oneg". amar rav yosef: hakkol modim befurim devaenan name lachem. may tama? "yeme mishte vesimcha" ketiv beh.

Mar bereh deravina kulla shatta hava yatev betaanita, levar meatzarta, ufureya, umaale yoma dechippure. atzeret — yom shennittena bo tora. pureya — "yeme mishte vesimcha" ketiv. maale yoma dechippure — detane chiyyay bar rav middifti: "veinnitem et nafshotechem betisha lachodesh", vechi betisha (hem) mitannin? vahalo baasiri mitannin! ella lomar lecha: kol haochel veshote betisha bo — maale alav hakkatuv keillu mitanne teshii vaasiri.
Rav yosef beyoma daatzarta amar: avdi li igla tilta. amar, i la hay yoma deka garem — kamma yosef ikka beshuka.

Rav sheshet kol telatin yomin mehaddar leh talmudeh, vetale vekae beivra dedashsha, vaamar: chaday nafshay, chaday nafshay, lach keray lach tenay. ini? vehaamar rabbi elazar: ilmale tora lo nitkayyeymu shamayim vaaretz, shenneemar: "im lo veriti yomam valayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti"! meikkara ki aved inish — addata denafsheh ka aved.

Amar rav ashe: ulemay dekaamar rabbi eliezer name yom tov reshut, it leh pircha: uma yom tov shehittir bo melacha shel reshut, lo hittir shevut sheimmah. shabbat shello hittir bah ella melacha shel mitzva — eno din shello tattir shevut sheimmah!
Verabbi eliezer, shevut demitzva adif leh.
Psalms 107:21-25: Yodu laAdonai chasdo venifleotav livne adam
Veyizbechu zivche toda visapperu maasav berinna
yorde hayyam booniyyot ose melacha bemayim rabbim
hemma rau maase Adonai venifleotav bimtzula
Psalms 3:7-4:3: Lo-ira merivvot am asher saviv shatu alay

Sanhedrin 112a:10-17: "Hacharem otah veet kol asher bah" kulei. tanu rabbanan: "hacharem otah veet kol asher bah" – perat lenichse tzaddikim shebbechutza lah. "veet kol asher bah" – lerabbot nichse tzaddikim shebbetochah. "shelalah" – velo shelal shamayim. "veet kol shelalah" – lerabbot nichse reshaim shechutza lah.

Amar rabbi shimon: mippene ma amra tora nichse tzaddikim shebbetochah yovedu? mi garam lahem sheyyaduru betochah? mamonam. lefichach mamonam aved. amar mar: "veet kol shelalah tikbotz" – lerabbot nichse reshaim shebbechutza lah. amar rav chisda: uvenikbatzim letochah.

Amar rav chisda: pikdonot shel anshe ir hanniddachat muttarin. hechi dame? i lema deir acheret veitanhu begavva – peshita demuttarin, lav shelalah hu! veella didhu veitanhu beir acheret. i denikbatzin letochah – ammay muttarin? vei en nikbatzin letochah – ha amra chada zimna!
La, leolam deir acheret demafkedi betochah. vehacha bemay askinan? kegon dekabbel aleh achrayut. mahu detema: kevan dekabbel aleh achrayut, kedideh dame? ka mashma lan.

Amar rav chisda: behema chetzyah shel ir hanniddachat vechetzyah shel ir acheret – asura. issa chetzyah shel ir hanniddachat vechetzyah shel ir acheret – mutteret. may tama? behema keman dela peliga damya, issa keman difliga damya.

Bae rav chisda: behemat ir hanniddachat mahu detithane ba shechita letaharah mide nevela? lefi cherev amar rachamana, la shena shachata mishchat, la shena katla miktal. o dilma, kevan deshachta mahneya la shechita? may? teku.
Bae rav yosef: sear nashim tzidkaniyyot mahu? amar rava: ha dirshaiyyot asur? "tikbotz vesarafta" ketiv. mi sheeno mechussar ella kevitza userefa – yatza ze shemchussar telisha ukevitza userefa.

Ella amar rava: befea nochrit, hechi dame? i dimchubbar begufa, kegufa damya. la tzericha ditle besivta. kenichse tzaddikim shebbetochah dame veavad? o dilma, kevan deayyla venafka, kilvusha dame? teku.
Zohar, Balak 15: David malka, shavvi garmeh bearbaa archin, shavvi garmeh bahade miskene. shavvi garmeh bahade chasidim. shavvi garmeh bahade avadim. shavvi garmeh bahade innun demasre garmayyhu venafshayyhu al kedushshat shemeh. shavvi garmeh bahade miskena. dichtiv ki ani veevyon ani. shavvi garmeh bahade chasidim, dichtiv shamra nafshi ki chasid ani. begin deitzterich leh levar nash, dela leshavvaa garmeh rasha. vei tema i hachi la yefaret chetoy lealmin. lav hachi. ella kad yefaret chetoy, keden ihu chasid, deate lekabbela teshuva, appik garmeh missitra bisha, dehava betinnufa dilah ad hasheta, vehashsheta itdevak bimina illaa, deihi peshuta lekabbela leh.

Vela tema, dela mekabbel leh kudesha berich hu, ad diyyefaret chetoy miyyoma dehava bealma. (sefer acher i hachi) an (o) innun deitkesun minneh, dela yachil leadbeka. ella la itzterich lefarsha, bar innun deyidkar minnayyhu. vei shavvi reuteh behu, kol acharanin itmashshechan abbatrayyhu. deha tanenan, en bodkin chore beta illain leella, vela innun tattain letatta beviur chametz. ella kevan devadik kefum chezu deenoy ma deyachil leadbeka, kolla itmeshach batar da, veitbettil bahadeh.

Vehachi garsenan bingaim, 24 rashe evarim innun dela metamin mishshum michya. vechahana la hava atrach abbatrayyhu, vehayeynu dichtiv, (Vayikra 13:12) lechol mare ene hakkohen. atar deyachil kahana lemecheze machtesha beistakkeluta chada, vela itzterich lemaacha garmeh, ulearama enoy hacha vehacha. uf hachi. la itzterich lefarta chetoy (lemive) min yoma dehava, deinnun chore beta tattain, vela innun deitkesu, dela yachil leadbeka, deinnun chore beta illain leella. (sefer acher ella) ta chaze lechol mare ene hakkohen, vechullehu itmashshechan abbatrayyhu. veal da shavvi david garmeh go chasidim.

Shavvi garmeh bahade avadim, dichtiv, (Tehillim 123:2) hinne cheene avadim el yad adonehem. uchetiv, (Tehillim 86:2) hosha avdecha atta elohay. shavvi garmeh bahade innun demasre nafshayyhu al kedushshat shemeh. dichtiv, (Tehillim 86:4) sammeach nefesh avdecha ki elecha Adonai nafshi essa. bechol hane arba, aved garmeh david malka kamme mareh.

Amar ribbi elazar, aremit yeday bitzllo lekamme malka kaddisha. deha tanenan, asur leh levar nash learma yedoy leella, bar betzallu, uvevirkan vetachanunim lemareh. dichtiv, (Bereshit 14:22) harimoti yadi el Adonai el elyon, umetargeminan, aremit yeday bitzllo, deha etzbean deyadin millin illain it behu. vehasheta ana hachi avidna. vaamena dechol man deillen arba yesadder kamme mareh, veavid garmeh biruta, betikkuna da kaddeka yaut, betikkuna da la tehadar tzeloteh berekanayya.

Bekadmita eved, lesaddera shevacha kamme mareh, ulezammera kammeh. veda betushebchan dekamme tzelota. ulevatar eved, levatar detzalle tzelota daamida, ihu avda desidder tzelota demareh. ulevatar eved, levatar detzalle kol tzeloteh, veazil leh, veal da david telat zimnin avad garmeh bitzlota da eved. dichtiv hosha avdecha atta elohay. sammeach nefesh avdecha. uchetiv (Tehillim 86:16) tena uzzecha leavdecha. ha telat zimnin, itzterich leshavvaa garmeh eved.

Levatar leshavvaa garmeh go innun demasre nafshayyhu al kedushat shemeh, vehayeynu beyichuda dishma yisrael, dechol man deshavvi hachi reuteh behay kera, itchashiv leh keillu masar nafsheh al kedushshat shemeh.

Levatar leshavvaa garmeh ani, bezimna deal vedafik dashin derome meromim, kad amar emet veyatztziv, (usemich) geula litfilla. lemehevi bitzlota daamida, tavir libba, anya umiskena. uleshavvaa reuteh, leitkallela go miskene, bitviru delibba, bimichu denafsha.

Levatar leshavvaa garmeh go chasidim, beshomea tefilla, lefarsha chetoy. dehachi itzterich yachid beshomea tefilla, begin leitdabbeka bimina, difshuta lekabbela leinnun detavin, ucheden ikre chasid, ha arba illen kedka yeot.

Man kalil lechol hane, hahu deka itzterich lechalla lon, vehay ihu eved, deachlil lechol shear. telat avdin innun bitlat duchetin, vechullehu chad. vealayyhu ketiv, hinne cheene avadim el yad adonehem vegomer. ben eved leeved innun acharanin. ben eved kadmaa, leeved tinyayna, it leh lemimsar nafsheh al yichuda dikdushat shemeh, uleshavvaa garmeh ani umiskena bitzlota daamida, uleshavvaa garmeh go chasidim beshomea tefilla. eved telitaa batar desiyyem vesider kolla.

Tenan, behahi shaata desidder bar nash kol hane siddurin arba, biru delibba, kudesha berich hu nicha kammeh, ufaris yemineh aleh, behahu eved telitaa, vekara aleh veamar leh, avdi atta, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 49:3) vayyomer li avdi atta yisrael asher becha etpaar. vadday tzelota dehay bar nash, la tehdar berekanayya lealmin. ata ribbi abba uneshakeh.

Amar ribbi elazar, ta chaze, tere eved meinnun telata, innun dechalle kol hane, deha telitaa kayyeyma lechatma beh chotama leella, leshavvaa beh yeda mimina demalka, uleishtabbecha beh. aval hane teren, kadmaa vetinyayna, innun kelala decholla. vedavid shabbach garmeh behu, dichtiv, (Tehillim 116:16) anna Adonai ki ani avdecha ani avdecha vegomer, deillen kelale dechol shear. telitaa bach kayyeyma lemifrak li, dichtiv hosha avdecha atta elohay. man dimsadder da, yedia lihavi leh dekudesha berich hu mishtebach beh, vekara aleh avdi atta yisrael asher becha etpaar. ata ribbi abba uneshakeh.

Amar ribbi abba, al da karenan, (Tehillim 19:11) hannechemadim mizzahav umippaz rav vegomer, kama metikin millin attikin desidderu kadmae, vaanan kad taamin lon, la yachlin lemechal. vadday hachi hu, veha kera ochach al telata avdin, veinnun chad, uvaatar chad. uteren kidkaamart, vechad deihu leitattera beh kudesha berich hu, dichtiv, (Vayikra 25:55) ki li vene yisrael avadim avaday hem vegomer. (Bereshit 131 amud bet) lo yimmachru mimkeret aved. begin dekudesha berich hu itzterich leitattera behay telitaa. veal da lo yimmachru lishma deaved, deha dekudesha berich hu havi.

Patach ribbi elazar veamar, (Yeshayahu 50:10) mi vachem yere Adonai vegomer. may shomea bekol avdo. hay kera ukemuha chavrayyay 8 bitzlota, vehachi hu. man deragil lemete leve kenishta letzallaa, veyoma chada la ate, kudesha berich hu shail aleh veamar, mi vachem yere Adonai shomea bekol avdo asher halach chashechim veen noga lo. may shomea bekol avdo. beman. i tema binvia, o gevar achara, man yahav nevia, o gevar achara litzlota. divgin detzalle tzeloteh shomea bekol nevia, o digvar bealma.

Ella hahu detzalle tzelotin bechol yoma, ihu shomea behahu kol, dekare leh kudesha berich hu, umishtebach beh, veamar deihu avdo vadday. shomea bekol, bemay kol. behahu deikre avdo. shevacha illaa ihu denafik aleh kol deihu avdo. vetu, dekala ishtema bechol innun rekiin, deihu avda demalka kaddisha, veda hu shomea bekol avdo.

Asher halach chashechim veen noga lo, vechi begin dela ata letzaluye halach chashechim. ella okmuha. aval ad la yitkanneshun yisrael levatte kenesiyyot letzallaa, sitra achara kayyeyma vesagir kol nehorin illain, dela yitpashshetun veyippekun al almin. utelat zimnin beyoma azle setar achara, dechar venukeba, umeshattin bealma, vehahu iddan atkan litzlota, begin dela havi tamman kitruga kelal.

Ucheden ihu iddan litzlota, begin (ki tissa 191 amud alef) deinnun azle limshatteta, beture chashuch, vehar nishpe, keden petichin kavvi nehorin illain, venafke vesharian al batte kenesiyyot, bereshehon deinnun detzallan tzelotin, umitpallegan nehorin al reshayyhu. vekudesha berich hu shail, al hahu dela ishtechach tamman, veamar chaval al pelanya, dehava ragil hacha, vehasheta dehalach chashechim veitavar mikkamme nehorin, vehalach leshatteta beturayya bealma, venafak mehahu noga nehora denahir, velet (leh) beh chulaka, en noga lo, kema deitpelig vesharya al acharanin detamman, kama tavin itavidu minneh. (en noga lo hasheta dehalach chashechim) veillu hava tamman, yivtach beshem Adonai, bichlala deeved kadmaa. veyishshaen belohav beraza deeved tinyayna.

Amar rabbi shimon, elazar beri, vadday ruach nevua sharya alach. amar ribbi abba, arya bar arya, man yekum kammayyhu, kad shaage lemitraf tarpa. kol aryayn dealma takkifin, veillen yattir mekullehu. kol aryayn dealma, kashyayn leappaka tarpa mippumayyhu, veillen nochin leappaka mippumayyhu tarpa. innun tarpe tarpa, veyahave lecholla.

Asher halach chashechim, asher halchu mibbae leh. amar ribbi elazar, (Shemot 188, 148 amud bet, 95 amud alef) begin deinnun sharyayn bechibbura, umiyyad mitparshan. halach chibbura, chashechim itparshan. sharan bechibbura, veitparshan miyyad. kegavvna da, (yechezkel 1:4) ruach seara baa, kelal dechar venukeba. baa vehi shavkat leh, miyyad mitparshshan. (leel 187 amud alef) (ad kan matzati ulefi dati chaser behetek)
Zohar, Balak 28: Tu patach veamar, (Devarim 20:19) ki tatzur el ir yamim rabbim lehillachem aleha letafsa vegomer, kama tavin innun archin ushevilin deorayyta, deha bechol milla umilla, it kamma etin, kama tavin livne nasha, kama margelan deka menaharan lechol setar, velet lach milla beorayyta, delet bah kama butzinin menaharan lechol setar. hay kera ihu kefum peshateh. veit beh kefum midrasheh. veit beh chachmeta illaa, leizdahara leman deitzterich. zakkaa chulakeh man deishtedal beorayyta tadir.

Man deishtedal bah, ma ketiv beh, (Tehillim 1:2-3) ki im betorat Adonai cheftzo uvetorato yehge yomam valayla, vehaya keetz. amay da samich leda. ella man deishtedal beorayyta yomam valayla, la lihevi keaa yevesha, ella keetz shatul al palge mayim. ma ilan it beh sharashin, veit beh kelippin, veit beh mocha, veit beh anfin, veit beh tarpin, veit beh parchin, veit beh ibba. shivat zinin illen, sallekin leshiva asar, leshivin. uf millin deorayyta it behu peshata dikra. derasha. remez, deka ramiz chachmeta. gimatriyayot. razin temirin. razin setimin illen al illen. pasul vechasher. tame vetahor. isur vehetter. mikkan ulehala, mitpashshetaan anfin lechol setar. vehaya keetz vadday, vei lav, lav ihu chacham bechachmeta.

Ta chaze, kama chavivin innun demishtaddele beorayyta kamme kudesha berich hu, deafillu bezimna dedina talya bealma, veityeyhiv reshu limchabbela lechabbela, kudesha berich hu pakid leh ilavavyyhu, al innun deka mishtaddele beorayyta. vehachi amar leh kudesha berich hu, ki tatzur el ir, begin chovehon saggiin dechattan lekammay, veitchayyeyvu bedina. yamim rabbim, may rabbim. (telata yoma, da batar da, ikre yamim rabbim, uf hacha ki tatzur al ir, yamim rabbim) telata yomin, da batar da, deishtemoda dever bemata. menalan deyamim rabbim telata yomin innun, dichtiv, (Vayikra 15:25) veishsha ki yazuv zov damah yamim rabbim. vechi yamim rabbim innun. ella telata yomin da batar da, ikre yamim rabbim. uf hachi ki tatzur el ir yamim rabbim, telata yomin da batar da, deishtemoda dever bemata. ta veafkid lach al (kol) bene beti. lo tashchit et etzah, da talmid chacham deihu bemata, deihu ilana dechayye, ilana deyahiv ivin.

Davar acher et etzah, hahu deyahiv eta lemata, leishtezava min dina, veolif lon archa deyahachun bah, veal da lo tashchit et etzah lindoach alav garzen, lenadcha aleh dina, vela leoshata aleh charba melahata, charba meshannana, hahi dekatla lishar inshe dealma. ki mimmennu tochel. vechi hahu mechabbela achil minneh, la. ella ki mimmennu tochel, hahi tinra takkifa, hahi dechol ruchin takkifin vekaddishin nafkin minnah, delet hanaa vetiuveta leruach kudesha behay alma, ella orayyta dehahu zakkaa, kivyachol ihu mefarnes lah, veyahev lah mezona behay alma, yattir mikkol karbenin dealma.

Bekarban ma ketiv. (Shir hashshirim Adonai:1) achalti yari im divshi ichlu reim. umiyyoma deitcharav be makdesha, uvatlu karbenin, let leh lekudesha berich hu, ella innun millin deorayyta, veorayyta deitchaddesha befumeh, begin kach ki mimmennu tochel, velet lah mezona behay alma, ella mimmennu, umeinnun dichvavteh. vechevan demimmennu tochel, veihu zan lah, oto lo tichrot, havi (tamir) zahir beh, dela tikrav beh.

Ki haadam etz hassade, da ikre adam deishtemoda ella vetatta. etz hassade, ilana ravreva vetakkif dehahu (Bereshit 27:27) sade asher beracho Adonai. (da) samich aleh, ilan deishtemoda lehahu sade tadir. lavo mippanecha bammatzor, milla da ahdar leresha dikra, dichtiv lo tashchit et etzah, hahu deyahiv lon eta, veatkin lemata, lavo mippanecha bammatzor, ihu yahiv lon eta, leittakna uleahadra betiyyuveta, veatkin leh mane zayynin, bukinas veshofarin. lavo mippanecha, may lavo mippanecha. lavo lekammay, uleaala mippanecha. mikkamme dechilu dilach. bammatzor, baatar deillain vetattain la yachlin leaala tamman. uman ihu. darga devaale teshuva alin tamman, uman ihu. teshuva. da ihu matzor, atar takkif, vetinnara takkifa.

Vechevan deeta da natlin, ana mechapper lechovayyhu veitkabbelan beraava lekammay. vechol da pakid kudesha berich hu, al innun demishtaddele beorayyta. begin kach zakkain innun deka mishtaddele beorayyta, innun demishtaddele beorayyta innun ilanin ravrevin behay alma.

Chamu, ma avad kudesha berich hu denata illen ilanin, zakkaa archa da, vela day ilana chada, ella telata ilanin ravrevin, perisan anfin lechol setar, avad lan kudesha berich hu. yehe raava kamme shemaya, dela yitadun lealma ilanin illen, veda mayayna, meatar da vead yoma kayymin tamman, vehahu maayyna demayya. ukeran lon bene nasha, netzivu deribbi pinchas ben yair. (ad kan) (chaser vezehu)

Patach rabbi shimon veamar, (Bereshit 33:5) vayyissa et enav vayyar et hannashim veet hayeladim vayyomer mi elle lach vayyomar hayeladim asher chanan elohim et avdecha. ta chaze, hahu rasha deesav, yahiv enoy leayyeyna al nashin, uvegineh atkin tikunoy. yaakov, shavvi shefachot bekadmita, uvenehon levatar, dechashivu yattir. lea abbatrayyhu, uvenaha levatar. levatar yosef, uvatra rachel, vehu avar lifnehem.

Kad segidu kullehon, ma ketiv. (Bereshit 33:6) vattiggashna hashshefachot henna veyaldehen vattishtachavina. ulevatar ketiv, vattiggash gam lea viladeha veyishtachavu veachar niggash yosef verachel vegomer. veha yosef levatrayyta hava, verachel lekammeh. ella bera tava, bera rechima, tzaddika dealma, yosef, kevan dechama eneh dehahu rasha mistakkal benashin, dachil al immeh, nafik meabbatrah, ufaris derooy vegufeh, vechasse alah, begin dela yitten hahu rasha enoy beimmeh. kamma itsege, shit ammin lechol setar, vechafa alah, vela yachil eneh dehahu rasha leshalletaa alah.

Kegavvna da, vayyissa bilam et enav, eno ketiv, hahu ena bisha (teren ayynin have zakif, ella beshaata) debaa leistakkela alayyhu. vayyar et yisrael shochen lishvatav. mahu shochen lishvatav. ella shivta deyosef hava tamman, veshivta devinyamin. shivta deyosef, dela shalta behu ena bisha, dichtiv, (Bereshit 49:22) ben porat yosef. man ben porat. deitsege lechassaa al immeh. ben porat ale ayin, dela shalta beh ena bisha. shivta devinyamin, dichtiv beh (Devarim 33:12) uven ketefav shachen. uchetiv (Devarim 33:12) yishkon lavetach. may lavetach. dela dachil meena bisha, vela dachil mippegain bishin.

Amar hahu rasha, ana abar shura da, dela itkeyyaym, vaana istakkal kaddeka yaut. rachel havat tamman, chamat deena dehahu rasha meshannena leavasha, ma avdat. nafkat uferishat gadfaha alayyhu, vechafat al beraha. hada hu dichtiv vayyissa vilam et enav vayyar et yisrael. kevan dechama ruach dekudesha, ena meshannena, miyyad vattehi alav ruach elohim. al man. al yisrael. defaris gadpoy, vechappa alehon. umiyyad tav hahu rasha laachora.

Bekadmita bera chafa al imeh. vehasheta imma chafat al bera. amar kudesha berich hu, behahi shaata dechafa ihu al rachel immeh, dela yishlot ena dehahu rasha alah, chayyecha, beshaata deyete ena bisha achara leistakkela al banecha veal benay, immach techappe alayyhu. at chappit al immach, immach techappe alayyhu. at chappit al immach, immach techappe alach.
Zohar, Balak 45: Vayhi vabboker vayyikkach balak et bilam vegomer. ribbi yitzchak amar, balak chakkim hava becharshin, yatir mibbilam, bar dela hava mechavvivn shaata lelatyay. mashal vechulei. begin kach vayyikkach balak et bilam vegomer. hu hava atkin leh veachid leh lecholla.

Vayyaalehu bamot baal. may vayyaalehu bamot baal. ella ashgach becharshoy, bemay sitra yitachid behu, veashkach dizminin yisrael lemebad bamot, ulemiflach labbaal. kema dichtiv, vayyelchu achare habbaal. vayyar mishsham ketze haam, chama ravreve deamma, umalka dilhon, defalchin leh, kema dichtiv (Melachim 1 18:26) veyikreu veshem habbaal, uchetiv (Melachim 1 18:21) im Adonai haelohim vegomer. kevan dechama bilam, dizminin yisrael lehay, miyyad vayyomer bilam el balak bene li vaze shiva mizbechot. (chaser ketiv)

Ribbi yose veribbi yehuda, chad amar lokovle madbechan dekadmae, akriv innun shiva madbechan. vechad amar, bechachmeta aved kolla, veashkach dechulakehon deyisrael beshiva dargin itkeshsharu. begin kach asdar shiva madbechan.

Lebar nash dehava leh rechima chad, deshavak leh avoy. uvene nasha mistafu lekatteta bahadeh, begin hahu rechima. leyomin, ata bar nash chad, uvaa leatara ketatu bahadeh. amar, ma abed, i atar beh ketata, ha hahu rechima deitkeshar bahadeh, vela yachilna, amar ma avad, shadar leh doron lehahu rechima. amar hahu rechima, vechi ma it leh lehay bar nash gabbay, yedana divgin hahu bar rechimay hu. amar, hay doron la yeul kammay, zeminu leh lechalbe veyechluneh.

Kach bilam, ata leatara ketatu behu beyisrael, vechama dela yachil begin hahu rechima illaa dilhon, (kema deat amar (Mishlei 27:10) reecha vara avicha el taazaveb.) share letakkena kammeh doron. amar kudesha berich hu, rasha uma it lach gabbay, at bae leizdavvevga bevnay, hare doronach zammin lechalbe. ta chaze, ma ketiv, vayyikkar elohim el bilam. veamar rabbi shimon, lashon keri vetumea. doronach leillen itmesar vela yeul kammay.

Ribbi abba amar, vayyikkar: kema deat amer, (Tehillim 147:17) lifne karato mi yaamod. hu hava zammin, divhahu doron, yachil behu beyisrael. ma ketiv. vayyikkar elohim. karir garmeh min da dehava chashiv. vayyikkar elohim, kema deittemar, deitar aleh missitra dimsaavuta.

Ribbi elazar amar, vayyikkar, bilam chashiv divhahu doron yeul leavasha lehu leyisrael, vekudesha berich hu akar leh mikkammeh lehahu doron. veakar leh levilam, mimma dehava chashiv. veakar (sefer acher leh mehahu darga), lehahu darga hada hu dichtiv vayyikkar. kema deat amer (Mishlei lo) yikkeruha orve nachal. amar leh, rasha, let annet keday leitkashshera bahaday ulemeal kammay. doronach lechalbe itmesar.

Amar ribbi shimon, ta chaze, hay rasha, gaala decholla hava. dela tishkach bechol parashta da, vayyomer Adonai el bilam, o vaydabber Adonai, chas veshalom. ma ketiv. vayyasem Adonai davar befi bilam vegomer, keman deshavvi chisma befum chamara, dela yiste hacha o hacha, kach vayyasem Adonai davar befi vegomer.

Amar leh kudesha berich hu, rasha, at chashiv deal yedach yehe veyitkayyem beracha bevanay, o ippecha. la tzerichin innun lach, kema deamrin latztzira vechulei. ella at shuv el balak, vechad tiftach pumach, la yehe birshutach. vela befumach talyay millula, ella vecho tedabber. hare ko, dizmina levarcha lon. ko, temallel beracha divnay, dechad tiftach pumach, hi temallel millin, leitkayyeyma al benay, dela eshbok millin lach.

Ta chaze, dechach hu, kevan deata levalak, uvalak shama kol innun millin, hava chashiv deha mippumeh devilam nafkin, amar, lakov oyvay lekachticha. amar bilam. sav illen charshin bidach, begin leakava hacha lehay ko, vei at techul leakeva (sefer acher leakera) lah behay charshin, ana akar lah meinnun millin dehi amra.

Ma ketiv, hityatztzev ko al olatecha, behay, uveillen charshin, teakkev lah, veanochi ikkare ko, kelomar, akar lah meillen millin. amar leh kudesha berich hu, rasha, ana akar lach. ma ketiv batreh. vayyikkar elohim el bilam. vehahu davar arim kala, bemilule decho. vayyomer shuv el balak vecho tedabber, ko tedabber vadday.

Ta chaze, bekadmita la ketiv hityatztzev ko al olatecha, ella hityatztzev al olatecha veelcha ulay yikkare Adonai likrati. kevan dechama decho amar innun birchan, keden amar hityatztzev ko al olatecha, veanochi ikkare ko.

Lecha ara li yaakov, kelomar, lekot. ribbi yose amar, ashde lon mehahu darga deinnun kayyme, kema deat amer (Shmuel 1 20:20) tziddah ore. amar, i techul lemishde (sefer acher lon mehahu darga) lehahu darga dilhon, ha kullehu itakaru mealma. ulecha zoama yisrael, yisrael dilella, deyishtechach rugeza kammeh, kema deat amer (tehillim 7) veel zoem bechol yom.

(Bamidbar 23:9) ki merosh tzurim vegomer. amar ribbi yitzchak, merosh tzurim, illen innun avahata. dichtiv (Yeshayahu 51:1) habbitu el tzor chutztzavtem. umiggevaot ashurenu, illen immahan, ben mehay sitra uven mehay sitra, la yachlin leitlatteyay.

Ribbi abba amar, ki merosh tzurim, man yachil lehu leyisrael, deha hu achid meresha dechol tzurim nafkin (Shemot 64), uman innun tzurim. gevuran. deha kol dinin dealma meinnun gevuran nafke, veinnun itachadan behu. umiggevaot ashurenu, illen shear mashiryayn (sefer acher kitrin) deitachadan behu. hen am levadad vegomer. kema deat amer (Devarim 32:12) Adonai badad yanchennu.

Mi mana afar yaakov vegomer, ha ukemuha. ella amar ribbi yose, teren dargin innun, yaakov veyisrael. bekadmita yaakov, ulevatar yisrael. veaf al gav decholla chad, teren dargin innun, deha darga illaa yisrael hu.

Mi mana afar yaakov vegomer. letatta, man hu afar. ribbi shimon amar, hay dichtiv beh (Yeshayahu 41:2) yitten keafar charbo vegomer. man charbo. ha yedia, dichtiv (Yeshayahu 34:6) cherev laAdonai mala dam. afar, hahu atar deitbere minneh adam harishon, dichtiv (Bereshit 2:7) vayyitzer Adonai elohim et haadam afar vegomer. umehahu afar, kamma chayyaylin, vekamma mashiryayn nafku, kamma tafsin, kama gardine nimusin, kamma girin, kamma balisteraot, kama rumechin, vesayyfin, vezayynin, ishtechachu mehahu afar. (mi mane) kema deat amer, (iyyov 25:3) hayesh mispar ligdudav.

Umispar et rova yisrael. rova yisrael hi hei, vechad milla hi. rova yisrael, kema deat amer (Shemot 23:5) rovetz tachat massao, revia hada hu dichtiv, (Shir hashshirim 3:7) mittato shellishlomo. davar acher rova, kemo reviit miyisrael letatta, rova itkere lefum kitrin mashma david, deihu ragla reviaa dechuresyay.

Davar acher mi mana afar yaakov vegomer, kol innun dachashivin afra, kema deokimna. umispar et rova yisrael, dichtiv hayesh mispar ligdudav. rova yisrael kema deokimna. davar acher mi mana afar, innun pikudin deinnun beafra, bizria, bintia, bechatzda, veha ukemuha chavrayyay. umispar et rova, kema deat amer (Vayikra 19:19) behemtecha lo tarbia. (amar rabbi abba, balak chakkim hava becharshoy kevilam. bar dela yada lechiuun shaata lelatya).

(Bamidbar 23:7) veyissa meshalo vayyomar. vaydabber la ketiv, may veyissa meshalo. ribbi chiyyay amar, hu hava zakif kala legabbe hahu memallel, veyyissa meshalo bilam. vayyomar hay ko kema dichtiv vecho tedabber, vaamira minnah hava.

Ta chaze, kevan dechama bilam divchol charashoy uvechol hahu doron, la yachil leakera hahu ko, kema deat amer veanochi ikkare ko, akar lehay ko. amar leh kudesha berich hu, rasha, annet savur leakera lah, ana akar lach mishshelshulach, ma ketiv. vayyikkar elohim el bilam, kema deittemar. levatar, kevan dechama dela yachil, hadar veamar, uverech velo ashivenna, velo ashivennu mibbae leh. ella velo ashivenna vday, lehahi dichtiv ko, veko tedabber. let ana yachil leahaddera lah.

Amar bilam, bitren dargin baena leaala behu. baena leaala behu middarga deyaakov, vela yachilna. baena leaala behu missitra achara deyisrael, vela yachilna. may taama. begin dishma da o da, la itkeshar bezinin bishin, hada hu dichtiv lo hibbit avn beyaakov vegomer.

Tana, teren dargin innun: nachash, vekesem. lokovlehon: amal, vaavn. amar bilam, ha vadday ashkachna lokovle dehane yaakov veyisrael. avn, lokovleh deyaakov, deihu katir benachash. amal, lekavleh deyisrael, deihu katir bekesem. kevan dechama dela yachil, amar, vadday lo hibbit avn beyaakov vegomer. may tama. begin daAdonai elohav immo vegomer.

Vei tema, behane la yachilna. bekesem venachash yachilna. ketiv ki lo nachash beyaakov vegomer. velo od, ella dechol chelin dilella, vechol mashiryayn kullehu, la yade vela mistakkele benimusa demalka illaa, ad deshaale lehane tere yaakov veyisrael. umay amre. ma paal el. amar ribbi elazar, kol hane millin, ko amar, vehu arim kala lokovlah, vela yada may hu, vela ishtema bar kaleh.

Hen am kelavi yakum vegomer, man amma takkifa keyisrael. beshaata deitnehir tzafra, kam umitgabbar kearya, lefulechana demarehon, bechamma shirin, bechamma tushebchan. mishtaddele beorayyta kol yoma, uvallayla lo yishkav vegomer. kad bae bar nash lemishkav al arseh, mekaddesh shema illaa, amlich leh leella vetatta. kama gardine nimusin mitkashsheran kammayyhu, beshaata defatchin pumehon al arsayyhu, bishma yisrael. uvaan rachame kamme malka kaddisha, bechamma kerae derachame.

Ribbi abba amar, hen am kelavi yakum. zeminin hay amma, lemekam al kol ammin ovde kochavim umazzalot, kearye gibbar vetakkif, veyitreme alayyhu. archayyhu dechol aryayvavta lemishkav al tarpayyhu, aval amma da la yishkav, ad yochal teref.

Davar acher hen am kelavi yakum, lekarva karbenin veillavavn kamme malkehon, al gabbe madbecha. vetana, beshaata dekurebna ittokad al gabbe madbecha, havo chaman diyyukena dechad arye revia al hahu karbena, veachil leh.

Veamar ribbi abba, uriel malacha illaa hava, vechaman leh bediyyukena dearya takifa, revia al madbecha, veachil lon lekarbenin. vechad yisrael la havo zakkain kol kach, havo chaman diyyukena dechad kalba chatzifa revia aleh, keden havo yade yisrael devayayn teshuva, ucheden tayyvan. lo yishkav vegomer, illen karbenin delelya kegon allavavn. vedam chalalim yishte, dekudesha berich hu agach kerava dilhon al sanehon.

Ribbi elazar amar, lo yishkav, mahu lo yishkav. ella bechol lelya velelya, kad bar nash ihu azil befikkude demareh, la shachiv al arseh, ad dekatil elef umea veesrim vachamesh, meinnun zayynin bishin, desharyayn immeh. ribbi abba amar, elef innun distar semala, dichtiv, (Tehillim 91:7) yippol mitztziddecha elef. kema dichtiv, (Tehillim 149:5) yalezu chasidim vechavod vegomer, (Tehillim 149:5) rommot el bigronam vegomer, laasot nekama vegomer, hada hu dichtiv lo yishkav vegomer veda hu laasot bahem mishpat vegomer.

Amar ribbi chizkiyya, lokovle telat zimnin dehu macha leatneh, veatin lah becharshoy, itbarchun yisrael telat zimnin. ribbi chiyyay amar, lokovle itbarchun yisrael telat zimnin, desallekin yisrael leitchazaa kamme malka kaddisha.

(Bamidbar 23) vayyar bilam ki tov beene Adonai vegomer, velo halach kefaam befaam likrat nechashim vegomer. may likrat nechashim. amar ribbi yose, dehane teren zimnin kadmae, hava azil bechol charashoy, uvaa lemelat leyisrael. kevan dechama reuteh dekudesha berich hu, deamar shuv el balak, deha millulach la bayayn banay. millula ochara zammin mehay ko, kema dichtiv vecho tedabber. ko tedabber, vela annet. ko tedabber, deshalta al kol shalitin charshin vekismin vezinin bishin, dela yachlin leavasha livnay. keden baa leistakkela behu, beena bisha.

Ta chaze, hay rasha kad istakkal behu beyisrael, hava mistakkal beillen teren dargin yaakov veyisrael, leavasha lon, o behay o behay becharashoy, begin kach kol birkan uvirkan yaakov veyisrael itberichu. vayyar bilam ki tov vegomer. bame chama chama di beshaata deanfe malka nehirin, zinin bishin la kayyme bekiyyumayyhu, vechol charshin vechol kismin la sallekan becharshayyhu.

Ta chaze, behane tere zemane ketiv vayyikkar. vayyekkar elohim. vayyikkar Adonai el bilam vegomer. uchetiv vecho tedabber. vehasheta kevan dechama deha la ishtechach rugeza, vecharshoy la sallekin, keden velo halach kefaam befaam vegomer. kevan deafrish veistallak garmeh mecharshoy, share (berucha achara) beitaruta achara leshabbecha leyisrael. amar ribbi yehuda, may ittearuta hacha. amar leh, (ruach elohim velo ruach Adonai ella) ittearuta derucha chada missitra dismala, hahu deitkesharu techotoy innun zinin vecharashin dileh.

Amar ribbi elazar, hachi olifna, deafillu hay zimna la sharya beh rucha dekudesha. amar leh ribbi yose, i hachi, ha ketiv vattehi alav ruach elohim, uvechol innun zimnin acharanin la ketiv behu hachi. amar leh hachi hu. ta chaze, ketiv (Mishlei 22:9) tov ayin hu yevorach, veha ukemuha al tikre yevorach. ella yevarech. uvilam hava ra ayin, dela ishtechach ra ayin bealma kevavteh, divchol atar dehava mistakkal beenoy, hava mitlatteyay. veal da amru, hay man deabar bereh beshuka, umistafe meena bisha, yecheppe sudera al resheh, begin dela yachil ena bisha leshalletaa aleh. uf hacha, kevan dechama bilam, dela yachil becharshoy vekismoy leavasha leyisrael, baa leistakkol behu beena bisha, begin divchol atar dehava mistakkal beenoy bishin, hava mitlatteyay.

Ta chaze ma reuteh dileh lakovlehon deyisrael, ketiv vayyashett el hammidbar panav, ketargumo, (veshavvi (sefer acher lekabbel egla) leegla di avdo yisrael bemadbera appohi), begin diyhe leh setar siyyua, leavasha lehu.

Hasheta chame ma ketiv, vayyissa bilam et enav vayyar et yisrael. baa leistakkela behu beena bisha. beh shaata, ilmale deakdim lon kudesha berich hu asvavta, hava meabbed lon beistakkeluta deenoy. umay asvavta yahav kudesha berich hu leyisrael behahi shaata. da hu dichtiv vattehi alav ruach elohim. vattehi alav, al yisrael kaamar. keman defarish sudera al resheh deyyannuka, begin dela yishlot behu enoy.

Keden share veamar, ma tovu ohalecha yaakov. ta chaze, kol man devae leistakkela beena bisha, la yachil, ella kad meshabbach veokir lehahu milla, devae lealteyay beena bisha. uma archeh. amar, chamu kama tava da. kama yaa da. begin deyishlot beh ena bisha. uf hacha amar, ma tovu oholecha yaakov, kama innun yaan, kama innun shappiran, kama netian shappiran deitnetaan minayyhu, damyayn leinnun netiin denata kudesha berich hu beginta deeden yaayayn. man yitten, veillen (nusach acher deillen) netian ishtechachu meinnun mishkene, divhu.

(Bamidbar 24:7) yizzal mayim middalleyav vegomer. lebar nash dahavo leh yedan shappiran, yaan lemecheze. abar chad bar nash deena bisha, istakkal beinnun yedin, nakit behu, share leshabbecha, amar, kama innun shappiran, kama innun yaan, chamu etzbean miggezera deshappiru illaa. levatar amar, man yitten yedin illen desharyayn ben avanin yakirin, uvilvushe yekar deargevavna (sefer acher babeyteay vechulei betevuta dileh) beveteh leishtammesha behu, veyehon genizin betevuta dileh.

Kach bilam, share leshabbecha, ma tovu ohalecha, chamu kamma shepiran, kamma yaan vechulei, levatar amar yizzal mayim middalleyav, la yishtekach netia shappira da, netia deorayyta, levar meinnun maskenin (dalyu, kelomar maskenin) (nusach acher mishkanin), vezaro bemayim rabbim, dela yisge vela yarbe rucha dekudesha.

Amar leh kudesha berich hu, rasha, la yachlin enayich leavasha, ha perisu dekudesha alayyhu, keden amar, el motzio mimmitzrayim vegomer, ha la yachlin kol bene alma leavasha lon, deha chela takkifa illaa achid behu, umay ihu. el motzio mimmitzrayim. velo od, ella ketoafot reem lo, dela yachil bar nash leoshit yedeh aleh, miggo rumeh. umiddeishtechach bizkifu illaa hachi, yochal goyim tzarav vegomer. velet man deyachil leavasha lon.

Vaafillu bezimna dela zakif, la yachlin, hada hu dichtiv kara shachav. la dachil, begin deishtechach gibbar kaari uchelavi, afillu kad innun bene ammaya, vechara veshachav benayyhu, kaari hu yishtekach benimuse orayyta, beorche orayyta. (veaf al pi ken) shuletanuta it lehu bemarehon, deafillu kol malchayya dealma, la yakerun lehu. kearya da kad shachiv al tarfeh, la yachlin leakkama leh minneh, hada hu dichtiv kara shachav kaari vegomer.

Amar ribbi elazar, la ishtechach bealma chakkim leavasha, kevilam reshia, deha bekadmita hava ishtechach bemitzrayim, veal yedoy, keshiru mitzrae alayyhu deyisrael kishshura, dela yippekun meavdutehon lealmin. veda hu deamar, ma echul leavasha lehu, deha ana avidna dela yippekun meavidata demitzrae lealmin, aval el motzio, mimmitzrayim ulokovlehon (nusach acher ulekovleh) la yachlin chakkimin vacharashin dealma.
Zohar, Vayakhel 13: Ta chaze, kevan deal shabbeta, veittammar hahu maddura, kol eshshin deeshsha kashya ittemaru veitkafyayn, vaafillu eshsha degehinnam, vechayyayvin degehinnam, it lon nayycha. vecholla tatta veella it lehu nayycha. kad nafak shabbeta, umevarchin yisrael al nura, keden nafkin kol eshshin demittammeran, kol chad vechad leatreh. uvegin dela leitteara eshsha achara, ketiv (Shemot 35:3) lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem beyom hashshabbat, veha ukemuha, eshsha demadbecha amay.

Ella kad al shabbeta, karoza kare bechullehu rekiin, ittekanu retichin, ittekanu mashiryayn, lekadmut marechon. keden nafik chad rucha missitra dedarom, vehahu rucha itperash al kol innun chelin umashiryayn delistar yemina, veitlabbeshan beh, vehahu rucha ikre levusha dikar deshabbeta. keden patore dehay alma, mittakkenan bechad hechala. zakkaa chulakeh dehahu bar nash, desiddura defatoreh itchaze tamman kedka yaut, vekayyeyma kolla mittakkena, bela kissufa, inish kefum cheleh.

Kad al shabbeta, itzterichu innun amma kaddisha leaschaa garmayyhu (136 amud bet) mishshimusha dechol, may taama. begin divchol, rucha achara azla veshatya veshara al amma. vechad bae bar nash lenafka min hahu rucha, uleaala berucha achara kaddisha illaa, bae leaschaa garmeh, lemishre aleh hahu rucha illaa kaddisha.

Ta chaze raza illaa demilla, kol innun shit yomin, (keyama milla decholla) itachadan beraza dechad nekuda kaddisha, vechullehu yomin itachadan beh. veit yomin acharanin, dekayymin levar besitra achara. veit yomin acharanin, dekayymin lego (hakedama Adonai amud bet) meiggula kaddisha, veitachadan binkuda kaddisha.

Veyisrael kaddishin, vechol innun demitassekin bikdushsha, kol yoma deshabbeta, itachadan kol innun shit yomin, beinnun shit yomin dilgo deitachadan behahi nekuda, itachadan behay, begin lenatra lon. vechol innun shit yomin (davar acher veinnun shit yomin dilgo) deshabbeta, hahi nekuda temira ihi. kevan deal shabbeta, keden salleka hahi nekuda, veitattera veitachada leella, vechullehu temirin begavvah.

Ta chaze, it yamim veit yamim. yeme chol, kema deittemar, veillen kayyeymin levar leammin. yeme hashshabbat, deinnun yeme hashavua, kayyeymin leyisrael. vechad salleka hay nekuda, kolla itgeniz, veihi salleka, kevan deihi salleka, ikre shabbat.

Mahu shabbat. i tema begin shevita, dichtiv ki vo shavat, yaut hu. aval raza demilla, kevan desalleka hay nekuda, unehora nahir, keden mitattera ihi baavahan, kevan demitattera ihi baavahan, keden itchabberat veitachadat behu, lemehve chad, veikre kolla shabbat. shabbat: 300 bat. 300 ha ukemuha, raza ditlat avahan, demitachadan bevat yechida, veihi mitattera behu, veinnun bealma deate. vecholla ihu chad. veda ihu 300 bat, lemeheve kolla chad.

Vei tema, shabbat haggadol, veihu leella, amay ikre shabbat. ella vadday hachi hu. veraza demilla, bechol atar nekuda deihi ikkara dechol ena, ikre bat. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 17:8) shamreni keishon bat ayin, begin deihi (nekuda) ikkara dechol ena, ikre bat.

Alma deate, ihu (180 amud alef) hechala lehahi nekuda illaa, vechad ihi kayyeyma, venatla begadpaha laavahan, leitattera leella ikre kolla shabbat. vechad avahan mitatteran leella, bego nekuda illaa, ikre shabbat. nekuda tattaa (70 amud bet) kad mitattera baavahan ikre shabbat.

rashi: Ki atta. amarta Adonai machsi. vahare ze mikra katzar:
Elyon samta meonecha. et hakkadosh baruch hu samta meon mivtachacha:
targum: Ane shelomo vechen amar arum ant hu Adonai ruchatzani bimdor ilaa shaveta bet shechintach:

rashi: Vayyar balak ben tzippor et kol asher asa yisrael laemori. amar, ellu shene melachim shehayinu vetuchim alehem lo amedu bifnehem, anu al achat kamma vechamma, lefichach "vayyagar moav" (tanchuma):
ohc: Vayyar balak ben tzippor vegomer vayyagar moav vegomer. tzarich ladaat leeze inyan tala hariyya bevalak velo bevaale hammagor shehem moav. 2, lamma lo pachadu ella moav velo midyan, uma gam shehammidyanim lahem yeot happachad ki hemma avdu velo moav, umazzalayyhu yecheze et asher yikre lahem.

Venire al pi divrehem (Bamidbar Rabba 20,4) sheamru shebbalak minnesiche midyan haya, ella shemechamat pachad yisrael asauhu moav melech alehem. meatta bemaamar "vayyar balak" gilla happasuk pachad umora midyan, ki az beoto matztzav haya gadol nesicham shel midyan. vahagam shello hizkir beferush hammora, muvan hu bezichron maase yisrael laemori shehem tokef kol yoshve haaretz. vehizkir achar kach megor moav gam ken, dichtiv "vayyagar moav", umeemtzaut shene moraim asu shalom benehem, vayyomer moav lezikne vegomer. vechen amru zichronam livracha (sham) veze leshonam: vahalo hammoavim nilchamim im hammidyanim, dichtiv: "hammakke et midyan bisde moav" (Bereshit 36:35), vesina hayta benehem meolam, mashal lishne kelavim" vechulei, ad kan. hare sheshshenehem pachadu. vetaam hachenaatam shel moav shekkibbelu minnesiche midyan lemelech alehem velo lehefech, mippene shemmoav hayu tzerichin laatzatan, lefi shennitgaddel moshe benehem, keamram zichronam livracha (sham), velaze nichneu lahem vehimlichu nesicham.

Od nire behair od lamma amar leshon reiyya velo leshon shemia. vahagam sherazal amru (mechilta) veze leshonam: yesh reiyya shehi shemia, kegon "vechol haam roim et hakkolot", ad kan, halo bemakom acher (mechilta) matzinu sheddarshu shehayu roim hakkolot mammash. od lamma hutzrach lehazekir shem aviv "ben tzippor". od lamma dikdek lomar shene ribbuyim et kol. od tzarich ladaat lamma kafal lomar vayyagar moav vegomer, vayyakatz vegomer. od lamma paam keraam "haam" ufaam keraam "bene yisrael".

Achen yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (Zohar chodesh kan) ki balak mechashshef gadol haya yoter mibbilam, vehaya ose keshafav betzippor echad sheshshemo yaddua, vehu amro vayyar balak, uvamme raa? batztzippor, vehu amro ben tzippor, perush lihyoto ben tzippor raa bichshafav shel tzippor. veamar tevat ben letzad ki hatztzippor hu lo leav ulekatzin, umimmennu yada et kol asher asa yisrael laemori, velo hutzrach lemaggidim lehodia davar katan vegadol.
