Veefshar shekkavvanat hakkatuv hi shemmikkodem heyot hammaase raa batztzippor, vedikdek lomar et kol ramaz beribbuy "kol" legufe, sheraa batztzippor kol ma sheasa yisrael laemori, veribbuy "et" remez liriyya acheret immah [umma] sheatida lihyot kayyotze baddavar, haemori sheatidin yisrael lechallotam, uma umma hi sheakru yisrael az hi midyan, veze ramaz betevat et, ha lamadta sheraa ma sheasu laemori uma sheyyaasu lemidyan. veefshar sheraa gam ken ki moav muvtachim mitztzarat yisrael kemo shekken haya, ki hakkishshuf yaggid heatid im ra im tov. umeatta tala hariyya bevalak ki hu haroe batztzippor levad, ureiyya zo lo raa otah ella balak bichshafav. vechavvanat hassippur bedavar ze hu lehakedim hassibbot shessibbevu maase keriat bilam vehannimshach mimmennu baavonot leyisrael, sheriyyat balak hayta sibba achat lannisbav kaasher avaer. veamar od vayyagar moav enah hodaat hannimshach mishshemiat balak ella hodaat sibba acheret lammeora hannimshach shennichnas belev moav magor.

Vedikdek lomar mippene haam, perush, letzad heyotam rabbim vetakkifim, keamro "ki rav hu". vehosif lomar vayyakatz vegomer, nitkavven lomar shehagam shennichnas belibbam hammagor, im kol ze hayu motzim terufa laddavar bederech teva, sheyyiskeru ammim rabbim vachazakim kenegdam, ella tzaratam tzara letzad heyotam bene yisrael, sheen nitzchonam kefi hatteva ella benes vafele, vehu amro vayyakutzu mippene bene yisrael, perush, heyotam bene yisrael. uveemtzaut kol ze hishlimu moav im midyan umalach balak alehem, veshalchu achar bilam, vehayu totzotav chatzar mavet.

Uveheader achat mikkol hassibbot hannizkarot lo hayu sholchim achar bilam velo haya davar, sheim lo haya reiyyat balak bannistarot lo haya massig ladaat et asher tikrena oto veet ammo bemidyan, velo haya mitratztze lehashelim im moav lehitchabber immahem lavo keneged yisrael. vahagam shehaya sholeach achar bilam vehu bimkomo bemidyan, lo haya nisbav davar behafekarat hannashim shehifkiru hammoavim, ki midyan lo hayu muvtachim bitziatam leyisrael ki im hammoavim, lefi sheamar lahem binvuato ki lo yareu velo yashchitu lahem ella beacharit hayyamim, dichtiv (Bamidbar 24:14) "et asher yaase haam hazze leammecha beacharit hayyamim", umizze huvtechu lishloach benotehem lemachane haivrim ulehitgar immahem (sanhedrin kav.), ki shelemim hem immahem, ma sheen ken midyan shello matzinu shehifkiru mehem ella midyanit achat, sheamru zichronam livracha (midrash Rabba kan) shehi bitto shel balak, ki hu ze hannikra "tzur". gam im lo haya moraam shel moav mehaam gam shekkatzu mippene bene yisrael kemo shepperashnu taam hakkefel vechulei, lo hayu mashlimin im midyan ulehamlich alehem nesicham. laze hikdim Adonai hassibba veamar vayyar balak vegomer vayyagar vegomer vayyakatz vegomer, veze haya sibbat vayyomer moav vegomer vayyishlach malachim vegomer vehaya ma shehaya.

rashi: Vekabboto li. en ze leshon tzivvuy kemo vekovno, ella leshon atid — ulay yishar beenav vetikkavennu li misham, mldyrsh belaaz:
ohc: Lecha na ekkachacha. amar na perush, atta shekkevar haya ma shehaya uma sheyyesh lo levarech kevar bercham. vetaam sheadayin haya metzappe ledavar, sheraa shete peamim she chafetz bivracha leyisrael, nire ki chashav sheefshar shehappinna sheamad bilam paam achat ushetayim hayu anashim tzaddikim, ma sheen ken atta shemmesim panav keneged kol haam, min hassetam yihyu bahem kat achat bilti haguna, vechashav ulay yimtza makom lakov mishsham. vehu amro ulay yishar vegomer. veamar vekabboto li velo amar "lekabboto", nitkavven baze sheen tzorech sheyyishar beene Adonai lekabboto, ella sheyyishar beene Adonai shello lemanacha veaz tikkovennu mishsham.

rashi: Vaani. hayiti vaar velo hayiti yodea ma hi hammidda, vechivhema hayiti immach:
targum: Vaana shatya la eda hech beire itchashvet gabbach:

rashi: Petora. keshulchani ze shehakkol meritzin lo maot, kach kol hammelachim meritzin lo iggerotehem, ulefi feshuto shel mikra kach shem hammakom (sham):

Eretz bene ammo. shel balak, misham haya, veze haya mitnabbe veomer lo, atid atta limloch; veim tomar mippene ma hishra hakkabbah shechinato al goy rasha? kede shello yihye fitchon pe laummot lomar, illav hayu lanu neviim, chazarnu lemutav, heemid lahem neviim vehem paretzu geder haolam, shebbattechilla hayu gedurim baarayot, veze natan lahem etza lehafkir atzman liznut:
Likro lo. hakkeria hayeta shello velahanaato, shehaya fosek lo mamon harbe:
Am yatza mimmitzrayim. veim tomar ma mazzikecha?
Hinne chissa et en haaretz. sichon veog shehayu shomerim otanu amedu alehem vaharagum:
Vehu yoshev mimmuli. chaser ketiv, kerovim hem lehachriteni kemo (Tehillim 118) ki amilam (tanchuma):
ohc: Vayyishlach vegomer el bilam vegomer. hutzrach lehazekir shem aviv ben beor, gam lehazekir mekomo petora asher vegomer eretz bene ammo, lehodiacha hazzerizut sheasa balak harasha bishlichut ze kede sheyyavo lide gemar techef umiyyad. laze perash lashsheluchim veamar ben beor leval yitchallef bilam bevilam, uchede shello yitakkevu lachzor acharav tziyyen lahem mekomo veamar petora, velachashash makom acher sheshshemo petora amar al hannahar, vehodiam od ki haaretz hahi hi eretz bene ammo vechullam yadu oto gam yadu derech halach bo, ki lifamim lo yimmatze haish beveto vehem yodium makom asher yimtzauhu sham.
Likro lo. nitchakkem bitchillat maamar hashshelichut lomar, ki ma sheshsholeach acharav hu lahanaat atzmo shel bilam, ki hu rotze laasot immo tova, vehakkavvana baze larutz achar hanaato belo ikkuv.

Hinne am yatza vegomer. tzarich ladaat amro hinne, gam amro yatza, vechi lo yadua hu lechol haolam sheyyatzu yisrael, uma gam levilam shehutzrach lehodio, gam amro hinne chissa shehaya lo lomar vaychas vegomer.

Veyitbaer hainyan al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 1,9) sheamru shelosha yoatzim hayu lefaro kesheamar al yisrael "hava nitchakkema lo", veechad mehem hu bilam, vehu asher yaatz alehem raa, uvichshafav heemid kishshuf leval yuchal eved livroach mimmitzrayim, vehaya muvtach ki leolam lo yetze am yisrael mimmitzrayim. velaze shalach lomar lo hinne am yatza mimmitzrayim, perush hefech hayyadua, uvittel koche hakkeshafim. veefshar ki bilam haya mavtiach et balak shello yetzu yisrael mishsham olamit, velaze amar lo "hinne yatza". veamro hinne chissa et en haaretz, nitkavven gam ken neged ma sheyyaatz alehem bemoatzotav haraim lemaan annoto lemaatam, gam laharog zechurehem uleshachet habbanim. hinne hu hefech haddevarim, shello bilvad shello nitmaet ella adrabba nitrabba ad limod, vehu amro hinne chissa et en haaretz.

Vehu yoshev mimmuli. nitkavven baze lomar shennikkar mittoch maasav shemmesim panav lemuli lehorisheni. vetimtza sheamru razal (Bamidbar Rabba 20,7) sheyyisrael hayu marim atzman mezuyyanim bichle zayin neged moav mittaam chatzifut harashum bashshem kayyadua, umizze hirgish ki kavvanatam lehara lahem. vetamo shel balak sheshshalach devarim ellu bishlichut levilam, letzad shechash sheyyomar bilam lamma li lalechet shamma veyachol ani laasot hammaasim sheyyesh beyadi laasot bammakom shehaya bo. gam chashash balak sheyyargish bilam bichshafav ladaat ki lo yareu velo yashchitu bigvul moav velo yirtze lavo, umishsham yishlach lomar lahem ki haam lo yatzuru otam velo yitgaru bam. laze hikdim bitchillat hashshelichut veamar hinne am vegomer hinne chissa vegomer lomar sheen lismoch beinyene am ze al asher yaggidu alehem hakkeshafim shehare amarta lo yetze veyatza, veetza alehem gam ken lo taamod kemo shello amda atzatcha lehameitam, shehinne chissa vegomer, velomar li shello yitgaru milchama bemoav vehinni roe shehu neged ze, shehinne hu yoshev mimmuli, laze lo tismoch al ma shettaskil bidiatcha uvo tavo.

rashi: Tancheni. nechitani:

Veachar kavod tikkacheni. illu haya taam al kavod, haya pitrono: leachar shehishlamta lesancheriv kol hakkavod sheppasakta lo, tikkachenu elecha. hifleta nissecha leyisrael vehecheravta et sancheriv. achshav shehattaam al veachare ken, ze pitrono: veachar, lechavod tikkacheni – meshachtani elecha lechavod uletiferet:
targum: Bemilketach tadberinani uvatar dishlim aykara daamarta alay leaytaa tisbinani:

rashi: Erennu. roe ani shivcho shel yaakov ugedullato, ach lo atta hi, ella leachar zeman:
Darach kochav. ketargumo, leshon "darach kashto" (Eicha 2), shehakkochav over kechetz, uvelaaz dyshtnt, kelomar yakum mazzal:
Vekam shevet. melech rode umoshel:
Umachatz paate moav. ze david shenneemar bo "hashkev otam artza vaymadded shene chavalim lehamit" vego' (Shmuel 2 8):
Vekarkar. leshon kore, kemo "ani karti" (Melachim 2 19), "makkevet bor nukkartem" (yeshayahu na), "yikkeruha oreve nachal" (Mishlei 30), pvryr belaaz:
Kol bene shet. kol haummot, shekkullam yatzeu min shet beno shel adam harishon:
ohc: Erennu velo atta vegomer. kafal haddevarim bemillot shonot, gam kafal lomar darach kochav vegomer vekam shevet vegomer, gam kafal lomar umachatz vegomer vekarkar vegomer. kol hannevua bemelech hammashiach neemra, veyitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (sanhedrin tzach.) sheamru befasuk "beittah achishenna" – zachu achishenna, lo zachu beittah, vehu rachok muflag, veze lecha haot hen anu bitchillat mea hashshishshit laelef hashshishshi, ucheneged shene kitztzim ellu dibber hakkatuv. keneged im zachu amar erennu, perush ledavar sheani atid lomar aval eno atta bazzeman hazze ella bizman acher, veyachol lihyot sheeno rachok kol kach, sheamru zichronam livracha (Devarim Rabba 2,23) im hayu yisrael chozrim bitshuva kammitztarech hayu nigalim miyyad afillu lo yaavor alehem ella yom echad baggalut, dichtiv "yaancha Adonai beyom tzara". ucheneged ketz "beittah" amar ashurennu kemo shetztzofe merachok, vehu amro velo karov ki hakketz shel beittah aroch ad limod baavonot. veamro darach vegomer perush, zot hi hannevua sheamar aleha "erennu" vegomer.

Vechefel hainyan veshinnuy hallashon, yitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (sanhedrin tzach.) sheamru sheim tihye haggeulla beemtzaut zechut yisrael yihye haddavar mufla bemaala veyitgalle haggoel yisrael min hashshamayim bemofet veot, kaamur besefer hazzohar (9 119. 17 212:), ma sheen ken keshettihye haggeulla mitztzad hakketz veen yisrael reuyim lah tihye beofen acher, vealeha neemar (Zecharya 9:9) shehaggoel yavo "ani verochev al chamor". vehu ma sheamar kan keneged geullat "achishenna", shehi beemtzaut zechut yisrael, sheramaz bemaamar "erennu velo atta", amar darach kochav, sheyyizrach haggoel min hashshamayim, gam ramaz lakkochav hayyotze beemtza hashshamayim lenes mufla, kaamur besefer hazzohar (sham). ucheneged geullat "beittah" sheramaz bemaamar "ashurennu velo karov", amar vekam shevet miyyisrael, perush sheyyakum shevet echad miyyisrael kederech hakkamim baolam derech teva, al derech amro (Daniel 4:14) "ushefal anashim yekim ala", sheyyavo ani verochev al chamor veyakum veyimloch veyaase ma shenneemar besamuch.

Vetaam sheyyied geullat "achishenna" shehi kechochav leyaakov, ugeullat "beittah" shehi ani vechulei leyisrael shehem kittot hatztzaddikim, nitkavven lomar shehammussag legeder ze shel biat haggoel kechochav hu keshettihye haggeulla mippeat geder habbenoni shebbeyisrael sheyyetivu maasehem veyavo bizchutam, vehu amro darach kochav miyyaakov, aval biato bederech "vekam shevet" ze yihye keshello yetivu maasehem kat habbenonim velo yavo ella mippeat kat hatztzaddikim shebbahem, vehu amro vekam shevet miyyisrael:

Od ramaz bemaamar darach kochav miyyaakov al mashiach ben david haramuz bakkochav kannizkar, veamro vekam shevet miyyisrael yirmoz al mashiach ben efrayim, vehakkavvana baze ki im yisrael yihyu begeder sheyyihyu nikraim yaakov, lo yair lahem ella mashiach ben david, aval mashiach ben efrayim yamut bemilchama rishona sheyyahargennu romilus, keamram zichronam livracha (socha nov.). aval im yisrael yihyu kullan tzaddikim, shebbeshem yisrael yitkannu, az afillu oto shevet shehu mashiach habba meefrayim – vekam, perush tihye lo tekuma lifne oyvav velo yahargennu romilus. vetimtza shetztziuu gedole yisrael (etz chayyim sear heemidah) lechavven bitfillatenu kesheanu omrim "lishuatcha kivvinu" vegomer levakkesh rachamim al mashiach ben efrayim shello yihye neherag bammilchama.

Veamro umachatz vegomer. yitbaer al pi divrehem (Bereshit Rabba 44,23) sheamru ki shelosha ammim asher amar Adonai leavraham levad mehashshiva shekkevar higgiu leferek hesseg yad yisrael, hem ammon umoav veedom, vehem harmuzim bemaamar keni kenizzi kadmoni, vehu amro umachatz paate moav perush, hammashiach haamur yeabbed moav velo yashir lo pea bechol zaviyyotav, velaze dikdek lomar paate.

O yirmoz sheyyakdim david veyimchatzem vimaddedem, umelech hammashiach yeabbed peotav hannisharim mehem. ucheneged ammon amar vekarkar kol bene shet, veyichasam leshet lefi shehem chasufe shet, ulefi sheshshemam yesh bo middat boshet amar "vekarkar" velo amar "umachatz":

O yechavven hakkatuv lichlalut kol haummot, shekkullan bau mishshet, umikkelalam hem ammon. vetaam shepperat moav, lefi shehem shalchu acharav veimmahem hu medabber, laze bear haddevarim hannogim lahem bifratut.

Veim tomar, vahalo en leyisrael ella eser ummot, velamma amar "kol bene shet"? hu ma sheggamar omer vehaya edom yeresha vegomer, umeatta kol bene shet shebbau lezakkotam yittaharu lanu beedom, velaze vekarkar kol bene shet velo amar "umachatz", ki lo yitabbedu kol haummot leatid lavo, vaalehem neemar bannevua (Yeshayahu 65:20) "hannaar ben mea shana" vegomer:

rashi: Ikkaf. ehye kafuf.
targum: Bama eflach kodam Adonai ishtabed lelaha dishchinte bishme meroma haeflach kodamohi bealvan beeglin bene shena:

rashi: Vaani. af al pi shehayiti roe kol ze, tamid hayiti immach. velo zazti miyyiratcha:
Achazta beyad yemini. lehachazikeni beyiratcha, keshekkarvu raglay lintot middarkecha; kemo sheamar lemala kimat natayu raglay:
targum: Vaana tedira imach ochadta veyad yemini:

rashi: Bashittim. kach shemah:
Liznot el benot moav. al yede atzat bilam, kidita vechelek (Sanhedrin 106):
ohc: Vayyeshev yisrael bashshittim vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma tzorech behodaat maamar ze, verabbotenu zichronam livracha (midrash Rabba, tanchuma) heiru baze veamru ki lehodiacha ba ki ze sibba liznut vechulei, lefi shehammakom mittivo leorer teva hattaava habbahamit. venire lefaresh shehakkatuv yaid sibbat hazzenut shehayta lefi sheyyatzu haam letayyel chutz lemachane yisrael vesham nimtzeu benot moav, vehu amro vayyeshev yisrael bashshittim, perush bemakom shehayu metayyelim bo chutz lemachanehem, veshittim hu leshon tiyyulim kederech amro (Bamidbar 11:8) "shatu haam", uferesh Rashi sham veze leshono: en shayit ella leshon tiyyul. veze sibbat "vayyachel haam liznot".

Vayyachel haam liznot el benot moav. amro vayyachel leshon chillul, shennitchallel liznot, perush lefi shezzanu achare elohe nechar. veamar el benot vegomer, perush al derech amram zichronam livracha (midrash Rabba vetanchuma sham) shehayu tovim otam laavera vehayu omrim lahem hishtachave laze vegomer, vehayu mishtachavim el asher hayu omrim lahem benot moav, vehu amro "el benot" vegomer. vedikdek hakkatuv lomar haam, lishlol hatztzaddikim asher beshem yisrael yitkannu.

rashi: El zikne midyan. vahalo meolam hayu soneim ze et ze, shenneemar "hammakke et midyan bisde moav" (Bereshit 36), shebbau midyan al moav lammilchama? ella miyyiratan shel yisrael asu shalom benehem; uma raa moav littol etza mimmidyan? kevan sherau et yisrael notzechim shello cheminhag haolam, ameru manhigam shel ellu bemidyan nitgaddel, nishal mehem ma middato, ameru lahem en kocho ella befiv, ameru, af anu navo alehem beadam shekkocho befiv (tanchuma):
Kilchoch hashor. kol ma shehashor melachech en bo veracha (sham):
Baet hahiva. lo haya rauy lemalchut, minnesiche midyan haya, vechevan shemmet sichon minnuhu alehem letzorech shaa (sham):
ohc: Yelachachu vegomer et kol sevivotenu. ulay shello ratzu lehareot kol kach morech hallevav shehem yereim mehem, ella shehem chasim al hassevivot, veamru leshon rabbim lichlol otam immahem. veamro uvalak ben tzippor hem divre hakkatuv, o efshar shehem divrehem sheamru ki davar ze nogea gam lemidyan, leheyot shebbalak ben tzippor melech lemoav baet hahi, veim ken hacherpa nogaat lemidyan letzad nesicham. vedikdek lomar baet hahi, lomar lo lefanav velo leacharav, ki achar shebba bilam vehodia lahem ki lo yareu velo yashchitu lemoav, shillechu et balak velo haya od melech alehem. veze lecha haot shennimtza et nesiche midyan veneherag immahem (Bamidbar 31:8).

rashi: Lahaloch immachem. ella im sarim gedolim mikkem, lamadnu sherucho gevoha, velo ratza legallot shehu virshuto shel makom, ella vilshon gassut, lefichach visap aod balak:
ohc: Vayyakam bilam babboker. ulay lefi shehayta besora raa lahem, lo ratza legallot lahem ballayla, lefi ma sheamarnu shehayu bimlono atzmah vehimtin ad habboker. o yirtze shello kam mittardemato ad habboker, vehu amro vayyakam bilam babboker velo kodem. o efshar sheyyedabber hakkatuv bignut bilam sheshshelacham maher kede sheyyemaher lishloach acherim nichbadim. o lehodia tzarut eno shemmiher leshalcham kodem haggaat zeman haochel, hefech minnedivut avi hannaara pilegesh baggiva (Shoftim 19) sheamar lachatano sheamad lalechet babboker: "sead libbecha pat lechem veachar telechu", ki ze harasha hu mekor hatztzarut ayin, vekam babboker leshalcham veamar lahem sheyyelchu leartzam ki chash sheyyitakkevu bair useudatam alav.

Lechu vegomer ki meen Adonai vegomer. hichchid chatzi davar velo amar lahem ella maamar rishon sheamar lo Adonai lo telech immahem letzad pechitutam, velo amar lahem maamar lo taor vegomer, shebbaze chazar balak veshalach rabbim venichbadim. veulay sheddan harasha middivre Adonai shennatan hattaam "ki varuch hu", shebba ledayyek shebbizman sheeno baruch yachol leorro, velaze lo hechlit lahem haddavar ad sheyyishlach haruyim lalechet immahem, ulay yihye zeman az shello yihye bo baruch.

rashi: Ulay notta. kemo lule, peamim sheulay meshammesh bilshon lule:
Gam otecha haragti. hare ze mikra mesoras vehu chemo gam haragti otecha, kelomar, lo haakkava bilvad keraatcha al yadi, ki gam hahariga:

Veotah hecheyeti. veatta mippene sheddibbera vehochichatcha, velo yacholetta laamod betochachtah — kemo shekkatuv viamar lo — haragtiha, shello yomru, zo hi shessilleka vilam betochachtah velo yachol lehashiv, shechas hammakom al kevod habberiyyot, vechen (Vayikra 20) "veharagta et haisha veet habbehema", vechen (sham) "et habbehema taharogu" (tanchuma):
ohc: Ki atta gam otcha vegomer. amro atta, ledivrehem zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 20,14) sheamru shenneherga haaton, velaze dikdek lomar gam otcha velo amar "gam haragti otcha", yeduyyak al nachon tevat "atta", ki lo yutzdak lomar "gam otcha" ella atta shekkevar neherga haaton, ma sheen ken kodem, ki kodem lo hayta meta haaton, keamro "veotah hecheyeti". veamro hecheyeti shemmashmauto hu poal chadash, lehaircha sheatta neherget. od lomar shehaya ose lah maase nissim, sheyyifga hammalach berochev venirkav veyaharog rochev bishmirat nirkav, uvederech ze yutzdak leamer lashon ze "hecheyeti".

rashi: Ketal meet Adonai. sheen ba laolam al yede adam velo yevakshu pene adam alav, kach lo yekavve yisrael leezrat ish ki im baAdonai:
targum: Vihe sheara devet yaakov bego ammin sagiin ketala kodam Adonai vechirsise malkosha di al isba di la morich leenasha vela machtar levar enasha:

ohc: Bene li. perush, lema sheani mechavven vechoshev betaam hammaase, sheharasha lo haya rotze legallot yediato vetachbulotav levalak, ki nichreta haemuna mehem. veasa balak kemitzvato shel bilam, dichtiv "vayyaas balak kaasher dibber bilam" (Bamidbar 23:2), perush sheamar lo laasot maase lema sheyyechavven bilam baddavar. gam nitkavven bemaamar kaasher, perush techef sheggamar haddavar velo shaha.

rashi: Pen tiggof. pen tikkashel, vechen kol leshon negifa; 387 belaaz:
targum: Al tukefehon yitlunach dilma tatkel beyitzra visha dimtil leavne riglach:

rashi: Veyeshchacha bekirbecha. hammaachol shettochal achnis bo meera betoch hammeayim veyigrom lecha choli shettehe chole veholech shachoach, vechen mefaresh oto besifre minnayin af betoch hammeayim talmud lomar veyeshchacha bekirbecha befarashat vehaya ekev bemidrash tamid ene Adonai elohecha bah. veaf yonatan tirgem ken "vihe lach lemara meta bimech".

Vetasseg. et oyvecha hammolichim banecha uvenotecha bashshevi velo tefalletem, veim tefalletem sofam lacherev. umishshemo shel rabbi menachem shamati vetasseg letaavat tashmish velo taflit, lo yihye lecha koach liflot shichvat zera veim tefalletem sofah lacherev etten etchem. veyonatan tirgem lashon harishon.
targum: At techul vela tisba vihe lach limra vimach vetadbek vela teshezev vedi teshezev lecharba emsar:

rashi: Vayyispok. hikka zo al zo:
ohc: Vayyichar af vegomer vayyispok vegomer. perush: chara appo veshikkech ragzo bisfikat kappav.
Berachta varech. perush, berachta beracha sheen bah kelala, veharaya sheamarta "mevarchecha varuch veorrecha arur", ulefi ma shekkatavti shekkavvanato lehara, lo hirgish balak bechavvana zo.

rashi: Vayyishma balak. shalach sheluchim levassero:
El ir moav. el metroppolin shello — ir hachashuva shello, lomar ree ma ellu mevakshim laakor (tanchuma):
ohc: Vayyetze likrato el ir moav. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lefaret hammakom sheyyatza likrato. venire ki ba hakkatuv lesapper pechitut bilam beene balak, shehagam sheshshama beviato lo yatza lehakebil panav kederech hakebalat pene haggedolim sheyyotzim chutz lammachoz, ella davka betoch hair, vehu amro vayyetze likrato el ir moav asher al gevul vegomer.

Veamro biktze haggevul, ulay shennitkavven gam ken lomar sheafillu yetzia zo muetet lo hayta lichvodo ella lesibba, keamram zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 20,16) veze leshonam: ma raa balak lekaddemo laggevulin? amar lo gevulin hallalu nikbeu mime noach shello tikkanes umma ligvul chavertah, vehaya mare lo ech partzu veavru gevulot sichon veog, ad kan. vezulat taam ze lo haya yotze mimmekomo:

Atta hayachol uchal dabber meuma. dikdek lomar atta, perush, achar dibbur sheni shebba elav mehammalach badderech shenneesar vechafal lo afillu dibbur, kemo shepperashti befasuk "veefes et haddavar". vechafal lomar hayachol uchal, kan gilla rishato shemmeniato hi bishne derachim: echad mikkoach haazhara, vehashsheni sheen habbechira beyad atzmo bedavar ze. ha lamadta sheim lo hayta lo ella haazhara vehaya baal bechira veratzon, haya ose.

rashi: Hen am kelavi yakum vegomer'. keshehen omedin mishenatam shacharit, hen mitgabberin kelavi vechaari lachatof et hammitzvot — lilbosh tallit, likro et shema ulehaniach tefillin:

Lo yishkav. ballayla al mittato ad shehu ochel umechabbel kol mazzik habba letorfo, ketzad? kore et shema al mittato umafkid rucho beyad hammakom, ba machane vegayis lehazzikam, hakkabbah shomeram venilcham milchamotam umappilam chalalim (sham); daa — han am kalabia yakom vegomer', ketargumo:

Vedam chalalim yishte. nitnabbe sheen moshe met ad sheyyappil malche midyan chalalim veyehareg hu immahem, shenneemar (Yehoshua 13) "veet bilam ben beor hakkosem haregu vene yisrael bacherev el chalelehem" (80' Tanchuma):
ohc: Hen am vegomer. amro hen, al derech amram zichronam livracha (shabbat kayit:) malach ra one amen beal karcho, shebbilam atzmo amar hen, ken yihye am ze kelavi yakum vechaari vegomer. veamro kelavi perush, kimato rishona eno kishar haolam shebbitchilla lihyoto chaser hitlammedut hammilchama lo yaase gevurot ella kelavi yakum veyaase niflaot, kemo shekken haya, shehagam shemmeodo hu shavuy bevet habbor meunne besevel enosh, af al pi chen ketzeto et hair hifli asot besichon veog. amar od vechaari yitnassa perush al derech amram zichronam livracha (shabbat oz:) shelosha kol zeman shemmazkinin mosifin koach: ari vechulei, vehu amro yitnassa shehu mitnasse veram bechocho shehagam sheyyaavru alav kamma milchamot lo mippene ze yihyu nechlashim ella holchim umitgabberim.

Od yirtze, shemmillevad koach asher asa Adonai bahem, od yihye beene kol haummot bemadrega gedola lefached mehem, keamro (Yehoshua 2,24) "vegam namogu" vegomer, vehu amro kelavi yakum ze beerech gevurato, uveerech ma sheyyihye nechshav beene haolam vechaari yitnassa, perush, yoter mimma shehu yihyu menussaim beene haolam.

Lo yishkav ad vegomer. perush, sheen hallayla miflat lanus mippanav, ki layla lefanav kayyom yair. vetze ulemad mihoshua (Yehoshua 10:12-13) sheamar lashshemesh shettaamod velo atz lavo vechaddome. vehu amro lo yishkav ad yochal teref, ha lamadta shebbizman shechiva mitassek hu baachilat teref.

Veamro vedam chalalim yishte, lefi shebbeteva enoshi kesheyyarbe lehappil chalalim tikar beenav nefesh hannisharim, laze amar oy lahem laummot, ki am elle haddam beenav kemashke asher yishte, veeno nechshav beenehem haddam begeder hariga ella begeder shetiyya.

Vedikdek lomar yishte, lefi ma shehikdamnu ki al yede harigat haummot nidbakim chelke hakkedushsha beam Adonai, besod "ki lachmenu hem" (Bamidbar 14:9), kemo chen amar kan "yishte", vehaven. verazal (chullin la:) lamdu mikkan ledam shechashuv mashke.

rashi: Ma ekkov lo kabbo el. keshehayu reuyim lehitkallel lo nitkallelu — keshehizkir avihem et avonam "ki veappam haregu ish", lo killel ella appam, shenneemar "arur appam" (Bereshit 49); keshennichnas avihem bemirma etzel aviv haya rauy lehitkallel, ma neemar sham? "gam baruch yihye" (Sham 27), bamvarechim neemar "elle yaamdu levarech et haam", bamkallelim lo neemar veelle yaamdu lekallel et haam ella "veelle yaamdu al hakkelala" (Devarim 27) — lo ratza lehazkir alehem shem kelala (tanchuma):

Lo zaam Adonai. ani en kochi ella sheani yodea lechavven hashaa shehakkabbah choes bah, vehu lo chaas kol hayyamim hallalu shebbati elecha, vezehu shenneemar (Micha 6) "ammi zechar na ma yaatz" vego' "ume ana oto bilam" vego' "lemaan daat tzidkot Adonai" (sanhedrin kh):
ohc: Ma ekkov lo kabbo vegomer ki merosh vegomer. kashe, im Adonai killelo laze ma makom lekallelo bilam, gam im zaam bo Adonai ma tzorech bizimat bilam? halo lo kara lo balak ella lekallel lemi sheeno mekullal vegomer. od tzarich ladaat ma netinat taam bemaamar ki merosh tzurim vegomer lemaamar ma ekkov vegomer.

Velaamod al kavvanat haddevarim yesh lehair beikkar haddavar shel haish hammekullal, mimma nafshach: im hu chayyav kefi haddin raa habbaa alav beemtzaut hakkelala, al kol panim lo yinnatzel mimmenna gam ki lo yekullal, veim hu kefi mishpat elohim lo asa davar sheyyitchayyev alav biat hara, killato tashuv al rosh hammekallel. bishlama habberacha, lefi shemmidda tova merubba, gam laasot Adonai retzon yedidav levarech hammitbarchim mehem bemiddat hachesed tekubbal birchato gam lemi sheeno rauy lah kemo maasav, ma sheen ken midda raa – ki lo yarea Adonai leadam chinnam chas veshalom.

Achen ikkar haddavar hu lefi shemmiddato yitbarach lehaarich appo leovre retzono, ben letzaddik kesheyyecheta ben lerasha hagam sheyyirtze lachato, umidda zo hi achat mishshelosh esre middot rachamim shenneemru lemoshe venoheget tamid, zulat beet asher yizom Adonai, dichtiv "ki rega beappo" (Tehillim 30:6), az mitgabberim haddinim al hannitba bammishpat beoto zeman velo titnaheg midda zo shel erech appayim. uchemo chen kesheyyekallel adam et chavero tesovev hakkelala sheavonotav asher Adonai maarich lo appo alehem yemaher lippara mimmennu. aval im en lo avon lo toil killat hammekallel kelum.

Od askilcha ki chol ose resha yafil pegam bemidda elyona beanaf hahu shetteluya otah mitzva sheavar aleha, velo bechol hammidda hu pogem ella beshoresh nishmato. vehappegam hu shettihye achiza lachelek hammeruchak laamod sham velehanot mimmekor hachayyim, vechelek ze hammeruchak nautz sofo betoch hachote verosho yonek mimmakom shoresh hannefesh hachotet. veze yihye kol od shello shav haadam bitshuva o lo nifra al cheto. veze hu sod "nose avon" sheamru razal she mefarnes hakkategor hannivra mechet haadam, vechi hu ze hannifra mehaadam atzmo (Zohar chelek 3 83:) keamro (Yirmeyahu 2:19) "teyasserech raatech", uchetiv (Yeshayahu 64:6) "vattemugenu beyad" vegomer, vehaish hammekallel yeorer haddin bechoach hakkelala beet hazzaam lemaher lehashelit hashshallit beadam lera lo.

Od yesh ladaat ki chelek haarur yikkare beshem ze kelala uzeima, vechen keraam hakkatuv dichtiv (Devarim 28:20) "yeshallach Adonai vegomer et hammeera vegomer veet hammigeret", vehem shemot kittot hammechabbelim. kelala hu keneged averot chamurot, vezaam keneged averot kallot. velaze keshehaya bilam rotze lekallel umma haya bocher et hazzaam, uletzad heyotam kullam zeumim bishvil maasehem haraim, hayu devarav moilim lahem. vechashav balak ki am bene yisrael lo yechdal mehem avon, ucheshafav yaggidu lo ki lo nimletu mittachalue hannefesh shehu anaf hammeruchak kemo sheamarnu, laze amar bilam ma ekkov vegomer, perush ki bechol anfe hakkedushsha shebbah neechazim am bene yisrael, en bo bashshoresh haelyon shum shelita mechelek hammeruchak shebbeemtzauto yeorer haddin alehem.

Vehinne shete middot elyonot sheyyisrael mityachasim alehem, shem el veshem 26 baruch hu. shem el – shekken nikra yaakov "yisrael", perush: yashar el, lishlol el hashshoresh makom shehu bechinat hara vehu chelek hammeruchak, veshem 26 dichtiv (Devarim 32:9) "ki chelek Adonai ammo", vehem shete hadderagot hakkedosha shehissigu yisrael. velaze amar ma ekkov lo kabbo el, ki shoresh nishmatam shebbivchina zo en bo roshem mizze chelek hara kemo sheamarnu lemala. gam beerech makom elyon shehem sharshe nishmot hatztzaddikim shebbivchinat shem 26 lo zaam Adonai, perush afillu dikdukim she medakdek im hatztzaddikim lo nimtza sham. umeatta ma yoilu killotav uzeamav? vetomar sheyyechappes beshoresh hakkodem lahem uvaanafim hassovvim, laze bittel taana zo mittaam shebbikkesh velo matza, vehu amro ki merosh tzurim erennu vegomer, perush tzurim hem haavot kayyadua, vehu hibbit veraa rosh hatztzurim shehem terach vaavotav velo raa makom shemmimmennu yeorer haddinim alehem.

Veshiur hakkatuv hu al ze hadderech, ki taam sheani omer lo zaam velo kabbo, lo shebbikkashti bechelek mehem levad, lo chen hu, ella ani roe rosh tzurim, gam chippes achar shoresh haimmahot, vehu amro "umiggevaot ashurennu", uvechol ze lo matza makom sheyyikkanes derech sham. veleheyot sheyyesh lehakeshot baddavar, ech yittachen shello matza nega barishonim terach vaavotav gam betuel velavan, laze amar hen am levadad yishkon uvaggoyim lo yitchashshav, perush levadad, sheen sharsho mishshoresh terach vaavotav umimmin anaf hahu, ella levadad min machtzav nishmot yisrael, en lo shum kureva mehammolidim. veamro uvaggoyim lo yitchashshav, perush sheafillu im otam shennikraim goyim, shehem achehem mammash, vehem yishmael veesav sheshshenehem nikraim goyim, yishmael dichtiv (Bereshit 17:20) "unetattiv legoy gadol", veesav dichtiv (Bereshit 25:23) "shene goyim" – lo yitchashshav. vechen amar Adonai leavraham (Bereshit 21:12) ki veyitzchak yikkare lecha zara, lemaet yishmael veesav sheenam nechshavim zaro. meatta en makom lekallel leyisrael lo latztzaddikim velo labbenonim. vahagam shehayu beyad yisrael avonot avon haegel vehameraggelim vechaddome, kevar amar Adonai alehem leshon selicha. veulay ki letaam ze lo haya Adonai mitkaes kol otam hayyamim shehaya bilam rotze lekallel chas veshalom.

Od yechavven beamro hen am vegomer, matmiah al balak sherotze lekallel yisrael, veamar: "hen am" – ze hu haomed achar kelot kol haummot, yaamod badad yishkon, vechol haummot en mivtach lahem afillu shanim rabbot, veech rotze laakor umma hammitkayyemet ad sof haolam. veamro uvaggoyim lo yitchashshav, perush, lo ba legeder cheshbon maalatam kesheyyihyu levadad, ki en dome lahem bechol haggedullot sheyyaggiu haummot.

Vayyasem Adonai davar befi vegomer. mikra ze kevar kishshetuhu rishonim beferusham uderashotam, umakom hinnichu lanu bo. venire ki lefi sheratza Adonai legallot atidot udevarim niflaim mehattovot asher yaggiu leyisrael, veratza sheyyitgallu al yede bilam nevi haummot lefarsem maalat am kedosho lifne kol haummot vaasher tavona leyisrael mehattovot beacharit hayyamim vechilyon haummot al yede yisrael levassof, veyedu haummot mippi neviam haddevarim kichtavam leharebe toaliyyot hannimshachot leyisrael niglim venistarim, ulefi sheadam ze hu adam muvhak bechiur veteuv veshikkutz lo tanuach alav haruach hakkedosha hammaggedet haatidot, gam haddevarim mitztzad atzman divre kodesh hem velo yachanu begoy tame, laze nitchakkem Adonai laasot tikkun lidvar kedushsha leval taavor bemavoy metunnaf, veasa mechitza ben koach hammedabber vehaddibbur atzmo uven pi chazir, vehu maamar vayyasem Adonai davar echad befi bilam, hitztzia koach echad sheyyachol lehitmatztzea ben shenehem uvaze naasa pi bilam gevul bifne atzmo, vehaddavar mafsik ligvul koach hammedabber vehaddibbur, veaz ko tedabber ruach hakkodesh hi tedabber. verazal bazzohar (chelek 3 210:) amru ki tevat ko tirmoz livchina kedosha, vehammaskil yavin:

Veim tomar, ech tihye hahavdala bedavar kaze, tze ulemad asher yavdil Adonai ben hammemot harabbim vehaatzumim keshiur melo nima (chagiga 15.). vetze ulemad mibbeerah shel miryam mayim toch mayim (shabbat la.), vehallalu omdim bifne atzman vehallalu bifne atzman.
Shuv el balak. amar shuv el balak, chiyyevo sheyyomar haddevarim shehu atid lomar lifne balak lehakehot shinnav.
Vayyissa meshalo vegomer. perashti lemala (Bamidbar 23:7) shekkol devarav enam ella derech mashal, vegam lefi ma shepperashti sham yachol lehitparesh gam ken kan.

Vayyaan bilam vegomer lemor. tzarich ladaat amro lemor, ki lemi yomar balak? achen nitkavven lomar ki ma sheddibber elav kodem kavvanato lomar lo shekkol asher yedabber Adonai – ben kelala ben beracha – oto eese, im ken hagam shello ekkovennu vidabber Adonai levarcham avarchem lekayyem devar Adonai.

rashi: Beaznenu shamanu. mikkan atta lamed shehayu medabberim bene korach bishvil dorot hallalu habbaim acharehem, sheillu bishvil atzmam lo haya lahem lomar avotenu sipperu lanu, shehare hem atzmam rau nisse hammidbar vehayyam vehayyarden umilchamot yehoshua. kach meforash beaggadat tehillim (midrash tehillim 44:1):
targum: Adonai beudenana shemana avahatana ishtaayu lana ovada daavadta vimehon beyomaya di milkadmin:

rashi: Ki yarat hadderech lenegdi. rabbotenu chachme hammishna derashuhu notarikon — yora, raata, notta bishvil shehadderech lenegdi (shabbat kkh), kelomar lekinati ulehakniteni; ulefi mashmao ki charad hadderech lenegdi, leshon retet — ki raiti vaal hadderech shecharad umiher hadderech shehu lechasi ulehamroti, umikra katzar hu, kemo "vattechal david" (Shmuel 2 13); lishana acharina yarat leshon ratzon, vechen "al yede reshaim yirteni" (Iyov 16) — mefayyes umenachem oti al yede reshaim sheenan ella maknitim:
ohc: Vayyomer elav vegomer al ma vegomer hinne vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma taana hi zot "al ma" vegomer – al asakeha raim! od ma taana bemaamar "hinne anochi" kevan shello haya yodea, kemo sheheid hakkatuv "vaygal Adonai et ene vilam", ha lamadta shessetumim hayu ad atta. veulay shennitkavven Adonai lehashepil geono kede sheyyode befiv veyomar ki haaton raata hammalach shalosh peamim vehu lo raa, umizze yitgalle gam ken hafelagat miut hassagato bannistarot. laze amar lo "al ma" vegamar omer hinne anochi vegomer vattirani haaton. kan tachav chetz belibbo, shennitchayyev lomar befiv ki enayim lo velo yire kemo sheraata haaton, keamro "lo yadati ki atta nitztzav likrati", veze haya tachlit hakkavvana bidvar hammalach.

Od nitkavven baze lehairo ma sheggarma lo halicha zo, al derech amram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin kav.) bilam mittechilla nizkak leruach hakkodesh, ucheshennizdavveg levalak nistalleka mimmennu venikra kosem (Yehoshua 13:22), vehu ma sheheiro bema shello yada hammalach haomed lefanav, ma shello haya chen kodem lachen shehaya roe beruach hakkodesh. vetaam yetziat hammalach lenegdo, hodio bemaamar ki yarat hadderech vegomer, perush 'yarat hadderech kemo shepperesh ramban, uferush 'hadderech – darko shel bilam shehaya holech alav.

rashi: Ki lo yadati. gam ze genuto, veal korcho hoda, shehu haya mishtabbeach sheyyodea daat elyon, ufiv heid lo yadati (sham):

Im ra beenecha ashuva li. lehatris neged hammakom hi teshuva zo, amar lo hu veatzmo tzivvani lalechet veatta malach mevattel et devarav, lamud hu bechach sheomer davar umalach machaziro, amar leavraham "kach na et bincha" vego' (Bereshit 22), veal yede malach bittel et devaro, af ani im ra beenecha tzarich ani lashuv:
ohc: Vayyomer bilam vegomer chatati ki lo vegomer. amro chatati keneged ma sheramzu bemaamar "yarat hadderech" vegomer, ucheneged amro "lamma hikkita" vegomer amar "ki lo yadati" vegomer, veamro veatta asa teshuva lema shechashav asot, ucheneged hahalicha amar "im ra beenecha ashuva", veamar "li" – nitnotztza bo nevua sheyyesh lo yitron tov bachazarato.

rashi: Ume ana oto bilam ben beor. "ma ezom lo zaam Adonai" (Bamidbar 23:8), shello kaasti kol otan hayyamim.
Min hashshittim. shechatatem li sham, deu tzidkotay shello manati tovati veezrati mikkem ad heveti etchem laggilgal vechavashti lifnechem sham et haaretz.
targum: Ami idbar kean ma melach belak malka demoav uma atev yateh bilam bar beor hala gevuran itavida lechon mimeshar shitin ad bet gilgala bedil lemeda zachvata dayay:

rashi: Nachale shamen. limnachot.
Haetten bechori. karban lefishi.
targum: Hayitree Adonai bealfe dichrin berivvat nachalin dimshach haetten bucheri chalaf chovi chibbuv meay chalaf chatae nafshi:

rashi: Vayyissa meshalo vegomer'. kevan shehizkir et sheviyyat ashur, amar aoy my yachih mashamv el, mi yachol lehachayot et atzmo missumo et elle — shello yasim alav haggozer et elle, sheyyaamod sancheriv vivalbel et kol haummot, veod yavou:
ohc: Mi yichye missumo el. razal (sanhedrin kav.) darshu baze shete derashot, yeuyyan sham divrehem. venire li hakkatuv al pi hakedama middivre hazzohar, ki sibbat galuyyot yisrael hu levarer nitzotzot hakkedushsha asher sham netunim beyoshev haaretz hahi, vehu ma sheramzu bappasuk (Kohelet 8:9) "et asher yishlot haadam baadam lera lo", perush lera lo lashsholet, ki yitbarer mimmennu chelek hattov veyiggamer bo chelek hara sheyyesh beshekkenegdo bannishlat. uchevar hikdamnu peamim rabbot ki beheder chelek hattov mehaadam ze hu kilyono, ki hu davar hammaamid vehammechayye, ki bechinat hara met tikkare. umeatta yechavven hakkatuv al ze hadderech, lefi shekkadam vehizkir sheviyyat ashshur, hodia ruach hakkodesh maase sheviyyat am kedosho shehem golim baaratzot, veamar oy laummot missumo el, perush haoyev yesovev lahem simat elle betocham, ki kol makom yasim Adonai yisrael shamma hem motziim mehem kol nitzotze hakkedushsha hammaamidam vehammechayye otam, vehu maamar atzmo "et asher yishlot vegomer lera lo" shel hashsholet.

rashi: Gam attem. piv hichshilo — gam attem sofechem lelech befache nefesh karishonim:
Ma yosef. lo yeshanne devarav mibberacha liklala, halvay shello yosif levarech; kan nitnabbe sheatid lehosif lahem berachot al yado (sham):
ohc: Veatta shevu na vegomer. amar leshon bakkasha, shechash leval yaasu kemaase zikne midyan befaam acheret sheamru zichronam livracha shechazru limkomam velo lanu immo (Bamidbar Rabba 20,8), ulefi shehaanashim hem rabbim venichbadim haya yare sheyyelchu lahem kesheyyishmeu shevu po velo yachlit halichato immahem.

rashi: Kara shachav kaari. ketargumo — yityashevu veartzam bechoach ugevura:
ohc: Kara shachav vegomer. perush, afillu bizman shekkara, perush sheeno choger kele zayin velo omed lammilchama ella korea veyoshev lo, velo ze bilvad ella afillu shachav, sheeno margish babbaim alav, af al pi chen eno choshesh, ki mi hu ze sheyyitkarev elav lahakimo. veamro uchelavi, kafal hahadragot keneged shete kittot shebbeyisrael zo lemala mizzo kemo shekkatavnu lemala, shehem hatztzaddikim vehabbenonim.

Mevarachecha varuch vegomer. amar mevarachecha leshon rabbim uvaruch leshon yachid, lo ratza levarech ella echad, venitkavven al atzmo, veraa eno bishar hammevarchim. veamar orrecha arur nitkavven lomar sheen kol orrav arurim, uva lemaet atzmo mehaarira. veulay ki leraa nitkavven al ze hadderech: mevarachecha yitkayyemu devarav vetihye baruch, veorrecha yitkayyemu devarav vetihye vegomer, veheerim harasha baze lekayyem im yekallelem achar kach, velaze hikdim maamar baruch learur lehaamidam bearur chas veshalom, vaAdonai heshiv gemulo berosho venitkayyema bo hakkelala venitarer baolam hazze uvaolam habba, keamram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 90.) bilam en lo chelek laolam habba.

rashi: Batztzar hirchavta li. bayyamim sheavru alay, umeatta channeni ushema tefillati:
targum: Beidan tzeloti kabbel mini eloah tzidkoti beidan akta aftita li chus alay vekabbel tzeloti:

rashi: Lech im haanashim. badderech sheadam rotze lelech bah, molichin oto:
Lech im haanashim. ki chelkecha immahem vesofecha lovad min haolam (Makkot 10):
Veefes. al korchacha et hadabar ashar adabar vegomer':
Im sare valak. shomach lekallelem kemotam:
ohc: Vayyomer malach vegomer lech im haanashim. tzarich ladaat lamma dikdek lomar "im haanashim". verazal heiru baze veamru (Bamidbar Rabba 20,15) chelkecha immahem vesofcha leaved min haolam, veze derech derash, aval tzarich ladaat mashmaut haddevarim kefi peshatan. od tzarich ladaat lamma lo amar lo "shuv" vehaya yoter nachon. achen kavvanat haddevarim hu shennatan lo taam shehu maskim al yado lalechet hu bishvil haanashim shebbau acharav lalechet immahem, sheim lo yaskim al yado lalechet yachshevu machashavot ki yachush Adonai levilam laasot davar hefech ma sheyyachpotz Adonai asot, veyesh chillul hashshem baddavar chas veshalom. ulefi ma shepperashti befasuk "ki holech hu" shehaya holech yechidi, efshar sheramaz lo hammalach sheyyelech im haanashim velo shefi, vehakkavvana levattel mimmennu hachanat hara asher haya choshev laasot biksamav, vechen asa, dichtiv "vayyelech bilam im sare valak".

Veefes et haddavar vegomer oto tedabber vegomer. kan hitna alav tenay acher ma shello amar lo berishyon rishon, vehu shebberishyon rishon asar alav hammaase, dichtiv (Bamidbar 22:20) "ach et haddavar vegomer oto taase", umizze chashav harasha machashavot lehara, ki kocho haya bemaase uvedibbur, bemaase – bichshafav ukesamav, gam beeno haraa uchemaamaram zichronam livracha (zohar chelek 3 202:) befasuk "vayyissa enav vayyar et yisrael" vegomer, sheratza lehabbit bahem beayin hara ad shebba hakkadosh baruch hu vechissa otam betzillo, dichtiv (Bamidbar 24:2) "vattehi alav ruach Adonai", vedarshu zichronam livracha (zohar chelek 1 211.) "alav" – al yisrael shello tishlot bahem eno haraa; uvedibbur – lekallam. vechavvanat elyon bemaamar "oto taase" nitkavven leesor alav gam haddibbur asher yetze mimmennu maase, velo chen hevin hu letzad techunato haraa. laze ba maamar Adonai paam sheniyya vesatar loo veamar lo beferush haddibbur dichtiv "oto tedabber", uvaze kalal issur etza raa keneged yisrael, asher lo chen asa harasha bechol perate haazhara. veayyen maamar rabbotenu zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 20:18) befasuk "vayyasem Adonai davar befi vilam" sheddarshu shennatan befiv tas shel barzel, keshehaya rotze ledabber raa haya chonko. gam matzinu lo sheddibber etza raa sheggaram bah shennaflu miyyisrael esrim vearbaa elef, gam bifrat hammaase shennata alav leval yabbit bahem beeno haraa matzinu sheavar al ze kannizkar, lule Adonai shehaya lanu. umeatta matzati taam lemaase yisrael sheharaguhu, ki kefi haddin nitchayyev mita, ki Adonai hizhiro ben al hammaase ben al haddibbur beferush kannizkar, veazharat bene noach zo hi mitatan (sanhedrin 57:).

rashi: Ki im yihye levaer kayin vegomer'. ashrecha shennitkata letokef ze, sheenecha nitrad od min haolam, ki af im atta atid liglot im aseret hashevatim, vetihye levaer mimmakom shennityashavta sham, ma bechach?
Ad ma ashur tishbekka. ad hechan hu magle otecha? shemma lachlach vechavor? en ze terud min haolam, ella tiltul mimmakom lemakom, vetashuv im shear haggaluyyot:
ohc: Ki im yihye levaer vegomer. perush, nistakkel bakkorot asher yecholin lehaggio lekeni, veamar "ad ma", perush, ad ma yihye shiur asher tavona alav mehatztzarot, ashshur tishbekka perush, sheyyishlot alav ashshur shehu sancheriv veyolichennu bashshivya.

rashi: Lo ish vegomer'. kevar nishba lahem lahaviam ulehorisham eretz shiva ummot veatta savur lahamitam bammidbar?:
Hahu amar vegomer'. bilshon temah, vetargumo vetoyvin umitmallechin — chozerim venimlachin lachazor bahem:
ohc: Lo ish vegomer uven adam vegomer. amar shete haderagot keneged shete bechinot: haachat asher yavtiach haadam hazzulat al davar, vehashsheni asher yachkim adam asot davar behanehagotav veinyanav sheen nogim lazzulat. keneged maamar shehu havetachat hazzulat amar lo ish el vichazzev, ucheneged maamar sheeno nogea lazzulat amar uven adam veyitnecham, sheeno mechazzev bazzulat ella yinnachem al asher dibber asot. uvema shellefanenu yesh shene devarim asher dibber Adonai: echad lehakim malchut yisrael ulehetiv lahem, vehashsheni shechashav Adonai laasot retzono latet torato leam kedosho, vehem devarim shennogim lo yitbarach. ucheneged shenehem amar "lo ish el vichazzev" bahavetachot hattovot asher hivtiach laavot, "uven adam veyitnecham" mimma shechashav behanehagot olamo latet torato leyisrael ulehadricham lekayyem mitzvotav. veim ken, ech yachshov lekallel yisrael venimtza mechazzev chas veshalom behavetachotav laavot venicham al ma shechashav asot?

Veamro "vichazzev" "veyitnecham" betosefet vav, kalal baze shete haderagot: achat, sheeno ish velo adam, veod lachshod bo chas veshalom davar sheafillu bannivraim hu geraon, vehu hakkazav vehacharata. venitkavven baze shemmin hannimna sheyyaskim al killat yisrael ad sheyyihyu bo shene devarim: "ish vichazzev" uven adam veyitnecham", shehagam shehaya chas veshalom ish vichazzev, im kol ze lo yitcharet lema shenogea lema shechashav asot retzono beemtzaut yisrael. vetaam sheppaam achat amar "ish" ufaam achat amar "ben adam", lefi shehammavtiach lehetiv lazzulat yeshno begeder maala, laze amar leshon chashivut, uvifrat hammitcharet al ma shechashav al atzmo amar "uven adam".

Hahu amar vegomer. peshat hakkatuv chozer lehaadam, veefshar lefarsho al hakkadosh baruch hu al ze hadderech: kesherotze laasot maase eno tzarich lemaase ella bemaamar hu naase, vehu amro hahu – perush, hael shehizkir besamuch, "amar" – perush peullotav sheasa hu amar vattehi, velo yaase – perush lo yitztarech lemaase, keamro (Bereshit 1:3) "vayyomer vegomer vayhi chen", vechen amru bammishna (avot 5:1) "baasara maamarot nivra haolam". veamro vedibber vegomer – perush ucheshehammaase shennaasa bemaamaro eno kol kach kayyam, al derech amram shehaya haolam rofef veroed, dichtiv (Iyov 26:11) "ammude shamayim yerofafu veyitmehu miggaarato", veamru chachamenu zichronam livracha (chagiga 12.) sheggaar Adonai bahem venitkayyemu, vehu amro vedibber leshon koshi, velo yekimenna – perush velo yitztarech lekayyemenna ella bedibburo hakkashe hi mitkayyemet umitchazzeket.

rashi: Holech leammi. meatta hareni chishar ammi, shennistallek hakkabbah mealav:

Lecha iatzecha. ma lecha laasot, uma hi haetza? elohehem shel ellu sone zimma hu 26', kidita vechelek (Sanhedrin 106); teda shebbilam hissi etza zo lehachshilam bezimma, shehare neemar "hen henna hayu livne yisrael bidvar bilam" (Bamidbar 31):
Asher yaase haam hazze leammecha. mikra katzar hu ze: iatzecha lehachshilam veomar lecha ma shehen atidin lehara lemoav beacharit hayyamim — "umachatz paate moav"; hattargum mefaresh kotzer haivri:
ohc: Veatta hinni vegomer. perush, hinne hu muchan lekayyem gezerat melech lalechet baet hahi. veamar leshon yachid keneged ma sheramaz lo betevat "lecha" kemo shepperashti, veamar leammi keneged ma sheamar lo "el mekomecha", aval keneged perat habbericha lo hoda lo ki lo chash liro mimmennu ki kashfan gadol haya, vetze ulemad (midrash haggadol lo,8) kamma nitatztzemu immo am bene yisrael baharigato umikkol shekken zulatam shello yuchelu asot immo raa.

Asher yaase vegomer beacharit vegomer. perush, lefi sheratza legallot lo sheyyisrael yeabbedu vikakeu betzatam shel moav, vegam balak efshar shehaya roe davar ze batztzippor ki am bene yisrael yimchatz paate moav, laze amar lo ki ma sheyyaase haam hazze leammecha yihye beacharit hayyamim. vetaam shehutzrach lehodio davar ze, lefi shebba leyaatzo atzat hafekarat benotehem, keamram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin kav.) beferush amro "lecha iatzcha", laze chash sheyyomar ech yittachen sheyyetzu neshehem leam bene yisrael habbaim leabbedam, halo kol hayyotze yiddaker. laze hodio ki lo yareu velo yashchitu am hazze leammecha, vicholin neshehem latzet lemachane yisrael laatzato. vedikdek lomar leammecha, lomar davka leammecha shehem moav shehaya melech alehem hu shello yaasu lahem davar ella beacharit hayyamim, ulemaet balak ki peta yishshaver, uchemo shekken haya dichtiv (Bamidbar lo,8) "veet malche midyan" vegomer vehu echad mehem, keamram zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 20,20).

rashi: Et heharim. et haavot.
Haggevaot. haimmahot.
targum: Shemau chean yat dayya amar kum don im turaya veyishmaan ramata kalach:

rashi: Ki yitchammetz levavi. mitterem sheraiti mappala zo beruach hakkodesh haya levavi mitchammetz al derech harshaim shetztzalcha (yirmeya 12:1), uvechilyotay hayiti mishtonan, leshon cherev shanun (Mishlei 25:18), ucheshehu mitpael hattav nittenet beemtza shoresh hatteva kederech kol teva sheyyesod techillatah shin:
targum: Arum yechush libbi vechuleyati baaran keesha:

rashi: Vayyar et hakkeni. lefi shehaya keni takua etzel amalek, kainyan shenneemar "vayyomer shaul el hakkeni" vego' (Shmuel 1 15), hizkiro achar amalek; nistakkel bigdullatan shel bene yitro shenneemar bahem (Dbhya 2) "tiratim shimatim suchatim" (Sifre Bamidbar 10; Sanhedrin 104):
Etan moshavecha. tameah ani mehechan zachita lechach halo atta immi hayita baatzat "hava nitchakkema lo" (Shemot 1), veatta nityashavta veetan umaoz shel yisrael (Sanhedrin 106):
ohc: Vayyar et hakkeni vegomer. ze yitro, vechavvanat hammaamar hi al derech amram zichronam livracha (bava batra 15.) "etan" ze avraham, veavraham haya ger tzedek rishon veal shemo nikraim kol haggerim avraham, veamru zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 27,6) sheyyitro nitgayyer, laze amar etan moshavecha perush moshavcha hu keneged avraham shennikra etan. veamro vesim bassela vegomer perush, veod lecha shessamta kinnecha bassela, perush kinnecha hu bitto shennatan lemoshe, veyiches moshe lassela lefi shehaya takkif battora veoz melech. gam sela yirmoz lattora kaamur besefer hazzohar (Tikkunei Zohar 21) venikra moshe al shemah.

rashi: Ki holech hu. raa shehaddavar ra beene hammakom venitavva lelech:
Lesatan lo. malach shel rachamim haya, vehaya rotze lemono millachato, shello yecheta veyovad (sham):
Ushene nearav immo. mikkan leadam chashuv hayyotze ladderech yolich immo shene anashim leshammesho, vechozerim umeshammeshim ze et ze (sham):
ohc: Vayyichar af vegomer ki holech hu. dikdek lomar hu, lomar taam shechara af Adonai bo, shello amar babboker lesare balak she natan lo reshut lalechet, ella hishkim babboker vayyachavosh vegomer vayyelech im sare vegomer, shezze yaggid shehalichato mertzono velo hutzrach lerishyon elyon, vehu amro ki holech hu, perush hu holech birtzono been rishyon Adonai, laze chara appo bo.

Od nire al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (Zohar chodesh 169:) sheamru befasuk "vayyelech shefi" shemmidderech shel hammashre alav kochot hattuma lehitboded yachid, vechan kesheraa Adonai sheholech hu, perush hu levaddo haya nifrad missare balak veose maasehu, ze yaggid shemmechin tzaado laasot kecheftzo haarura. vahagam shehayu immo shene nearav en meakkevin alav hahitboddut, letzad shehem regilim immo veyaase maasehu lifnehem, veyada Adonai darko haraa vechara appo bo. od yirtze beamro holech hu sheyyada Adonai sherasha ze gavar bo hachefetz lalechet meatzmo, hagam shello haya balak sholeach acharav hu holech lirtzono, uvaze gilla otzem sinato leam Adonai, velaze chara appo yitbarach bo.

Ushene nearav immo. tzarich ladaat leeze inyan hodia shehayu immo shene nearav, verabbotenu zichronam livracha (tanchuma) amru lehodia derech eretz vechulei, vaadayin kashe lamma lo hodia ken ella achar shehizkir charon appo yitbarach vitziat malach lesatan lo. veyitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (berachot mag:) ki lishlosha en hammazzik nire lahem veen tzarich lomar shello yazzik, vechan lefi sheyyatza satan levilam malach hammazziko, modia hakkatuv taam shello hizzik gam shello nigla elav, lefi shehaya hu ushene nearav immo hare shelosha.

rashi: Vayyar et amalek. nistakkel befuranuto shel amalek:
Reshit goyim amalek. hu kadam et kullam lehillachem beyisrael — vechach tirgem unkelos — vacharitv leaved beyadam, shenneemar "timche et zecher amalek" (Devarim 25):
ohc: Reshit vegomer veacharito vegomer. perush: reshit goyim shennitztauu yisrael leabbed, lo nitztauu techilla ella al amalek, shekken ketiv (Shemot 17:14) "ketov zot zikkaron vegomer macho emche et zecher amalek", veze haya samuch litziatam mimmitzrayim, vehayu lochamim veholchim bo. shaul asa bo ma sheasa, bime mardechay asu bo yisrael ma sheasu, veamar veacharito vegomer, perush, lo yaamod al perek sof hakkillayon ella ade oved, perush, ad shehammelech hammashiach yeabbed haummot az tihye acharito shel amalek lehacherit.

O yirtze al ze hadderech: reshit goyim – perush, "reshit" leshon maala vachashivut hu amalek lechol haggoyim, veyihye omed bemaala zo ad sheyyaggia leferek kilyono. vehu amro veacharito – perush, gam ki yihye reshit goyim – ade oved, veyesh shevach leyisrael sheyyaggia beyadam beferek gedullato. vechen amar vetzim miyyad kittim vegomer vegam hu ade oved yihye leyisrael lemana.

rashi: Kiryat chutzot. ir melea shevakim, anashim vataf bechutzoteha, lomar ree verachem shello yeakeru ellu:
ohc: Vayyelech bilam vegomer. nitkavven lomar shello nahag bo kavod, ella shekkadam vehalach balak vehu halach acharav, velaze lo amar "vayyelchu balak uvilam". veefshar ki lefi sheshshama balak maamar bilam sheeno yachol laasot davar, pana elav oref vehalach lo, ella shebbilam nitpal lo meachorav vehalach immo, vehu amro vayyelech bilam im balak.

rashi: Lamnatztzeach binginot. mizmor ze yasad david, sheyyomruhu bene levi hamenatztzechin binginot beshir al hadduchan. leshon nitztzuach nofel bammitchazzekim baavoda, keinyan shenneemar "yaamdu haleviyyim mibben esrim shana vamala lenatztzeach al melechet bet Adonai" (Ezra 3:8):
targum: Leshabbacha al chingita tushebachta ledavid:

rashi: Veyerd miyyaakov. veod yihye moshel acher miyyaakov:
Veheevid sarid meir. hachashuva shel edom, hi romi, veal melech hammashiach omer ken, shenneemar bo "veyerd miyyam ad yam" (tehillim ab) "velo yihye sarid levet esav" (Avb' 18):
ohc: Veyerd miyyaakov. rabbi avraham ibben ezra amar sheal yoav hu omer. verashi zichrono livracha peresh al melech hammashiach, udevarav ikkar, ki ledivre rabbi avraham ibben ezra haya lo lehakedim maamar ze lemaamar "vehaya edom yeresha" shehu inyan hammashiach. uledivre Rashi zichrono livracha, hagam shekkevar amar "vekarkar kol bene shet" vechalal kol sheyyatzu mishshet ben adam harishon, ba lomar shehagam sheyyishshaaru mehaummot achar "vekarkar" vegomer, kammuvan gam ken mimmashmaut "vekarkar" shello yeabbed kullam kemaamaram zichrono livracha (fesachim sach.), af al pi chen lo tihye memshala mehem ella miyyaakov, vehu amro veyerd perush, leshon malchut, miyyaakov, perush miyyaakov levad tihye.
Veamro veheevid sarid meir, perush, lo melech levad hu sheyyihye miyyaakov velo mehem, ella afillu sarid shehu memshala lematta mehammalchut yovad mehem, velo yarim mehem od rosh.

rashi: Vehishmadti arecha. "vaashetze baale devavach", vechen (Yeshayahu 14:21) "umalu fene tevel arim" vechen (Shmuel 1 28) "vayhi arecha":
targum: Veaakar shetile ammaya mibbenach veeshetze baale devavach:

rashi: Bakar vatzon. davar muat:
ohc: Vayyizbach balak vegomer. nitkavven hakkatuv baze gam lehodia cherpat adam ze, shello hechshivo balak lisod immo afillu seuda rishona ella shalach elav velassarim vegomer, veulay sheddikdek lomar velassarim asher itto shello shalach ella davar hammaspik levilam velassarim hayyeduim shehayu itto veshalal nearav, veze yaggid tzarut en balak bichvod bilam. o lefi shechashav balak ki bilam yikkach kol hashshaluach lo veyachzik bo ki hu lo levaddo velo yitten lassarim vechulei ki haya yadua shehu ra ayin, laze kesheshshalach amar beferush ki lo lo levaddo yihye hattevach hashshaluach ella lo velassarim. veamar asher itto, efshar sheasa lefi cheshbon hassarim sheimmo, perat lammizdammen, sheim yizdammenu sarim acherim immo en menat basar lahem. velaze timtza sheamru razal (Bamidbar Rabba 20,16) shehikpid bilam al miut habbasar veamar "lemachar ani sholeach meera binchasav shel ze", ulemachar amar lo "bene li vegomer shiva farim veshiva elim" (Bamidbar 23:1).

rashi: Beno veor. kemo "lemayeno mayim" (Tehillim 114); umia shenehem hayu gedolim meavotehem, balak beno tzippor — aviv beno hu vemalchut, uvilam gadol meaviv binviut — mane ven peras haya (sanhedrin kh; tanchuma):

Shetum haayin. eno nekura umutzet lachutz vechor shellah nire fatuach, uleshon mishna hu, kede sheyishtom veyistom veyiggov (Avoda Zara 69); verabbotenu ameru, lefi sheamar umispar et rova yisrael — shehakkabbah yoshev umone reviotehen shel yisrael, matay tavo tippa shennolad hatztzaddik mimmennu, amar belibbo, mi shehu kadosh umeshortav kedoshim yistakkel bidvarim hallalu? veal davar ze nismat eno shel bilam (Nidda 31); veyesh meforshim shatam hain — petuach haayin, kemo shettirgem unkelos, veal sheamar shetum haayin velo amar shetum haenayim, lamadnu shessuma veachat meenav haya (sanhedrin kh):
ohc: Vayyissa meshalo vegomer neum bilam vegomer uneum vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar vayyissa meshalo. od ma tzorech lomar neum bilam, peshita ki fiv hamedabber. od lamma hutzrach lehodia shem aviv kan. od lamma hutzrach lesammen atzmo besimanim shebbegufo. gam bemaamar "shomea" vegomer ma nitkavven baze, veim leshabbeach atzmo lamma lo shibbach befaam rishona?

Achen lefi shead atta haya medabber ma sheyyasim Adonai befiv hefech retzono, shehaddibbur haya yotze mippiv beal karcho, veatta ratza sheyyaskim hu al haddevarim hayyotzim mippiv keillu hu omer otam mertzono happashut. vechavvanato baze gam ken sheim yekallel yavo koach hammevarech vivarech, aval im yevarech lo yevarech koach hammevarech. uma gam lefi ma shepperashti befasuk "vayyashet el hammidbar panav" vegomer beferush sheni, shennitkavven lehacheshir atzmo levarech yisrael, yityashshev hakkatuv al ze hadderech: vayyissa meshalo – perush, hammashal shehu mimmennu umiddato. uvaze yityashshevu divre razal (sanhedrin 105:) sheamru shehu amar "kinchalim" vegomer, bikkesh lechannotan kenachal shepposek bimot hachamma vechulei, veruach hakkodesh meshivato: "lo kemo sheatta choshev ella nittayu", perush kenahar sheeno posek veholech. "kaahalim" – perush shehem metultalim veneekarim mimmekomam, veruach hakkodesh meshivato "nata Adonai" vegomer. vechen kol devarav hem beracha sheppenimiyyutah kelala, veim hem divre ruach hakkodesh lamma tomar davar sheyyesh bo dofi, ella vadday shehem divre atzmo.

Velaze amar vayyissa meshalo vayyomar neum bilam, perush, devarim ellu hem mishshelli veenam kishar haddevarim shekkadmu shello hayu mimmenni, uferesh mi hu hammedabber devarim ellu kede sheyyuchakku leolam mi baal devarim. veamar shelosha simanim kederech amro bammishna (pea 87 41): kol zayit sheyyesh lo shem vechulei bishmo uvemaasav uvimkomo. keneged "bishmo" amar beno veor, veamar "beno" velo amar "ben" lomar shehaya aviv lematta mimmennu verauy lihyot bemadregat beno legabbe bechinat hahassaga. o efshar lomar shello haya livor ella bilam, laze amar "beno" perush yechido shel beor. velichshettimtza lomar shehayu lo acherim, amar shekkullam nechshavim keayin lefanav keillu en lo ki im bilam. keneged "maasav" amar haggever shetum haayin, shehaya nikkar bemaase enav shekkol makom shehaya mistakkel beenav haya loke, velachen haya sotem eno haraa leval yazzik. veefshar shehayta lo ayin hassemalit meyuchedet laze. veim nefaresh "shetum haayin" hu leshon peticha, yirtze shehaya mesumman biftichat eno lehara. keneged "mekomo" amar shomea imre el, shehaya omed lenes ammim veen adam acher omed bemakom ze shel nevua.

Od yirtze behair lamma amar shalosh peamim "neum" velo hispik beachat. achen lefi sheyyesh bevilam shalosh haderagot mikkochot hannelam: 1 – koach shebba bivriato asher paal bo hammolid, 2 – asher kana bechoach maasav ki haadam yimshoch lenafsho kochot kefi hammufal mimmennu, 3 – asher hiknahu Adonai lesibba yedua lihyot navi laggoyim kede shello yitraamu haummot, kaamur bedivrehem zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 20:1). venitkavven bilam lomar devarav behasekamat kochotav yachad: keneged koach habba mikkoach hammolid amar neum bilam beno veor, vedikdek lomar "beno" velo amar "ben", ki az haya nishma shemmetzayyen mi yelado, vehu nitkavven lomar al hachelek shebbo mimma shehu beno velo al ma sheyyesh bechocho hen hayyom; ucheneged chelek asher kana bechocho amar neum haggever, perush haggever ma shekkana bihyoto gever meatzmo, gam ramaz letaatzumotav milleshon gevura, shetum haayin sheppakach enav, keamram zichronam livracha (Zohar chelek 3 208.) shehaya holech etzel uzza vaazael vesham kana kochot hattuma venitpattechu enav benistarot uvemuflaot achar kamma yegiot, kaamur bedivrehem kamma yegiot tzarich laddavar; ucheneged koach shebbo asher hiknahu Adonai lassibba hayyedua amar neum shomea imre el, vechafal lomar imre el umachaze vegomer keneged shene perate hassaga: echad – keshehaya ba lo haddibbur leaznav, vehashsheni – keshehaya nigle elav. ucheneged shenehem amar nofel ugeluy enayim, perush, keshehaya choze machaze shadday haya nofel, ucheshehaya ba lo haddibbur veshomea beaznav lo haya nofel ella haya geluy enayim.

rashi: Middolyav. mibbeerotav, uferusho ketargumo:
Vezaro bemayim rabbim. leshon hatzlacha hu ze — kezera hazzarua al pene hammayim:
Veyarom meagag malko. melech rishon shellahem yichbosh et agag melech amalek:
Vetinnasse malchuto. shel yaakov yoter veyoter, sheyyavo acharav david ushelomo:
ohc: Yizzal mayim vegomer. hakkavvana al pi divrehem (Shemot Rabba 28,6) ki chol ish yisrael kibbel missinay chelek battora, velaze ramaz "morasha", vedarshu (fesachim mat:) al tikre morasha ella meorasa. veamar kan ki chol ma shemmechaddeshim battora hu "middalyav", mimma sheddalo dala moshe, shehakkol ramuz battora shebbichtav.

Veamar leshon deli lomar, ki beerech pinna (bina) haggedola asher atid Adonai legallot leyisrael besof haddorot bime melech hammashiach, shehu shaar hachamishshim shel bina, kol hamt hem begeder deli beerko. veamar ki hagam sheatta hu deli, zera yisrael yizke lakachat mayim rabbim shehu shaar hachamishshim, vehu amro vezaro bemayim rabbim:

Veyarom meagag malko. kan gilla malchut yisrael hakkayyemet shehitchila meagag shehi malchut amalek, rishona sheasa shaul umishsham nifseka malchut shaul venittena lereehu hattov shehu david. vetaam shekkinna hatechalat malchuto meagag, lehair sibbat haddavar shehaya mitztzad agag, perush shehinnicho shaul chay velo harago, keamram zichronam livracha (Megila 13.) shebbeotah hallayla hishritz agag zera amalek, veze sibba laakirat malchut shaul uleromem malchut bet david. vetinnasse malchuto hi malchut hammashiach shehu david, dichtiv (Yechezkel 37:24) "veavdi david melech alehem", yarum venissa meod kaamur bishaya (Yeshayahu 52:13).

Od yirtze beamro veyarom meagag, shettechillat peullat melech hammashiach hi milchemet amalek, shekkol amalek ba meagag kayyadua, veamru zichronam livracha (tanchuma sof parashat tetze) sheamar hakkadosh baruch hu: "en hakkisse shalem ad sheyyimmache zecher amalek", vetinnasse malchuto al kol haolam.

rashi: Nakke bo. ani veammi nakke vahem. daa — leshon mishna hu (42 Kh), menakke lo min haddamim — lechasser mehem meat (tanchuma):
Ki yadati vegomer'. al yede milchemet sichon sheazarto lehakkot et moav:
ohc: Veatta lecha na vegomer, amar veatta shello yeakkev afillu shiur shaa achat, ki kol shaa hem besakkana mitztziddam. veamro na leshon bakkasha, vesamach habbakkasha leikkar happeulla shehi "ara li" vegomer, vedikdek lomar tevat li shettihye haarira bahem li letzarki, vehakkavvana baze shello titakkev haarira ad achar sheyyaasu nekama bahem uma shehaya kevar haya, ella shettaase happeulla techef umiyyad shebbaze tihye hatztzalat moav mehem. veramaz od bemaamar li lefi shekkadam bilam uverach et balak, keamram zichronam livracha (tanchuma, balak 1), laze amar "ara li", perush, afillu li shekkevar ani mevorach lo yoil ze vetzarich learer otam. veim tomar eno tzarich shekkevar atta mevorach, laze amar ki atzum hu mimmenni kan kalal shene devarim, echad inyan hachozek hattivi, veechad inyan habberacha ki am ze birchato atzuma mibbirchati. veamro ulay nakke bo perush, veachar kol ze odenni begeder hassafek ulay, vegam geder safek ze lo leabbedo ella lehakkot bo legarsho mealay. gam nitkavven lomar keneged habbenonim nakke bo, ucheneged hatztzaddikim vaagarshennu.

Uvederech remez piv hichshilo bemaamar ara li learer et balak, vechen haya, sheggaram lo baatzato mitat kazbi bitto. gam haya sibba sheyyashuv balak lemidyan vesham nafal bacherev, dichtiv (Bamidbar 31:8) "veet malche midyan hargu vegomer veet tzur" vegomer, vezulat halichat bilam sheggilla lemoav ki muvtachim hem miyyisrael velo yaasu lahem davar ella beacharit hayyamim, haya nishar sham balak velo haya chozer lemidyan velo haya neherag, hare nitkayyem shehalach learoto levalak, lekayyem ma shenneemar (tehillim 37:15) "charbam tavo velibbam".

Ki yadati et vegomer. yitbaer al pi divrehem (Bamidbar Rabba kan) sheamru shebbilam berach et balak sheyyihye melech, laze amar ki yadati et asher tevarech mevorach shehare nitkayyema bo birchato, vedavar ze hu yadua etzlo levad lefi shehu nissa et haddavar veeno yadua lakkol ki birkat bilam beracha, vaasher yuar ze yadua mimma shekkillel moav lesichon. veyesh lehair beinyan ze, bishlama ma shehayu tzodkin killotav shel bilam yesh shene teamim baddavar, echad lihyoto ra ayin, vehashsheni shehaya yodea rega beappo, kemaamaram zichronam livracha (berachot 7.) vehaya mekallel berega hazzaam, aval habberacha en metziut shettitkayyem mippiv.

Venire ki leolam birkat bilam kevirkat chamor, ella sheharasha haya maarim keshehaya roe beitztagninut sheppeloni yaale ligdulla vechaddome, haya ose shemmevarcho, ucheshebba haddavar umitbarech choshev shebbirchato shel bilam garma, velo chen hu ella mazzalo garam. uchemo chen asa levalak sheraa bechochavo sheatid limloch bemoav, uvercho baddavar atzmo lerammoto ki hu hassovev.

rashi: Linu fo hallayla. en ruach hakkodesh shora alav ella ballayla, vechen lechol nevie ummot haolam, vechen lavan bachalom hallayla, shenneemar (Bereshit 31) "vayyavo elohim el lavan haarammi bachalom hallayla" keadam haholech etzel pilagsho behechave (Tanchuma; Vayikra Rabba 1):
Kaasher yedabber Adonai elai. im yamlicheni lalechet im bene adam kemotechem, elech immachem, shemma en kevodo letitti lahaloch ella im sarim gedolim mikkem:
Vayyeshevu. leshon akkava:
ohc: Linu fo. dikdek lomar tevat fo, ulay shennitkavven lomar lahem sheyyalinu itto bimlono, vegamar omer hattaam vahashivoti vegomer kaasher yedabber vegomer, dikdek lomar "kaasher" velo amar "asher yedabber" vegomer, nitkavven lomar taam sheomer lahem linu fo immo kede shettechef umiyyad kaasher yedabber Adonai elav yeshivem davar, ma shello yihye chen kesheyyihyu chutz limlono. veamar hallayla ulay sheamar ken letzad tzarut eno shello natan lahem achsanya ella lelayla echat.

Veatta berach vegomer. gazar alav arbaa devarim: 1, shello yitakkev ella yelech beotah shaa, vehu amro veatta. 2, sheyyelech bimrutza kevoreach, vehu amro berach. 3, shello yelech achar immo lelavvoto ella hu levaddo, vehu amro lecha. 4, shello yelech meir zo leir acheret meare moav o midyan ella limkomo petora, vehu amro el mekomecha. ulefi shekkol ze hu zilzul levilam vehu hefech ma sheshshalach lo (Bamidbar 22:17) "ki chabbed achabbedcha meod", laze amar lo "amarti kabbed" vegomer, veamro vehinne menaacha Adonai mikkavod perush, kol ma sheasa Adonai shello hinnichacha lekallelam eno ella letachlit davar ze shehu lemanacha mehakkavod.

Vesatar bilam taanato ki sheker befiv, halo gam lemalachecha dibbarti vegomer, perush veaf al pi chen savarta vekibbalta veshalachta li "ki kabbed achabbedcha". vechafal lomar "malachecha asher shalachta" velo hispik beamro malachecha umuvan haddavar shehu shelacham, nitkavven bemaamar malachecha al hammalachim harishonim, veamro asher shalachta nitkavven el malachim sheshshalach paam sheniyya. veamro lemor perush lo dibbarti haddevarim levad ella tzivvitim lemor lecha.

rashi: Ma tovu ohalecha. al sheraa fitchehem sheenan mechuvvanin ze mul ze:
Mishkenotecha. chaniyyotecha, ketargumo; davar acher, ma tabv ahalik — ma tovu ohel shilo uvet olamim beyishuvan, shemmakrivin bahen korbanot lechapper alechem:

Mishkenotecha. af keshehen charevin, lefi shehen mashkon alechem, vechurbanan kappara al hannefashot, shenneemar "killa Adonai et chamato" (Eicha 4), uvamme chilla? (sham) "vayyatztzet esh betziyyon" (tanchuma mishpatim):
ohc: Ma tovu ohalecha vegomer. perush, lefi sheyyesh beyisrael kat shekkovim ittim lattora, vechat sheoskim bah yated hattekua. keneged baale ittim amar ma tovu ohalecha yaakov keohel ze sheeno kavua, ucheneged kat hattekua amar mishkenotecha yisrael:

Od nitkavven keneged shene zemannim: 1 shehayu bammidbar shehaya Adonai benehem baohel, dichtiv (Shemot 26:7) "veasita vegomer leohel al hammishkan", uchenegdo amar "ma tovu ohalecha". 2 shehayu vo bayyishshuv, dichtiv (Melachim 1 8:12) "Adonai amar lishkon baarafel", uchenegdo amar "mishkenotecha yisrael". veamar leshon rabbim lefi sheyyesh haderagot beohel moed, mishkan lifnim min happarochet.

rashi: Vehaya yeresha seir. leoyevav yisrael:
ohc: Oyvav. perush, edom veseir, veamro yeresha perush: shello tibbane od velo tihye lahem tekuma kishar haummot sheyyichyu mehem kaamur. venatan taam lefi shehem oyve yisrael, dichtiv (Tehillim 137:7) "zechor Adonai livne edom" vegomer, laze makkatam yetera al kol bene shet.

Veyisrael ose chayil. perush, beemtzaut ibbud edom ushear bene shet yaasu yisrael chayil. perush, asher bala 100 ushear haammim yotziu balo mippiv, ulefi shennitzotze hakkedushsha hem meluchelachim keshehem toch hakkelippa, ucheshehem mitbarrim veyotzim mimmenna hem nitkanim, laze amar ose chayil leshon tikkun lachayil asher haya balua bahem:

Vayyaal vegomer par vegomer. nire shechozer levilam shebbesamuch, ki hu sheheela hakkarbanot velo balak, ki hu lo amar lo ella "vehachen li baze shiva farim" vegomer. vetzarich ladaat lamma asa bilam davar ze bilti rishyon meAdonai, ki hu tzivva lo "ach et haddavar vegomer oto taase". veyesh mehammefarshim sheratzu lomar ki chen tzivva lo hammelech, venistayyeu mimmaamar "et shivat hammizbechot arachti" vegomer shehammashmaut yaggid sheasa kaasher amar lo Adonai, ad kan. udevarim ellu en sichli holmam, ki bevadday shello yachpotz Adonai bezevach reshaim, uma gam shettachlit kavvanat hammakrivim hi lehara leam kedosho. umatzati sheamru razal bammidrash (Bamidbar Rabba kan) hefech ze, gam baggemara bemassechet sota (47.) amru veze leshonam: amar rav yehuda amar rav, leolam yaasok adam battora vechulei afillu shello lishmah vechulei, shebbischar arbaim ushenayim karbanot shehikriv vechulei, ad kan, veim hakeravatam hayta bemitzvat Adonai, mi yomar shello hayta hakkavvana lekayyem mitzvat hammelech, velaze yatzta mimmennu rut.

Vehannachon beenay ki bilam dan bedato shello nitztavva meAdonai ella al hammaase vehaddevarim sheyyaase bilam behishtaddeluto bivchinot vechochot hattuma shechutz mimmennu yitbarach, aval bahishtaddelut asher yishtaddel immo yitbarach kivyachol ze lo neesar lo. velaze hikriv karbenotav laAdonai, shekkol ma sheyyihye lichvodo yitbarach aso yaase. veamro et shivat hammizbechot, ba lirot im ratza Adonai bemaasav o im hikpid alav gam al ze, venitkavven gam ken lehagedil maasav, sheharishonim hayu bonim mizbeach echad vehu shiva, veamar bederech ze et shivat vegomer kemi shekkadam lo haddibbur al ze velo amar "shiva mizbechot" vegomer, uchevar heiru razal (Bamidbar Rabba 20,18) baze shennitkavven leshiva mizbechot shebbanu haavot, ad kan, veze shiur hakkatuv et shiva mizbechot hayyeduot shebbanu haavot ani arachti kemotan, vehakkavvana baze lo tigdal maalat am bene yisrael bishvil haavot harishonim shebbanu shiva mizbechot.

rashi: Mi li vashshamayim. shum malach shebbacharti li leeloah? lo vacharti ella otcha:
targum: Man kevatach dili bishmaya ela at veimach chavra la tzeviti beara:

rashi: Kava li. zo kasha meara li, shehu nokev umefaresh (sham):
Vegerashtiv. min haolam, uvalak lo amar ella vaagareshennu min haaretz — eni mevakkesh ella lehassiam mealay, uvilam haya soneam yoter mibbalak (sham):
ohc: Hinne haam vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma shinna middivre balak, ki balak amar hinne am yatza vehu amar hinne haam hayyotze, uvalak amar hinne chissa vehu amar vaychas, balak amar veatta vehu amar atta, balak amar ara vehu amar kava, balak amar nakke bo vehu amar lehillachem bo. veyitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 20,9) sheamru shebbilam taa bedato ki yesh davar nelam meAdonai chas veshalom, vetaa mimmaamar "mi haanashim" vegomer. vahagam shepperashnu bo derech acher, shivim panim lattora. vechevan sheeno hitattu baze, chashav leshannot divre balak, lefi shennishma mehem sinato shel bilam uchemo shepperashti bemaamar "hinne am yatza". vechash bilam lihyot beene Adonai shehu sone leyisrael, ki kevar nitparsem lakkol ki am bene yisrael hem ahuve hammakom, umaase mitzrayim yochiach, laze shinna veamar hinne haam hayyotze mimmitzrayim, kayyadua ki yetziat mitzrayim mefursemet lechol haolam hayta, velashon ze en nishma bo ma shepperash bemaamar "hinne am yatza" shezze yaggid oyvut bilam. gam amar vaychas vegomer velo amar "hinne kissa" mehattaam atzmo, lehasetir haddevarim hannishma mehem heyoto sone kannizkar. laze lo amar "hinne" sheyyore hodaat hefech ma shehaya birtzonam vidiatam beyisrael meatzato kemo shepperashti. veamro vaychas, perush shemmodio taam happachad shebba lo mimmennu ki rav hu.

Veamro atta lecha kava – perush, nitkavven lavo betaana shehaddin im balak bedavar ze, shehagam shehakkadosh baruch hu natan leyisrael ammon umoav, adayin lo higgia zeman hannetina, vehaddin immo lehillachem bo ulegarsho. vehu amro atta – perush, bizman ze kava li lehillachem bo legarsho mealay. uchefi ze yesh taam beshinnuy tevat "atta", sheim haya omer "veatta" yihye nishma shehu hemshech ma shekkadam lo, vehu nitkavven letaanat hazzeman sheyyachol hu lehillachem immo bo. gam shinnuy "kava", ki en kavvanato shel balak sheyyearer haam setam, sheaz yimmashech hara laam ben beerech moav ben beerech haummot, ella yefaresh beferush bilam sheeno mearro ella beerech milchemet moav, sheyyihyu yisrael muchnaim vechulei lifne hammoavim. laze dikdek lomar kava li – perush, sheyyefaresh hakkelala shehi leerech moav. gam shinna bemaamaro "lehillachem bo" bimkom "nakke vo", lomar sheen chefetz laasot lo raa ella lehitgare immo bemilchama lemano meartzo. gam shinna veamar vegerashtiv, uvalak amar min haaretz. ulay balak nitkavven legarsho min [haaretz] hayyedua asher natan Adonai lahem, ki kesheyyachnio yiru mealot el haaretz. uvilam lechashvo lehametik ulehatim divre balak, ki eno mevakkesh ella hanaat atzmo uvetaana hannishmaat veeno meoyve yisrael, laze hishmit tevat "min haaretz" veamar "vegerashtiv" – perush, sheyyegarshennu mealav.

rashi: Higgid. hakkadosh baruch hu lecha adam ma tov lecha laasot.

Vehatzenea lechet. tirgem yonatan: "heve tzanua lemehach bedachala deelahach". davar acher: vehatzenea lechet, lo kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vadam, middat basar vadam adam mevayyesh et chavero uva lefayyeso veomer lo eni mitratztze lecha ad sheyyavo peloni ufeloni shebbizitani lifnehem, aval hakkadosh baruch hu en chafetz ella sheyyashuv elav beno leven atzmo.
targum: Hayechave lach enasha ma tav uma Adonai tava minach elahen lemebad din dikshot ulemircham gemilot chisda vahave tzenia lehalecha bidchalta deelahach:

rashi: Vehichratti susecha. hi ezrat mitzrayim sheattem nishanim alehem lehametziachem susim:
targum: Vihe veidana hahi amar Adonai veeshetze susevat ammaya mibbenach veoved retichehon:

rashi: Bamot baal. ketargumo, "leramat dachalteh", shem aza:
ohc: Vayhi vabboker vayyikkach balak vegomer vayyar vegomer. amro vayhi leshon tzaar, ulay sheasa meriva bilam im balak vetziaro bidvarim al miut habbasar sheshshalach kemo shekkatavti. veamro vayyikkach balak lekacho bidvarim, perush sheritztzahu al haddavar.

Od yirtze, lefi shehaya bilam chigger beraglo, uchefi tiviyyut haragil bechushe harekavat bene adam, adam kaze lo yitkonen bo regel hatztzolea lalechet babboker, uma gam laalot bamot. veulay ki laze nitkavven hakkatuv betevat vayhi – oy lo levilam, vetaam hatztzaar hu bishvil heyot haddavar babboker. ulefi shello haya yachol lalechet techef umiyyad, haya balak lokeach oto beyado usemacho lehaaloto, vehu amro "vayyikkach balak et bilam vayyaalehu bamot" vegomer:

Od nitkavven beamro babboker lehodiacha shennadda shenat eno shel balak, ki midderech hammelachim lihyot al mittotehen ad shalosh shaot, keamram zichronam livracha (berachot 9:), veze bihyot habboker amad velakach bilam vayyaalehu bamot vegomer.

Od taam babboker al derech ma sheamru bemassechet avoda zara (77 4:) veze leshonam: emat ka ratach? amar abbaye bitlat shae kammayta, ad kan, laze amar "vayhi vabboker", vedikdek lomar vayhi leshon tzaar, perush zeman she mitkaes al olamo shehu babboker lakach bilam shehaya baki bechiuun harega. od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 20,18) veze leshonam: "bamot baal" ze peor, ad kan leshonam. veyadua hu ki peor avodato hi haterazat zevel befanav, veze leshon divrehem zichronam livracha (sanhedrin sad.): bamme ovdim avoda zara shel peor? ochlin teradin veshotin shechar umatrizin befaneha, ad kan, hare sheavodat peor hi behaterazat hammeus, uletaam ze ratza balak lehaalot bilam lifor shehi bamot baal bizman haavoda shehi zeman hahafnaa sheadam ose tzerachav, vehu amro babboker vayyaalehu bamot baal, veulay ki bilam lo haya oved avoda zara zo ulekacho bidvarim leavdah.

Od nire taam babboker al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (Zohar parashat zo), sheamru shekkeshafav shel balak hayu betzippor, uchemo sheramaznu bemaamar "ben tzippor", laze bachar balak laamod babboker sheaz yetzaftzef hatztzippor kayyadua, veyaale beyadam keshafav ukesamav ki ze hu zemanno.

Uvaze nire latet taam lema sheyyesh litmoah bainyan, bema sheamar hakkatuv "vayyar mishsham ketze haam", vahalo amru razal (taanit 9.) shehaananim hayu mechassim al yisrael velo hayu nirim laayin, ucheshemmet aharon venistalleku haananim niglu laayin veyada hakkenaani moshavam venilcham immam, vechazru achar kach bizchuto shel moshe keamram zichrono livracha (sham). im ken yisrael hayu mechussim beanan, veech yomar hakkatuv "vayyar mishsham ketze haam", sheadrabba haya tzarich Adonai lehosif shemira al shemiratan leval tikkanes bahem ayin raa shel bilam. ella vadday ma sherau ketze haam hu al yede keshafim shehayu osim batztzippor hayyadua, vehu haya megalle otam, veyesh koach bammechashshefut laasot ken, keamram zichrono livracha (sanhedrin 67:) lamma nikreu mechashshefut vechulei, vehem gillu hammechusse beanan. vehodia hakkatuv shello gillu lahem ella ketze haam, lo pinnat hatztzaddikim ugedolehem:

rashi: Ara li yaakov ulecha zoama yisrael. bishne shemotehem amar lo lekallelam shemma echad mehem eno muvhak:
ohc: Vayyissa meshalo vegomer. perush, kesheraa shello tzivvahu Adonai shello ledabber, gam lo amar lo haddevarim sheyyomar, chashav shennittena lo reshut, velaze nasa meshalo, perush, lomar devarav shehaya chafetz, venitakkem piv uleshono ledabber devarim acherim, vehu amro vayyomar, perush yatzta mimmennu amira acheret haamura bainyan. od yirtze al ze hadderech shennasa hammashal shehaya muchan etzlo lomar, vehissio veamar hammaamar haamur bainyan. od yirtze al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 20,19) sheamru veze leshonam: "min aram" min haramim hayiti vehoridani balak liver shachat vechulei, ad kan, velaze amar vayyissa, perush herim kolo bemashal shello, shennaasa lemashal velishnina, shehaya min haramim veyarad kevodo.
