Od yitbaer al pi ma sheamru zichronam livracha beinyan perate haderagot hannevua, uchemo shekkatavti ketzat mehem befarashat behaalotcha (Bamidbar 12:6), ki yesh navi sheyyimat kocho lekabbel divre nevua beyosher, ad sheyyihyu bederech kal sheyyitlabbeshu bedivre meshalim kefi asher yuchal seet, veze afillu linvie yisrael, umizze neshaer levilam shetztzarich mashal linvuato, laze amar "vayyissa meshalo". vedikdek lomar vayyissa shehannevua hi kemassa lerov hahergesh asher taase, velaze tikkare massa.

Lecha ara li yaakov vegomer. perush, lefi sheyyesh beyisrael shete haderagot: geder hatztzaddikim vegeder habbenonim, uchevar katavnu lemala beferush shelichut balak sheamar "nakke bo vaagarshennu", leechad mehadderachim shennitkavven keneged habbenonim "nakke bo", ucheneged hatztzaddikim amar "vaagarshennu", ki yadua haya lahem hafelagat maalat hatztzaddikim shello tishlot bahem koach hattuma, vehu ma sheamar kan ara li yaakov – hem habbenonim leshon arira, zoama yisrael – hem hatztzaddikim hammitkannim yisrael. vehazzeima hi lematta mehaarira.

rashi: Allay li. hannavi mekonen al atzmo oy li shehoomadti lenavi baet hazzot sheen bene adam tzaddikim baddor.

Keaspe kayitz. nakud chataf kamatz sheeno leshon poel kemo 'yoshev omer ella leshon mifal kemo (Yeshayahu 33:4) "osef hechasil" kaasifat kayitz vehem sofe teenim shehen raot, vechen tirgem yonatan "kesiyyufe kayta".
Keollot batzir. tirgem yonatan: "keollan batar ketuf".
En eshkol leechol. ketargumo "let gevar deveh ovadin tavin".
Bikkura. teena tova hammitbashshelet beittah, ketargumo "letavya chamedat nafshi".
targum: Amar neviya vay li are haveti kemesaf tavaya beidan daavadu chasidaya min ara ha chisyufe kayta keollan batar ketof let gevar deveh ovadin tavin letavaya chamadat nafshi:

ohc: Meen bilam haloch immanu. chashaduhu beshakran vetalu haddavar bo shehu lo nitmalleu enav beshiur kavod ze, veulay ki lefi sheamar lahem sheyyeshivem davar techef sheyyedabber Adonai elav ballayla velo asa chen ad habboker, amru, en ze ki im divre atzmo. o efshar ki muchzak haya asher piv dibber shav vimino yemin vegomer:

rashi: Vayyissa vilam et enav. bikkesh lehachnis bahem ayin raa, vahare yesh lecha shalosh middotav — ayin raa veruach gevoha venefesh rechava haamurim lemala:
Shochen lishvatav. raa chol shevet veshevet shochen leatzmo veenan meoravin, raa sheen pitchehem mechuvvanin ze cheneged ze, shello yatzitz letoch ohel chavero:
Vattehi alav ruach elohim. ala velibbo shello yekallelem:
ohc: Vayyissa vilam vegomer. hutzrach lomar "vayyissa", gam hutzrach lehazekir shemo velo samach al zichrono besamuch, lefi ma shekkadam lanu sheyyisrael hayu mesubbavim baananim velo hayta ayin sholetet bahem, laze amar shennasa bilam vegomer, perush, nasa neviuto, ki hu haya nevi ummot haolam umachaze nevua yecheze, velaze dikdek lomar "bilam" lirmoz nesiut ayin sheenah bezulato ella bo, uvaze heir shebbemachaze hannevua hakkatuv medabber, uvaze hissig lirot yisrael shehayu nistarim beanne hakkavod.

Vayyar vegomer lishvatav vattehi alav vegomer. perush sheraa bahem shene inyanim gedolim: 1 – shochen kol shevet veshevet bifne atzmo, 2 – vattehi alav vegomer shehayta shora shechina al kol shevet bifne atzmo, malko berosho. vehattaam shekkol shevet yesh lo haderaga bifne atzmo, o letzad hazzechut sheyyesh leechad yoter mechavero, o lefi hamminyan. gam ramaz bekesher shene devarim al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (bava batra 60.) sheamru shebbeemtzaut shennisderu yisrael bederech ze kol shevet bifne atzmo, shachna alehem shechina venaasu merkava lah, vehu ma sheddikdek lomar vattehi alav ruach elohim:

rashi: El motzio mimmitzrayim. mi gorem lahem haggedulla hazzot? el hammotziam mimmitzrayim betokef verum shello, yochal et haggoyim shehem tzarav:
Veatzmotehem. shel tzarim:

Yegarem. menachem patar bo leshon shevira, vechen "lo garemu labboker" (Tzefanya 3), vechen "veet charaseha tegaremi" (Yechezkel 23), vaani omer leshon etzem hu, shemmegarer habbasar beshinnav missaviv, vehammoach shebbifnim, umaamid haetzem al armimuto:

Vechitztzav yimchatz. unkelos tirgem chetzyo shel tzarim — chalukka shellahem, kemo (Bereshit 49) "baale chitztzim" — mare palguta, vechen yimchatz leshon "umachatza vecholfa rakkato" (Shoftim 5) — sheyechetzu et artzam. veyesh liftor leshon chitztzim mammash — chitztzav shel hakkabbah yimchatz bedamam shel tzarim, yitbol veyitztabba bedamam, kemo "lemaan timchatz raglecha bedam" (Tehillim 68), veeno zaz millashon makka, kemo "machatzti" (Devarim 32), shehatztzavua bedam nire keillu machutz venagua:
ohc: El motzio mimmitzrayim vegomer. perush al derech amram zichronam livracha ki betzet yisrael mimmitzrayim berru kol nitzotze hakkedushsha shehayu biklippat mitzrayim. uchevar hikdamnu shettokef hakkedushsha hi keshemmevareret anafeha, vehu amro motzio vegomer, ketoafot reem lo perush laam, velaze gam ken ramaz bemaamar yochal goyim tzarav, shehaachila hi lehotzi nitzotz hakkedushsha shebbo vetihye nichlelet benefesh yisrael, besod (Mishlei 13:25) "tzaddik ochel lesova nafsho". veamro veatzmotehem perush, vaafillu bechina hammitatztzemet bahem yegarem otah.

Veamro vechitztzav yimchatz yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (tanchuma, beshallach 15) befasuk (Yeshayahu 24,21) "yifkod Adonai al tzeva" vegomer, sheen hakkadosh baruch hu meabbed umma lematta ad sheppoked al sar shellah lemala. vehinne keshehaumma nechleshet levad lo yovad hassar lemala ella yashpilennu Adonai, ucheshehaumma yeera lah kisdom vaamora az yovad sarah lemala, vehu amro vechitztzav perush koach maarachtam shehem chitztzim hallochamim baadam vehem hassarim, yimchatz al derech amro (tehillim 110,6) "machatz rosh al eretz rabba" sheyyeabbedu koach sarehem millemala. veim nefaresh "yimchatz" leshon tevila urechitza, yechavven lomar sheen zorkin chetz sheeno nitka bahem venitbal bedamam.

rashi: Lo hibbit aven beyaakov vegomer'. ketargumo; davar acher achare feshuto hu nidrash midrash nae —
Lo hibbit. hakkabbah aon shebbeyaakov — keshehen overin al devarav eno medakdek acharehem lehitbonen beoniyyot shellahem vaamalan shehen overin al dato:
Amal. leshon avera, kemo "vehara amal" (Tehillim 7), "ki atta amal vachaas tabbit" (Sham 10), lefi shehaavera hi amal lifne hammakom:
Adonai elohav immo. afillu machisin umamrim lefanav, eno zaz mittochan:
Uteruat melech bo. leshon chibba vereut, kemo (Shmuel 2 15) "ree david" — ohev david, (Shoftim 15) "vayyittenah lemereehu", vechen tirgem unkelos "ushechinat malkehon benehon":
ohc: Lo hibbit aven beyaakov. yitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (raya mehemana 11 275) sheamru ki al yede chet haadam nirsham roshem koach hara baevar shebbo asao, vehi bechinat happegam hammuzkeret bedivrehem zichronam livracha. uferush "aven" hu koach hara hannimshach mehaavera, al derech amro (Mishlei 30:20) "lo faalti aven", uchetiv (tehillim 125:5) "yolichem Adonai et poale haaven". velaze amar lo hibbit aven shehu roshem hammifal hara eno afillu beyaakov shehen hamon haam sheyyitkannu beshem yaakov, shekkullam nishmarim measot ra. vahagam sheyyitu midderech hassechel eno nikba benafsham haaven shehu chelek hara, al derech amro (Shir HaShirim 4:7) "kullach yafa umum en bach", perush sheen hachet ose bo mum kavua ella lichluch haover al yede rechitza vahadacha, uchemo sheramzu zichronam livracha (Shir HaShirim Rabba) bema sheamar hakkatuv "shechora ani venava" yeuyyan sham. veamro velo raa amal beyisrael, perush, afillu pegam shetztzarich amal lehaaviro eno beotam shennikraim yisrael shehem hatztzaddikim.

O yirtze amro lo hibbit aven hu chet hammachshava, sheggam hu yikkare aven, al derech amro (Tehillim 66:18) "aven im raiti velibbi", sheen Adonai mabbit el hammachshava haraa. beyaakov, perush, sheen ose beyaakov hammachshava haraa roshem haaven shehi anaf hara, velaze dikdek lomar leshon habbata shehi yoter mehariyya, perush ki hagam ki biriyya rishona hu roe machshava haraa, keshehu mabbit bifnimiyyut mifalah en aven. vedikdek lomar aven beyaakov, perush sheeno ose bo hachet hahu roshem, veze afillu bahamon haam asher beshem yaakov yechunne. ucheneged hatztzaddikim shebbahem amar velo raa, perush, afillu machshava bilti haguna hannikra amal sheamal immo yetzer hara bechoach hammachshava lehattotah midderech hassechel, vehatztzaddikim libbam chalal bekirbam, vehu amro velo raa amal beyisrael. gam nitkavven lomar shehatztzaddikim hagam sheosim mitzvot vechol iskam battora enam margishim sheyyesh lahem amal, al derech amro (Tehillim 73:16) "amal hu veenay", ella adrabba keadam hammarviach ucheadam hammishtashea beshaashuim lerov cheshkam battora. gam nitkavven al derech amro (Mishlei 8:14) "ani vina li gevura", ki keshehatztzaddikim oskim battora umatmidin bah en lahem amal beesek hattora, sheadrabba hi notenet lo gevura.

Od yirtze lomar, ki beemtzaut shete haderagot sheyyesh beyisrael en hakkadosh baruch hu makpid al resha shebbaolam mehaummot, uvaze eno meabbedam, gam eno yagea bivriat olamo uvinsiat ol lechol haddevarim hatztzerichin laolam. vehu amro lo hibbit aven sheyyesh baolam, bishvil yaakov, gam eno roe amal sheamal kivyachol bisvilat haolam uvimzonotav uvesippuk tzerachav, hakkol eno chash lo bishvil yisrael, vehu amro beyisrael – bishvil yisrael. vechen timtza sheim yisrael holchim bederech hattora vehammitzvot, Adonai noten tuvo laolam venizzonim venehenim gam haummot yachad. umeatta hammevakshim laakor umma zo mevakshim leabbed haolam veyoshvav. od nitkavven beamro "velo raa amal beyisrael" ki hatztzaddikim kol tziftzufam osim bo nachat ruach laAdonai veenam meyaggeim oto kivyachol, al derech amro (Malachi 2,17) "hogatem Adonai bedivrechem", velaze amar "velo raa amal beyisrael".

Adonai elohav immo uteruat melech bo. perush, keneged shete bechinot shehizkir, hannikraim beshem yaakov shehem hamon haam, vehammitkannim beshem yisrael shehem hatztzaddikim, Adonai elohav immo hem hatztzaddikim sheosim meahava, laze amar "Adonai" shehu shem hachesed, lomar sheen avodat hatztzaddik letzad haddin ella ohev hattov bema shehu tov. vedikdek lomar "elohav" shello tachshov sheim Adonai meyasserehu yashuv achor, laze amar "elohav", shehagam sheyyeyasserehu – al mishmeret ahavato yaamod. ucheneged kat hehamon hannikraim beshem yaakov amar: uteruat melech bo, shehu yare letzad hammishpat.

Od yirtze lomar shevach hassagatam, shello bachar Adonai leshakken shemo ella immam, veod sheasa bahem koach elyon sheyyecholin leabbed kol ma shennotnin bo enehem kemelech olam, vehu amro uteruat melech bo, perush en tzerichin she yeabbed kamehem ella bahem atzman yesh haderaga zo. vechen timtza shehatztzaddikim kol makom shennotnim bo enehem lehashechit bechol hannivraim hem baale hayyecholet:

Od yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (berachot 61:) al rabbi akiva shehayu sorkim besaro bemasrekot shel barzel vehaya maarich beechad vechulei, vehu amro Adonai elohav immo perush medabbek nafsho baAdonai elohav betachlit hachibba, hagam shetteruat melech bo, beshevet barzel shessorkin besaro, vaafillu bazzeman atzmo shehashshevet bo shehayu sorkim vechulei, af al pi chen Adonai elohav immo.

rashi: Vayyishtachavu lelohehen. keshettakaf yitzro veomer lah hishomi li, vehi motzia lo demut peor mechekah veomeret lo hishtachave laze:
ohc: Vattikrena laam. hutzrach lehazekir "haam" velo hispik lomar "vattikrena lahem", nitkavven lomar shekkaru leotam shello yatzu lashut meoholehem, halchu hem etzlam vekaru lahem. o yirtze, ki millevad ma shehayu holchim echad echad, hosifu likro lahem sheyyelchu bichnufeya lezivche elohehen vechulei:

Lezivche elohehen. vahagam sheamar (sanhedrin sad.) sheppeor en baavodato zevicha ella behaterazat hallichluch lemul panav, umin hassetam lo zavchu lo, ulay shehayu osim simcha bevasar lichvodo, o ulay shehayu osim ken kede leharebot bemaachalim lehateriz kenegdo beribbuy yetziat hattinnuf.
Vayyishtachavu vegomer vayyitztzamed. perush, zo sibbat hishtachavayayto shennitzmad vegomer. al derech amram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin sad.) shebbaal peor maanis ovdav.

rashi: Gam kov lo tikkovennu. gam rishon mosif al gam hasheni vegam hasheni al gam rishon, vechen "gam li gam lach lo yihye" (Melachim 1 3), vechen "gam bachur gam betula" (Devarim 32):
ohc: Gam kov lo tikkovennu. amar gam, vechafal lomar "kov tikkovennu", perush, lefi sheamar lo bilam "kum balak vegomer haazina" vegomer, vesham ramaz lo shehu chafetz lekallel umalach okem piv kemaamaram zichronam livracha (midrash Rabba Bamidbar kan), gam ken laze amar "gam kov", perush, millevad shello tekallelennu bechiuun, ella afillu lehotzi hakkelala mippicha belo zechirat shemam lo tikkovennu. mikkan shemmitchakkem haya bilam harasha lehotzi mippiv kelala bederech shello yaanishehu habbore, al ze hadderech sheyyomar "arur" o "mekullal" velo yotzi mippiv shem hammekullal vehammeorar, ella shebbelibbo yechavven lema sherotze, uletaam ze haya Adonai mono millehotzi mippiv kelala venechtema belibbo.

Veamro gam barech, lefi sheamar lo bilam sheeno mevarcham mertzono ella anus hu levarcham, laze amar lo: "im atta lo tekallel lo titchayyev levarech", vechashav shello yeakkem Adonai piv levarech ella im yirtze lekallel. vechafal lomar gam barech lo tevarachennu, perush afillu beracha sheenah kefi haemet beracha kefi daat bilam vechavvanato, af gam zot lo tevarchennu.

Vayyakam bilam vayyelech. perush, lo pana levet achsanyato ella halach techef umiyyad, vehutzrach lomar vayyelech vayyashav limkomo velo hispik lomar "vayyelech limkomo" lehaircha shehalach bekumo velo nitakkev, sheim haya omer "vayyakam vayyelech limkomo" hayta hakkavvana shemmodiacha shene devarim: 1 vayyakam, 2 vayyelech limkomo, veen yadua im bekumo halach. laze amar "vayyakam vayyelech" lehaircha shehalach bekumo, umodiacha od shechazar limkomo kaasher amar lo balak. veamro vegam balak halach vegomer, perush shello amad immo lelauoto bekumo millefanav.

Od efshar shebbalak gam hu lo amad od bemalchuto sham, lefi sheyyadu moav middivre bilam ki am bene yisrael lo yareu velo yashchitu lahem, im ken behibbatel hassibba yibbatel hamesubbav, veheemiduhu mimmeloch alehem, vehalach ledarko shebba bo lemidyan, veharaya sheshsham nimtza bemilchemet midyan veneherag (Bamidbar 31:8).

rashi: Bene ish. bene avraham yitzchak veyaakov hakkeruyim ish, beavraham neemar (Bereshit 20:7) "hashev et eshet haish", beyitzchak neemar (Bereshit 24:65) "mi haish hallaze", beyaakov neemar (Bereshit 25:27) "ish tam":

Ad me chevodi lichlimma. ad matay attem mevazzim oti? haritem et ben yishay (Shmuel 1 22:9), "mi david umi ven yishay" (Shmuel 1 25:10), "bichrat beni im ben yishay" (Shmuel 1 22:8), "ki vocher atta leven yishay" (Shmuel 1 20:30), en li shem?

Tevakshu chazav. tirdefu limtzo kezavim, kegon hazzifim shemmalshinim alay, veli hayu marim shalom, vechayyotze vahem dilatorin shehayu bime shaul: "halo david mistatter begivat hachachila" (Shmuel 1 23:19), vechen harebe:
targum: Bene nesha metul me aykari leitkenauta terachamin serikuta tivun kadivuta lealmin:

ohc: Lakov oyvay lekachticha vegomer. nitraem balak al habberacha, lefi shehagam sheamar lo bilam "hayachol uchal dabber" vegomer (Bamidbar 22:38), hevin shehakkavvana hi leinyan sheim lo yaskim Adonai alav lekallel lo yekallel, aval habberacha shev veal taase hi velo yevarech. vahagam sheamar lo gam ken "haddavar asher yasim elohim befi oto adabber", chashav shehu beinyan hakkelala, sheim Adonai yasim befiv lekallel aso yaase kechol avvat nafsho, aval im yasim befiv beracha yimna atzmo velo yevarech, ki eno mehammusar sheyyaase hezzek lemi sheshshalach acharav levarech oyvav sheen ze ella mekallel et balak. vehu ma sheddikdek betevat li sheamar me asita li, shebbirkat yisrael kelala hi lo.

Vehinne berachta varech. taam kefel haddavar, yitbaer behair od al balak shehu matmiah al bilam, gam alav yesh litmoah shehimtin levilam ad sheggamar birchotav velo hispik kappav kemo sheasa baacharona (Bamidbar 24:10) lemano millevarech od, umi yachush al ze yoter mimmennu. achen yodea haya balak ki bilam arom yarim lehitchakkem lekallel yisrael, velaze haya meshabbeach umevarech behafelaga lomar achareha hashshiflut ugenut ukelalot, vetimtza sheafillu bemin habberacha atzmah haya mitchakkem lomar min beracha shebbo kelala, kemo sheamru bemidrash yelammedenu (yalkut shemauni tasheaa) veze leshonam: "im sheharasha mekallesan bikkesh legannotan", yeuyyan sham divrehem. hare shehaya mitchakkem gam babberacha atzmah lekallelam, velachen haya balak mamtin levilam ma yomar battachlit, vechevan sheamad nitgalla ki ma shehaya mevarech leyisrael lo haya letachlit ra ella letachlit tov, vehu amro "berachta varech".

Od nire shehakepadat balak hayta al ma sheshshama mippi vilam shennitavva taava lihyot kamohu, ze yaggid ki ma shebberach haya millibbo ulevaracha yechavven, vehu amro berachta veasita otam beracha, sheamarta "utehi achariti kamohu", velaze dikdek lomar barech melo pum, shemmitbarchim acherim lihyot kemotam.

rashi: Kearye bevahamot yaar. kach yehi malkam shallit bakkol:
Veramas vetaraf. ramas hi derisat haari keshehu raev veochlo bimkomo, vetaraf hu keshennose et hatteref limonotav bishvil gurotav uleviotav:
targum: Vihe sheara deyaakov beammaya bego ammin sagiin kearya bivira vechuresha uchelayta beedre ana deim yaade veyirmos veyiktol velet di mesheziv:

rashi: Vekovno li. leshon tzivvuy, kallelehu li:
ohc: Vayyomer elav balak lecha na itti vegomer. amar tevat na, gam amar vekavno li belashon vaddait, yitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 100) sheamru sheraa sheyyisrael nifratzim sham sheshsham met moshe, ad kan, vehu lefi shello yada taam happirtza chashav shehappirtza tihye bahem, ulefi sheyyeduim hayu yisrael sheosim teshuva umevattelim haggezerot, miher lomar lecha na perush, maher atta sheani roe shehem mechuyyavim pirtza zo kodem sheyyaasu teshuva, vekavno li, hechlit havayat haddavar shettassigem killot rasha.

rashi: Ki heeliticha. af al pi sheasiti lecha kol hattova hazzot, lo heleticha baavoda gedola uvekarbanot gedolim.
Et moshe aharon umiryam. tirgem yonatan: "moshe lealfa mesorat dinin veaharon lechappara al amma umiryam leoraa lenashiya".
targum: Are asiktach meara demitzrayim umibbet avduta pariktach ushelachet kodamach telata neviyin moshe lealafa mesirat dinin aharon lechappara al ama umiryam leoraa linshaya:

rashi: Kol Adonai lair yikra. "kal neviyya da al karta" machrizin lahem teshuva.
Vetushiyya yire shemecha. vetushiyya kore lahem hannavi asher roe et shemecha, asher noten lev lehitbonen velirot derachecha. vetushiyya musav al mikra shellemala hemennu.

Shimu matte umi yeadah. hattu ozen veshimu matte happuranut asher tirde etchem shehanneviim matrim bachem, veshimu mi hu asher yied oto happuranut im yecholet beyado lekayyem ma sheggozer. veyonatan lo chen tirgem.
(Vetushiyya yire shemecha. mikkan shekkol mi sheomer bechol yom mikra hammitchil umesayyem kemo shemmitchil umesayyem shemo hattora matztzilo miggehinnom).
targum: Kal neviyaya dayya al karta machlan umalfaya dachalin lishma shema malka veshiltona ushear ama deara:

rashi: Lo telech immahem. amar lo im ken akallelem bimkomi, amar lo lo tar et ham, amar lo im ken avorchem, amar lo enam tzerichim levirchatecha, ki barok hu, mashal, omerim letzira lo midduvshech velo meuktzech (sham):
ohc: Vayyomer elohim el bilam. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar el bilam velo hispik beamro "vayyomer lo". od lamma hutzrach lomar lo telech lo taor. od lamma hutzrach lomar lo hattaam ki varuch hu. verazal amru (Bamidbar Rabba 20,9) veze leshonam: amar lo "akallelem bimkomi", amar lo "lo taor", amar lo "im ken avarchem", amar lo "ki varuch hu", ad kan.

Venire lefaresh hakkatuv lefi ma shepperashti bemaamar "mi haanashim" vegomer, shennitkavven lomar lo lamma hechshivam lehachenisam immo bechadro veheshivo ki balak vegomer, al ze hadderech ki meshivo Adonai al rishon rishon, lema sheheshiv "balak ben tzippor vegomer shalach elay" vehem sheluche melech, laze ba maamaro yitbarach "lo telech immahem", perush, enam reuyim lalechet hu immahem lefi erech maalato, vehodio ki balak zilzel bichvodo velo shalach lo sarim rabbim venichbadim, vehu ma shennitkavven bemaamar rishon mi haanashim leshon pechitut, lo mitztzad hameshalleach ella mitztzad hammishtalleach, vehu bilam lo hevin hakkavvana mittechilla. vetimtza shehevin bilam haddevarim veamar lassarim "meen Adonai letitti lahaloch immachem", vayyosef balak sheloach sarim rabbim venichbadim.

Vetaam shehechshivo Adonai veasa lo kavod ze, millevad hattaam shekkatavti lemala befasuk "mi haanashim" vegomer, nire od lomar taam baddavar ki Adonai natan lo secharo sheamar bitchillat teshuvato lezikne moav: "vahashivoti etchem davar kaasher yedabber Adonai elay", veyadua ki en hakkadosh baruch hu mekappeach sechar kol beriyya vaafillu shel ummot haolam, vetze ulemad (sanhedrin tzav.) ma shillem hakkadosh baruch hu linvuchadnetztzar al pesiotav vechulei, vegam kan shillem lo secharo vechibbedo veamar lo "lo telech immahem", veal pi haddevarim yityashshev al nachon ma sheddikdaknu amro "vayyomer Adonai el bilam" perush, maamar shennogea levilam lichvodo, "lo telech immahem", sheen ze kevodcha hagam shehayu baim likro lecha al davar sheyyesh lecha reshut laasoto. velaze dikdek lomar immahem, ucheneged ikkar hashshelichut amar "lo taor et haam".

Veamar lo taor, velo lakach lashon atzmo sheamar bilam "kava li", lehodio ki yada gam leshon hashshelichut sheshshalach balak uleshon ara amar, vaakatzo levilam beremez ze sheyyada sheshshinna bilshono.

Veamar ki varuch hu, shello yavin sheshshene hammaamarim sheamar Adonai elav "lo telech" velo taor" taam echad lahem, vehu mishshum kevodo shel bilam, kemo sheddiyyaknu meamro "el bilam" umeamro tevat "immahem", uchefi ze kesheyyihyu sarim rabbim venichbadim yaase retzon balak veyelech veyaor, laze amar ki varuch, perush, ze hu taam maamar "lo taor". uleinyan hahalicha immahem hu sheyyeshno letaam hakepadat kevodo shel bilam.

Od nire lefaresh hakkatuv al ze hadderech, lefi sheyyada Adonai ki bilam chafetz resha hu ulevassof yelech, kemo shekken haya shehiskim Adonai ushelacho kaasher avaer hattaam bimkomo beezrat Adonai, laze amar lo Adonai lo telech immahem, perush "immahem" shehechlit lo hahalicha, veim haya omer lo "lo telech" en od metziut lachzor velomar lo "kum lech".
Vedikdek lomar el bilam, nitkavven latet taam haddavar, bishvil machshevet bilam sheratza lelech, laze hu shello hechlit lo hahalicha, vedikdek lomar immahem.

Veamro lo taor vegomer ki varuch hu, nitkavven baze lehashiv al ma sheddikdek bilam bidvarav veamar "atta lecha kava" vegomer, kefi ma shepperashti shennitkavven lomar shettaanat moav taana sheadayin lo higgia zeman zechiyyatam bemoav atta. laze amar lo taor vegomer, veim tomar vahalo lo higgia zeman zechiyyatam bemoav, "ki varuch hu" – en baruch ella tzaddik, ki hatztzidkut hu mekor habberachot. vehakkavvana baze sheal yachshedem beresha ki vadday shello yikkansu begeder sheadayin lo higgiam. uvachar lechannot hatztzaddik levaruch shennitkavven lichlol gam ken ma shepperashnu badderech harishon.

rashi: Mi mana afar yaakov vegomer'. ketargumo "dadekayya devet yaakov", mearba mashiryata — mearbaa degalim; daa, afar yaakov, en cheshbon bammitzvot shehem mekayyemin beafar, "lo tacharosh beshor uvachamor" (Devarim 22), "lo tizra kilayim" (Vayikra 19), efer para vaafar sota vechayyotze vahem (tanchuma):
Umispar et rova yisrael. reviotehen, zera hayyotze min hattashmish shellahem (80' Nidda 31):
Tamot nafshi mot yesharim. shebbahem:
ohc: Mi mana afar yaakov vegomer. hinne lefi sheharasha haya mitchakkem bedato umevakkesh eze ofen lehara leyisrael, kemo sheamar shechippes bahem uvaavotehem likkanes derech sham, bikkesh gam ken anaf acher shehu meyuchad lakkelippa shettishlot bo vetaase roshem, vehu inyan hammispar, keamram zichronam livracha (bava metzia 42.): en habberacha shora lo bedavar hammanuy vechulei, veratza harasha lehachenis ayin hara bammispar velo matza, veamar "mi mana afar" shennimshelu lo dichtiv (Bereshit 13,16) "kaafar haaretz", uveracha zo hagam shenneemra leavraham lo nitkayyema ella beyaakov, velaze amar "afar yaakov".
Od nitkavven lomar shello higgia adam limnotam, afillu kesherotzim limnot atzman tzivva Adonai shello lifkod ella al yede davar acher bishkalim o bitlaim.

Veamro umispar et rova yisrael, lema shehikdamnu sheyyedabber bishte haderagot: bahamon haam sheyyitkannu beshem yaakov, uvatztzaddikim asher beshem yisrael yitkannu. laze amar keneged hehamon mi mana afar yaakov, ucheneged hatztzaddikim amar umispar et rova yisrael, perush sheyyesh bahem tzaddikim leen mispar. veteda shehatztzaddikim hagam sheyyihyu muatim yafligu bemisparam, veharshaim behefech, hagam sheyyihyu rabbim misparam muat, keamram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 26.) sheamar Adonai lechizkiyyahu kesheamar lefanav "rabbim asher et shevna" vegomer, amar lo: "en minyan larshaim". vedikdek lomar "rova" lefi shehatztzaddikim hem revutzim beoholehem, dichtiv beyissashochar (Bereshit 49:14) "rovetz ben hammishpetayim", gam lefi shehashshechina rovaat alehem, gam yesh sod baddavar shehem yesovvu yichud veziuug haolamot.

Od ramaz al ma shehaya Adonai mafli immahem bemitzrayim, kesheggazru "kol habben hayyillod" vegomer, shehayu monim lammeubbarot millayla rishona shehayta haishsha hayyehudit tovelet, velo hayu moilim, shehaya Adonai ose niflaot lahem leen mispar, kemo shemmefuzzarim haddevarim bemaamaram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 23, sota 11:), velo hayu yecholin laamod al reviotehem, vehu amro "umispar et rova yisrael".

Tamot nafshi mot yesharim. ellu divre atzmo velo divre ruach hakkodesh, uchevar amru zichronam livracha (yalkut shemauni tashesach) ki keshehaya rotze ledabber devarim sheen hezzek leyisrael haya Adonai mannicho ledabber asher yachpotz. veamar mot yesharim velo amar kemotam shechozer al yisrael, hiflig rasha lishol inyan gadol, sheamru zichronam livracha anshe emet (Zohar chelek 1 122:) sheyyesh shete haderagot batztzaddikim bishat mitatam, haachat sheyyotzet hannefesh min hagguf veholechet been masach mavdil been meakkev ad mekom haosher haelyon, veyesh tzaddikim shebbitziat hannefesh lo yassigu geder ze, venimnaim millechet techef umiyyad umitakkevim ad zeman ma im yihye lahem eze chataim vechaddome, vaafillu chet kol shehu yesovev haddavar. velaze bachar bilam lishol geder haelyon, shennafsho bishat mita tihye kemitat otam sheholchim beyosher et panav yitbarach been masach been meakkev.
Od efshar sheddevarav gam baze beruach hakkodesh neemru, vehakkavvana bahem hi "tamot nafsho mot" beyad "yesharim", sheyyaharguhu yisrael, kemo shekken haya.

Od yirtze, shebbehaggio leyom hammita yetiv derachav mimmaasav haraim vetoavotav, ki rasha shebbaummot haya, vaatono shehayta lo sochenet kemaamaram zichronam livracha (avoda zara 4:) taggid alav, ella shennitavva shebbishat mita yashuv veyihye yashar kayyesharim shebbaummot. ulefi sheamad al mizgo vehinne hu ra betachlit hara venimna mimmennu asot yosher, laze shaal davar sheyyachol lihyot shebbishat dichduchah shel mavet yihye yashar. vechayyotze baze raiti reshaim sheamru li beferush ki im hayu yodim sheyyachzeru bitshuva vetechef yamutu hayu osim, ella sheyyodim sheenam yecholim laamod bitshuva zeman aroch, ki devar melech alehem, melech zaken uchesil, rachamana litztzelan. velo shaal harasha sheyyamut kemitat hatztzaddikim shebbeyisrael, ki hu min hannimna sheyyaggia lehassaga zo.

Utehi achariti kamohu. chozer el haam, amar ze keneged olam habba shehu acharit haolam. veteda she maamid baddin gam latztzaddikim mi shehu rauy laosher hahu hannelam mehammussag lannefesh achar mita, laze hitpallel al shete hahadragot.

Od lefi ma shepperashnu bechavvanat maamar "mot yesharim" sheyyaharguhu yisrael, yitbaer maamar utehi achariti vegomer, al pi ma shekkadam lanu mimmaamre anshe emet sheen lecha kelippa baolam sheen bah nitzotz mehakkedushsha, sod hammechayye otah. uchevar heerachti beinyan ze bechamma mekomot uvefarashat shelach lecha befasuk "ki lachmenu hem" vegomer (Bamidbar 14:9). veoto nitzotz keshebbealav neherag al yede yisrael mitbarer hannitzotz hahu hattov, velifamim yidbak bo im hu naki belo pesolet. vehu maamar tamot nafshi mot yesharim, uvaze tihye achariti kamohu, ki hannitzotz yidbak beish yisrael vahare hu kamohu. umatzinu bedivre hammekubbalim (sefer haggilgulim 283) ki nafsho shel bilam baa bachamoro shel rabbi pinchas ben yair, veze yore shennitkan beacharito. vahagam shemmet al yede yisrael, haya hannitzotz meshukkatz vehutzrach lehitlabben begilgulim velibbunim, veamad ad shebba laatono shel rabbi pinchas ben yair umishsham ala limkomo harishon:

Halo et asher vegomer eshmor vegomer. perush, lo kemo sheatta choshev sheen alay chiyyuv kesheyyavo haddibbur meAdonai levarech veestom pi velo adabber, lo chen hu, ella hare hu mutre leval yishtok. velaze dikdek leshon shemira al derech amram zichronam livracha (shavuot lo.) kol hishshamer pen veal eno ella lo taase, shehu muzhar leval yiddom veim yaavor chayyav mita. vezulat maamar eshmor lo haya nishma, umeatta anus hu. verabbotenu zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 100) amru sheamar lo ulevay shehaya met velo mevarech yisrael, hare shekkol ma shehaya mevarech anus haya velo millibbo.

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (yalkut shemauni), tas shel barzel haya omed befiv, im haya rotze lekallel haya mono, levarech – yachol, vehu amro oto eshmor kede sheuchal ledabber, shezzulat ze haya mitallem.

O efshar shennitkavven lomar lo ki hu meyachel umetzappe lasum Adonai devaro befiv ledabber, vehu amro asher yasim Adonai befi oto eshmor, perush meyachel umetzappe ledabber, ki yitom taam gadol asher eno keday hu vechol mishpechot haummot, kayyadua kamma arev lannefesh taam hakkoach hakkadosh asher millato al leshono, vahagam sheasa Adonai befiv davar uferashnu leval yiggeu haddevarim befe chazir, af al pi chen yitom taam ben noten taam veyeerav lo.

rashi: Tara leummim. hareota leshiva ummot gedolot veshillachtam mippanenu, veatta beyadcha kochacha horashtam mittoch artzam vattittaem laavotenu betochah:
targum: Ant bida digvuretach amaya kenaanae tarechta unetzavtinun levet yisrael bearahon tabbarta amaya ufesadtinun:

rashi: El motziam mimmitzrayim. atta amarta "hinne am yatza mimmitzrayim", lo yatza meatzmo, ella haelohim hotziam:

Ketoafot reem lo. ketokef rum vegovah shello, vechen "vechesef toafot" (Iyov 22) leshon maoz hemma, veomer ani shehu leshon "veof yeofef" (Bereshit 1) — hamofef berum vegovah, tokef rav hu ze, vetoafot reem — afifat govah; daa, toafot reem — tokef reemim, veameru rabbotenu ellu hashedim (80' Gittin 68):
ohc: El motziam mimmitzrayim. amar motziam velo hotziam, hagam sherazal amru (berachot lach.) deappek mashma vehochichu mikkan, af al pi chen yoter mashma leshon avar im haya omer hotziam. venire al derech amram zichrono livracha (fesachim 116:) bechol dor vador chayyav adam lirot et atzmo keillu hu yatza mimmitzrayim, al ken amru yode penimiyyut hattora ki chol lel pesach mitbarrim kochot hakkedushsha mehakkelippa venosafim beam bene yisrael, vehi habbechina atzmah shel yetziat mitzrayim. vehu amro el motziam ki lo yetzia rishona levad ella bechol shana veshana motziam kannizkar. venatan taam ketoafot reem lo, perush, ki Adonai mosif umechazzek otam lerommam, veen ketz larommut asher chashav Adonai alehem ad geder shello yishshaer shum taarovet hara bakkedushsha, vehu amro ki lo nachash beyaakov remez livchinat hannichush, gam livchinat hannikret nachash shehu rosh hakkelippa 100 harasha hannikra nachash teaker velo yishshaer mimmennu beyaakov, al derech amro (Zecharya 13:2) "veet ruach hattuma aavir min haaretz". "velo kesem" – hu bechinat tuma lematta mimmenna, veaz yihyu yisrael begeder shelemut hammaala vetihye maalatam yoter min hammalachim, vehu ma sheggamar omer kaet yeamer leyaakov vegomer veamru razal (Bamidbar Rabba 20,20) shehammalachim yishalu leyisrael "ma paal el".

rashi: Veshillumat. killayon, velamma?
targum: Lechod beaynach tehe mistakkal vehech mitgamrin rashie techeme:

ohc: Al na timmana vegomer. perush, lefi ma sheamru sheluchim harishonim ki daat atzmo hu meniat halichato immahem, laze amru lo sheyyitratztze beshiur kavod ze velo yimmana vegomer, vehu lefi shechaser lo yediat hachashad shechashaduhu shehem divre atzmo velo divre Adonai, chashav shennitkavven lomar lo shello yachush ledivre Adonai veyelech belo retzono, laze heshiv im yitten li valak vegomer lo uchal, perush hagam sheani etratztze laasot ki techunat rasha hayta lo veeved mored baadono, aval eno baal bechira veratzon bedavar ze.

rashi: Veyishtammer chukkot amri. veyadati ki lo tishmeu elay ki yishtammer al yedechem uvenechem kol chukkot amri veachav.
Vecherpat ammi tissau. attem tekabbelun avon hacherpa shehaovde kochavim umazzalot mecharfin et ammi sheheida bahem tora al kach (Devarim 25:14) "lo yihye lecha efa veefa" vehem enam shomrim.
targum: Veal di netartun gezirat bet amri vaavadtun ovade bet achav vehalachtun benimosehon bedil lemimsar yatach letzadu veyatvaa leishtemamu vachaside ami tekabbelun:

rashi: Me asiti lecha. ten libbecha lehakkir ma tov asiti lecha.
Uma heleticha. baavodati.
Ane vi. haed bi.
targum: Ami ma tava amaret lemebad lach vela avedat o meroa kashya asgeti alach ashed bi:

rashi: Hinne varech lakochti. atta shoaleni "ma dibber Adonai?", kibbalti mimmennu levarech otam:
Uverech velo ashivenna. hu berech otam vaani lo ashiv et birchato:

Uverech. kemo uvirech, vechen hi gizrat resh, kemo (Tehillim 74) "oyev cheref" kemo chiref, vechen (Sham 40) "uvotzea berech" — hamhallel umevarech et haggozel veomer al tira ki lo teanesh, shalom yihye lecha, margiz hu lehakkabbah; veen lomar barak shem davar, sheim ken haya nakud befattach katan vetamo lemala, aval lefi shehu leshon piel, hu nakud kamatz katan vetamo lematta:
ohc: Hinne varech lakachti uverech vegomer. lefi ma shepperashnu befasuk (Bamidbar 23:5) "vayyasem Adonai davar befi vilam" sheasa befiv davar ruchani sheyyafsik ben piv leruach hakkodesh hammedabberet, vehu ma shekkivvenu razal bemaamaram (yalkut shemauni) davar – malach. ella shehem natnu taam haddavar kede lemano millekallel ushene hatteamim tzodkim, uchefi ze nitkavven bemaamar hinne barech lakachti shehirgish bema shennittosef befiv uvilshono sheyyikra barech. veod "uverech" ki lo sam haddavar befiv venishar haddavar lirtzono shel bilam ella "uverech", perush, machricho levarech, vahagam shehu eno chafetz ulehashivah eno yachol, vehu amro velo ashivenna perush eno yachol lehachezirah.

rashi: Hecheleti hakkotecha. heenashti makkotecha chazakot vecholot vaanushot.
Hashemem. lehashemimcha al chattotecha.
targum: Veaf ana ayteti alach mera umecha atzdinach al dachatata:

rashi: Kum balak. kevan sheraahu metzachek bo, nitkavven letzaaro — "amod al raglecha, enecha rashay leshev, vaani shaluach elecha vishlichuto shel makom" (sham):
Beno tzippor. leshon mikra hu ze, kemo "chayto yaar" (Tehillim 50) "vechayto eretz" (Bereshit 1), "lemayeno mayim" (Tehillim 114):
ohc: Kum balak vegomer. kima zo lamma? verabbotenu zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 20,20) amru lefi shehaya balak metzachek bevilam sheeno birshut atzmo, laze nitkavven lehakenito veamar lo kum ushema. uledivrehem tzarich ladaat lamma amar "ushama" betosefet vav. veulay shennitkavven lomar lo sheyyatchil lishmoa mishsheat kima, vehu amro kum ushama.

O yirtze, lefi sheamar Adonai levilam "shuv el balak" vegomer shehizkiko lomar haddevarim lifne balak, laze im haya omer "kum balak shema" yihye nishma shertzono lomar sheyyakum lishmoa kede sheyyishma meomed, aval en chiyyuv bashshemia, im lo yirtze lishmoa yifne veyelech lo. laze amar "ushama" – chiyyuv bakkima vechiyyuv bashshemia.

Od yechavven lomar lo shekkima hi lo shezzacha lishmoa devarim habbaim mimmakom gavoah, veheiro od lehattot azno adav lehaazin kol dikduke haddevarim, uvaze atta yoter bemadrega meoto sheatta machshivo leav, shehu tzippor hakkeshafim, dichtiv "ben tzippor", meatta hu bincha, vehu amro "beno tzippor".

Od yitbaer hakkatuv lefi ma shehikdamnu ki rasha ze hayu bo shene devarim raim: haechad shehaya rotze lekallel yisrael vehaya tzarich sheyyavo malach leakkem piv kaamur, vehashsheni shehabberacha atzmah shehayta yotza mippiv haya mechavven bah lignay, vehaya tzorech leruach hakkodesh lefarshah leshevach, kemo shekkatavnu lemala. ulefi shechashad balak levilam shehu chafetz levarech et yisrael, bitchillat devarav amar levalak sheyyakum al amdo lehitbonen bishne peratim kede shello yachshedennu, veze rishona keneged ma shehaya omer bevirchato devarim sheenam kol kach meforashim letova vehayta ruach hakkodesh mefarashtam livracha shelema, vehu amro ushama betosefet vav lirmoz shemia acheret, ucheneged ma shehaya rotze lekallel vehammalach okem piv amar haazina aday, perush, sheyyitkarev beyoter adav veyaskil baakimat sefatav, shemmitakkemin mimmivta asher yevatte bisfatav, uvaze heiro ki anus haya velo yachshedo kimvarech oyvav.

rashi: Vayyar bilam ki tov vegomer'. amar eni tzarich livdok od behakkabbah, ki lo yachpotz lekallelam:
Lo halach kefaam befaam. kaasher asa shette feamim:
Likrat nechashim. lenachesh ulay yikkare Adonai likrato kirtzono, amar rotze velo rotze lekallelam, azkir avonotehem, vehakkelala al hazkarat avonotehem tachul:
Vayyashet el hammidbar panav. ketargumo:
ohc: Vayyar bilam ki tov vegomer. uledivrehem zichronam livracha (midrash Rabba) sheamru beferush pasuk "ki varuch hu" sheamar Adonai levilam lo tevarchem, nitkavven lomar al ze hadderech: "tov beene Adonai levarech" – perush, Adonai shehizkir besamuch veeno chozer al bilam, ki kevar amar lo Adonai "ki varuch hu" veeno tzarich levarcham. vahagam shemmatzinu shehaya mevarcham, ze haya lehappech killato livracha. ulefi ma shepperashti befasuk (Bamidbar 23:5) "vayyasem Adonai davar befi vilam" – lo bilam haya mevarech ella malach haya mevarcham befiv behefsek davar lefiv. veamro velo halach kefaam vegomer – perush hechlit sheen tikva meAdonai lehasekim lehara leyisrael, gam lo halach kefaam vegomer mishshum sheen tochelet mehannechashim. laze nitchakkem beetza raa, vehu vayyashet el hammidbar panav – perush, lirot ma shehichisu bammidbar, ulay derech sham yuchal lekallel.

O yitbaer leshon dibbur, kederech shepperesh bazzohar (chelek 3 205:) befasuk "avinu met bammidbar" (Bamidbar 27:3) leshon dibbur, vehakkavvana lefi shekkol haeser nisyonot shennissu yisrael et hammakom hayu bedibbur: al yam suf, baegel, bammitonnim, bammeraggelim, baadat korach, me meriva vechulei, kullam hayu chotim bedibbur, vechashav ki bichlalut yisrael shehayu leneged panav yimmatzun rabbim mikkittot hammedabberim vederech sham yekallel.

Od yirtze al pi divrehem zichrono livracha (Zohar chodesh 2 157.) sheamru ki hammidbar hu mekom chanot 100 harasha, venitkavven leorer kochotav, vehu amro "vayyashet el hammidbar panav" sheshsham hu rosh hakkelippa 100 vechelotav sone am bene yisrael. vedikdek lomar panav, ulay shettitorer hakkelippa beemtzaut hakkaas kederech shettitorer hakkedushsha besimcha uvelev tov, ki chol echad yitorer lemino, vehu amro "panav" leshon kaas, al derech amro (Shemot 33:14) "panay yelechu" shehu leshon kaas:

O efshar lefaresh hakkatuv al ze hadderech: vayyar bilam ki mi shehu tov hu beene Adonai rauy levarech yisrael, al derech amro (Mishlei 22:9) "tov ayin hu yevorach", veamru zichronam livracha (sota lach:) al tikre yevorach ella yevarech. vehakkavvana baze ki hu lihyoto ra ayin kayyadua lo netano Adonai levarech, karamuz bemaamar "ki varuch hu". umizze hirgish ki nifsal lihyoto ra ayin, vehammevarech hu hammalach shemmedabber befiv. laze chashav shello yelech kefaam befaam likrat nechashim shehu chelek hara. vayyashet el hammidbar perush asher hu chone sham haelohim mekom machane shechina, umarad beshoresh nishmato vechashav shebbaze yuchshar lihyot tov vivarech et yisrael. vehodia hakkatuv ki lo asa ze mertzono umillibbo ella lefanim hu sheasa et haddavar hazze, shechashav lerammot bochen levavot. veulay sheddato hayta ad sheyyaamin bo hammalach lehasir chakka mippiv ledabber kecheftzo, veaz yachshov machashavot lehitchakkem beseder habberacha atzmah lehara, kemo shekken asa, keamram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 105:) beferush amro "kinchalim vegomer kaahalim" vegomer, vehayta ruach hakkodesh mevattelet machshavto veomeret: "lo kemo sheatta choshev" vegomer.

rashi: El hakkubba. el haohel:
El kovatah. kemo "vehallechayayim vehakkeva" (Devarim 18), kivven betoch zachrut shel zimri venakvut shellah verau chullam shelo lechinnam haragam, veharbe nissim naasu lo 26', kidita hatam:
ohc: Vayyidkor et shenehem vegomer. kashe, bishlama dekirat ish yisrael kemishpat hahalacha shekkannaim pogim bo, aval haishsha enah chayyevet mita veenah metzuvva, veim al chashashat heyotah eshet ish lo hayta nehereget al hassafek. veefshar sheddan bah mishpat habbehema, dichtiv (Vayikra 20:15-16) "veet habbehema taharogu", uchetiv (Yechezkel 23:20) "asher besar chamorim besaram".

Veim tomar, lamma lo hargu yisrael hammidyanit mikkodem, kevan shehayu meam shello nitztauu alehem? veefshar lefi sheadayin lo shalchu lahem yisrael keriat shalom (Devarim 20:10), vahagam shellevassof gam ken lo shalchu lahem, ze haya achar maase ki tzivva Adonai "tzaror" vegomer (Bamidbar 25:17). o ulay shello hayu makkirim otah vechashvu ki hi moavit velo midyanit, shehare lo hayu regilim etzlam lehakkiram, o haya malbusham kemalbush moav. veamro "hammidyanit", hu divre hakkatuv.
Chassalat parashat balak

rashi: Lo teunne. lo tikre, vechen "vehaelohim inna leyado" (Shemot 21:13):
targum: Ativ mare alma vechen amar la teara lach bishta umachtasha umazikaya la yikrevun bemashkenayich:

ohc: Vayyosef od. perush, sheshshalach et harishonim vehosif alehem acherim, vehu ma sheddikdek gam ken bemaamar meelle velo amar mehem, lomar ki odam min hammuva bashshelichut im hannosafim alehem, venitkavven baze shello yachchish et dibburo harishon shettala haddavar bifchitut hashsheluchim shehem yochichuhu al panav.

Od nitkavven bemaamar vayyosef, shehosif al minyan rishon, sheim harishonim hayu shelosha, shalach beminyan sheni arbaa veyoter. veze eno nishma im haya omer "vayyishlach od sarim rabbim" vegomer, shehayiti omer sheomer "rabbim" leval tachshov sheshshalach muatim mimminyan rishon. veamro meelle chozer letevat "nichbadim", laze amar "vayyosef".

rashi: Kinchalim nittayu. shenneerchu venimshechu lintot lemerachok; ameru rabbotenu mibbirchotav shel oto rasha anu lemedim me haya velibbo lekallelam kesheamar lehashit el hammidbar panav, ucheshehafach hammakom et piv, berecham meen otam kelalot shebbikkesh lomar 26', kidita vechelek (Sanhedrin Kh 2):
Kaahalim. ketargumo, leshon "mor vaahalot" (Tehillim 45):
Nata Adonai. began eden; lashon acher kahalim nata Adonai — kashamayim hammetuchin keohel:
Nata Adonai. leshon netia matzinu veohalim, shenneemar "veyitta ohole appadno" (Daniel 11):
ohc: Kinchalim nittayu vegomer. razal (sanhedrin 105:) darshu baze harebe derashot. veefshar lefaresh hakkatuv al ze hadderech, shehakkatuv medabber keneged arba kittot hatztzaddikim shebbeam Adonai. 1 hu kishmuel hannavi, shehaya mesabbev kol eretz yisrael lelammed yisrael tora umitzvot bechol shana veshana, keamram zichronam livracha (shabbat 56.). 2 kat hatztzaddikim hakkevuim letalmud tora, lilmod ulelammed ulehorot mishpat, vehi kat haomedet belishkat haggazit haoseket battora uvahoraa kayyadua, vehi baggeder harishon atzmo, ella shehammevakkesh Adonai yavo alehem, mosif alehem shemuel shehu haya mesabbev lehorotam. 3 kat hallomedet tora lishmah leatzmah lehasekil ulehavin imre noam, yetera aleha kat harishona shellomedet umelammedet. 4 hi kat hammachzika yede hallomdim veyotzim limlachtam limtzo teref adam.

Ucheneged arba kittot amar arbaa dimyonim: keneged kitto shel shemuel amar kinchalim nittayu shehem osim kannachal hazze shennotel memav mimmakom lemakom lishtot mimmennu, kemo chen kat zo shettorchin beatzman lehashekot tzame lemayim chayyim. ucheneged kat sheniyya amar kegannot ale nahar, kaggan hazze shehu natua vechol harotze lehanot yavo veyehane, gam molichim perot mimmennu vezanim harchokim, kemo chen hem kat netua belishkat haggazit vechol harotze lehanot yavo veyehane, gam perotehem holchim lemerachok, shehabbaim lesham mitchakkemin mehem veyotzim lehashekot tzemee tora, vechen ketiv (Yeshayahu 2:3) "ki mitztziyyon tetze tora" vegomer. ucheneged kat hashshelishit hallomdin leatzman veen bahem koach lehashepia lazzulat amar kaahalim nata Adonai, keyaakov ish tam yoshev ohalim lilmod leatzmo. veamar leshon netia kannetia hazzot shekkol shehi mityashshenet mosif sharashim vaachiza binikatah, kemo chen lomde tora kol zeman shemmaarich beesek hattora tosif lehishtaresh nafsho bah. ucheneged kat harviit amar kaarazim ale mayim, arazim remez laashire am, baale koma baale koach ugevura baolam hazze, aval en osim perot battora lefi sheenam lomdim battora.

Uchevar katavti bechamma mekomot ki peri hattora hu levaddo yikkare peri. veayyen ma shepperesh bazzohar (chelek 3 202.) befasuk "lo tashchit et etzah vegomer mimmennu tochel" vegomer (Devarim 20:19), shehakkatuv romez levaal tora shehu ose peri vechulei yeuyyan sham. veamar ale mayim shechazkam gam ken hu ale mayim shehi hattora, lefi shemmachzikim yede haanashim hallomdim battora shennimshela lemayim veyehanu mehammayim atzmam, ki hammachzik yede lomde tora cholek immahem sachar kayyadua. vehakkavvana bechol hammaamar lomar shekkol yisrael omdim beshoresh hakkedushsha, zot hattora, vaafillu haoskim beinyan olam hazze.

rashi: Vattere haaton. vehu lo raa shennatan hakkabbah reshut labbehema lirot yoter min haadam, shemmittoch sheyyesh bo daat, tittaref dato kesheyyire mazzikin:

Vecharbo shelufa beyado. amar, rasha ze hinniach keli ummanuto, shekkeli zenan shel ummot haolam bacherev, vehu va alehem befiv shehu ummanut shellahem, af ani etpos et shello veavo alav beummanuto, vechen sofo — "veet bilam ben beor haregu vecharev" (Bamidbar 31):
ohc: Vattere haaton vegomer. tzarich ladaat kavvanat Adonai beinyan ze shennitgalla hammalach lehaaton, gam behaamadat hammalach shalosh peamim bishlosha mekomot, uvilchitzat ragle bilam, uvirvitzatah, gam biftichat pe haaton, vechol maase haamur bainyan hu inyan satum.

Venire ki kol kavvanat Adonai beinyan ze lo hayta ella lehashepil gaavato shel bazuy ze, lefi shekkadam venahag gavhut lifne Adonai kemo shekkatavnu lemala shello amar lassarim ki hu holech birshut Adonai ella keadam haomed birshut atzmo, laze bikkesh lo Adonai hashepala sheen lematta mimmenna vesachak bo bekalon mechoar umeshunne. vedavar yadua hu ki haharkava hachiyyunit asher hirkiv Adonai bevaale chayyim bilti medabberim hi meshunna meharekava hachiyyunit sheppaal Adonai veasa bevaale chayyim hammedabberim, velaze kesheratza Adonai shettiftach haaton et piha ledabber kevaale chayyim hammedabberim hutzrach leharekiv bah harekava hachiyyunit shel baale chayyim hammedabberim, vehu ma sheppaal Adonai bemaase haamadat hammalach bishlosha mekomot uviriyyat haaton hammalach shalosh peamim, ki koach hammedabber tzarich shalosh hachanot kodmot lo, vehem koach hatztzomeach shehu bechol hannivraim, vechoach hammenia, veachar kach koach hammedabber. laze amad paam rishona veraata haaton oto ufaal bah bechoach reut haruchani koach echad mimmin harekavat koach hatztzomeach shebbo yitkabbel koach hammedabber, veamad paam sheniyya veraata oto ufaal bah koach hammenia hammitkabbel bo koach hammedabber, uvefaam shelishit paal bah koach hammedabber, veaz patach Adonai et piha vedibbera divre havana bederech shoel umeshiv, vehichlima et bilam bederech bizzuy bifne nearav vechulei, uvizzuy sheyyihye bederech ze yesh lo kol, lihyoto davar tamuah bishne ofanim, ofen echad shettedabber habbehema, vehashsheni sheadam gadol kevilam hayta lo atono leishsha shochevet cheko.

Venishar ladaat lamma amad hammalach bishlosha mekomot shonot, veyachol haya lehitraot lah shalosh peamim bemakom echad. veulay ki asa lo keneged shelosha devarim sheasa berisho: 1 shehashshem amar elav paam achat lo telech lo taor, vehu lo amar lassarim maamar "lo taor" vegomer, shezze haya sibba lishloach acherim, ucheneged ze nitztzav paam achat badderech venatta haaton mehadderech, keshem shehu nata mehadderech asher amar Adonai elav kannizkar. 2 shehashshem amar elav im likro lecha vegomer, shettenay hu haddavar ad sheyyeda bevadday sheyyesh lo hanaa baddavar, uvaze remazo sheen lo hanaa velo hirgish. ucheneged ze amad hammalach bemishol hakkeramim vattilchatz haaton raglav, lemor shellechatzo Adonai benoam devarav lehasekil lehetiv leval yelech. hag shehashshem amar elav beet rishyon hahalicha ach et haddavar vegomer, vedibbur ze hu meduyyak, en lintot bemashmauto ana vaana, vehu harasha halach beetza acheret kemo sheddiyyaknu mimmaamar "holech hu" gam meamro "vehu rochev" vegomer "ushene nearav" vegomer, vehu ma sheamad hammalach bemakom tzar asher en derech vegomer, veravtza haaton tachtav, shezze yirmoz lomar sheen Adonai chafetz baddavar shehu chafetz lalechet alav.

rashi: Od haish bet rasha otzrot resha. hei haesh nekuda pattach lefi shehi tema, vechen perusho od leshon orech yamim hu, haesh kemo hayesh (uvedivre hayyamim 1 2) matzinu ishay avi david bimkom yishay af kan esh bimkom yesh vechen (bishmuel 2 14:19) "im esh lehemin ulehasmiyl" im yesh lehaamin ulehasmiyl, veyonatan tirgem ken "hait" sheyyaale bilvavchem sheyyitkayyem bet rasha leorech yamim veotzrot resha.
Veefat razon zeuma. midda ketanna sheashirechem merammim bah haaniyyim umeviin otan lide razon, vehu zeuma beappo shel hakkadosh baruch hu.
targum: Od hait bet reshia otzrin dirsha umechilan dishkar maytin lut:

rashi: Vehichratti are artzecha. velo titztarech leare mivtzar:
targum: Veeshetze kirve ammaya mearach vaafager kol kerakkehon takifaya:

rashi: Kach et kol rashe haam. lishpot et haovedim lifor:
Vehoka otam. et haovedim:
Vehoka. hi teliyya, kemo shemmatzinu bivne shaul "vehokaanum laAdonai" (Shmuel 2 21:6) vesham teliyya meforeshet (Sanhedrin 34); aza biskila vechol hanniskalin nitlin (Sanhedrin 45):
Neged hashamesh. leen kol. umia: hashemesh modia et hachoteim, heanan nikpal mikkenegdo vehachamma zorachat alav:
ohc: Veyashov charon vegomer. hutzrach lehashiv charon gam achar asot mishpat, lefi shehabbet din shel matta en maanishim ella leosim beedim vehateraa, veim yaase Adonai mishpat yiggof gam osim belo edim uvelo hateraa, uchesheyyetze hammashchit yashchit gam lechoshve machshevot ra, laze amar lahem laasot mishpat uvaze yashuv charon appo leval yashchit ovdeha belo edim uvelo vechulei veyashuvu veyichyu.

rashi: Mi haanashim haelle immach. lehatoto va, amar peamim sheen hakkol galuy lefanav, en dato shava alav, af ani ere et sheuchal lekallel velo yavin (tanchuma):
ohc: Mi haanashim vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma shaal oto Adonai, hamimmennu yibbatzer kol davar? od tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar tevat immach velo hispik bemaamar haelle? od tzarich ladaat teshuvat bilam sheamar "balak ben tzippor" vegomer, vechi sheelato yitbarach hayta mi shelacham? sheelato hayta mi hem! verazal hirgishu bedikduk ze veamru (yalkut shemauni tashesah) veze leshonam: "mi haanashim" vegomer, amar oto rasha, eni yodea bahem ella balak ben tzippor shalach elay, ad kan. perush, mittoch haddevarim sheamar "balak vegomer shalach" vegomer muvan shennitkavven lomar "eni yodea vegomer ella balak shalach" vegomer. od tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar lo "melech moav" velo hispik bezichron shemo? venire shekkavvanat maamar Adonai hi al pi ma shepperashnu befasuk "linu fo" sheyyalinu immo bechadro hammeyuchad lo. laze ba maamaro yitbarach veamar lo mi vegomer leshon hashepala, al derech amro (Shemot 3:11) "mi anochi" vegomer. kemo chen amro mi haanashim haelle shehichnasta otam lemakom ze immecha bacheder hammeyuchad lecha ledabber immecha malach haelohim, ki yakpid Adonai al kevod bilam beerech haummot kevan shehu navi alehem, uchemo shemmatzinu (Bamidbar Rabba 20,14) sheharag et haaton mishshum kevodo shel bilam. veayyen bappasuk sheachar ze "vayyomer elohim". vehevin bilam devarav veamar taam sheasa lahem kavod ze hu lefi shehem sheluche melech, vehu amro balak ben tzippor, perush, hayyadua linsich midyan, veod lo shehu melech lemoav shalach elay, perush, haanashim haelle, uvishvil kevod hammalchut asiti otam immi. uvaze nityashshevu kol haddikdukim.
Od yirtze beamro melech moav, ki umma zo lo nittena leyisrael, venitchakkem bemaamar ze kede sheyyitratztze Adonai leshalcho velo yeakkev al yado, velaze lo yeakkev al yado bahalichato im sheluchav.

rashi: Im likro lecha. im hakkeria shellecha vesavur atta littol aleha sachar, kom lecha attem:
Veach. al korchacha et hadabar ashar adabar alik atv tashah; veaf al pi chen vayyelech bilam, amar shemma afattennu veyitratztze:
ohc: Im likro lecha bau haanashim vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma amar devarav bilshon safek, hamimmennu yippale kol davar? od, lamma hiskim Adonai al yad harasha lalechet lekallel sonehem shel yisrael? od tzarich ladaat lamma chazar bo Adonai middaat rishona sheikkev al yado, mittechilla ma savar ulevassof ma savar?

Venire ki bema shellefanenu hayu lifne Adonai shene derachim, uvechol echad mehem yesh bo mechush bilti hagun. haechad, im yaskim Adonai al halichato yachshevu haammim hahem shershuto beyad atzmo velo yedu sheshshalshelet hakkelev beyad bealav veeno yachol asot kechol asher yachpotz, vaAdonai ratza sheyyivvada leene haammim sheen bilam birshut atzmo lehara lemi sheen Adonai chafetz beraato. veim lo yannichehu lalechet yikkanes bemechush acher, ki yomar bilam shehu yare mimmennu chas vechalila leshalcho velaze mono millechet. asher al ken nitchakkem Adonai vesillek shene hammechushim bederech nachon. bitchilla amar elav lo telech vegomer, shebbaze hera laammim ki en hakkelev ra birshut atzmo. gam nitchakkem Adonai baze leshallem lo secharo shehikdim lomar lishluche valak ki eno birshut atzmo. uma sachar natan lo sheyyada Adonai et asher tikrena oto bahalicha zo, shemmillevad shello tihye lo toelet, dichtiv (Bamidbar 24:11) "amarti kabbed achabbedcha vehinne menaacha Adonai mikkavod", millevad ze od lo shettesovvehu halicha zo linpol bacherev, dichtiv (Bamidbar 31:8) "veet bilam vegomer hargu becharev" keshehalach lekabbel secharo al atzato shennatan lahem bahalichato. laze menao Adonai meredet shachat bischar devarav veamar lo "lo telech immahem", ki en hakkadosh baruch hu mekappeach sechar kol beriyya. veze nosaf al geder hakkavod sheasa lo behaderagat hassarim kemo shekkatavnu lemala.

Uvishlichut sheniyya sheshshalach balak, banu letikkun mechush hashsheni sheyyomru sheen Adonai yachol chas veshalom lemano mehara leyisrael bahalichato, vetikkanes taut ze belev bilam veyachshov machashavot ki lo yishlot Adonai bo sham lemano measot cheftzo, ki kevar nivchan ki hu avit shel me raglayim. laze amar elav kum lech ittam uvechol hammakom yaday moshlot alecha. velo amar lo behechlet "kum lech" ella bederech ze im likro lecha vegomer, perush im keriat haanashim yesh lecha bah hanaa. kan remazo sheen lo hanaa bahalicha zo, vetala lo haddavar im halicha zo letovato kede sheyyishtaddel biksamav ladaat tachlito umizze yeda et asher yikraehu veyechdal. veen kavvanat maamar "im likro" safek lefanav ella tenay haddavar im yesh lo bo hanaa vechulei. uvaze husar hammechush sheyyomar bilam she yare chas veshalom mimmennu leshalcho shehare shelacho, gam remazo ulay yeshev velo yimmashech ma shennimshach meharaa leyisrael. gam baze shillem lo tashlum secharo kemo shekkatavnu umenao minnefol bacherev im nafsho lo tove raa, vehu nafsho nefesh rasha velo shat libbo lema sheheiro Adonai. veulay shellaze chara appo kesheraahu Adonai holech velo hirgish bema sheheiro, ze yaggid sheyyitztaddek etzlo bevadday sheyyesh lo hanaa, veze eno yachol lihyot ella im yachshov sheyyaale beyado haddavar asher shelacho lo bishvilo. laze chara appo shel elohe yisrael bo, uvaze nityashshevu kol haddikdukim. uvesamuch yityashshev od taam "vayyichar af" vegomer.

targum: Veeshetze tzalme ammaya vekamathon mibbenach vela tishtabed od leovade yedach:
Vaamar bememreh vaakim zaafa vealola veitrommu galloy:
Arum malachoy yefaked alach lemitrinach bechol orchatach:
Veabed birgaz uvechema yat pureanut din min ammaya dela kabbilu ulefan orayta:
Shemau turaya yat dinaya dayya veikraya misode ara are dina kodam Adonai im ameh veim yisrael avid tochecha:
Al gur bar arveyan ufitna tivot tirmos arya vechuremana:
Hayizkon bemaznevan dirsha uvechis deveh matkelin ravrevin udeadkin:
Veyichsun nichse todta veyishtaun ovadoy beditzta:
Yehodun kodam Adonai metul chasdeh umishtaan perishvateh livne nasha:
Sagi mibbechen titkef yedach yisrael al sanach vechol baale devavach yishtetzun:
Hinun chamon ovadaya dayya uferishvateh bimtzuleta:
Veeshetze charashin mibbenach umeannin la yehon lach:
At tizra vela techtzod at tevader zetin vela teshuf meshach vetaatzar invin vela tishte chamar:
Malachaya nechote yama beilfaya avde fulechana bemayin sagiin:
Deattiraa malan otzrehon chatof veyatvaha memallin shekar velishanhon nichlin befumehon:
Leshabbacha ledavid al yedehon divne korach sichla tava:

bart: Zecharim olot. sheanu tolin sheyyatza mirushalayim, verov zecharim shebbirushalayim hen olot, verov nekevot zivche shelamim:
Harauy lifsachim. zachar ben shana min hakkesavim o min haizzim:
Pesachim. vehammotzo muttar lo lehakerivo lefischo, veim yavo bealav achar kach yitten lo et damav:
Kodem laregel sheloshim yom. mishshaa shemmatchilin lidrosh behilchot happesach veadam mafrish et pischo. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Af bimkom sheamru lehasekir. lerabbi meir besureya davka velo veeretz yisrael, ulerabbi yose afillu veeretz yisrael:
Lo levet dira amru. ella lehachenis sham teven veetzim vechayyotze vaze:

Mippene shehi nikret al shemo. vehannachri mechammemah beshabbat veyomru merchatz shel peloni yehudi rochatzim bah beshabbat. velo dame lesade shel yisrael shearis nachri ose vah melacha veshabbat, desade laarisut avida, vehannachri arisuta denafsheh ka avid, aval merchatz lav laarisuta ka avida veen hakkol yodim shehayyisrael hiskirah lenachri, ulechach asur. uvazzeman hazze shedderech lehorid aris lammerchatz leshana, lemechetza lishlish velirvia, kederech shemmoridin lassadot, share lehasekir merchatz lenachri, veaf al pi shehannachri ose vah melacha veshabbat meda yadi shehannachri aris bah vaarisuta denafsheh ka avid:

Mechatzi hakkevesh ulematta vammaarav. kohanim hazzochim bappayis beevre hattamid lehaalotam, lo hayu maalim otam befaam achat, ella notnim otan al hakkevesh, veholchim lelishkat haggazit likro et shema, veachar kach chozrim umakrivim haevarim al gabbe hammizbeach. vekatane hacha denittanim mechatzi hakkevesh ulematta, shehakkevesh aroch sheloshim ushetayim amma, umechetzyo ulematta notnim otan. verochav hakkevesh shesh esre amma, uvechetzyo shelletzad maarav hayu notnim otan:
Veshel rashe chodashim. mechetzyo ulemala, dehaynu al karkov hammizbeach shehu hassovev. uchelappe hammizrach:

Enan nohagim ella vifne habbayit. shekalim, mishshum detzorech karban ninhu vechevan sheen karban en shekalim. uvikkurim, dichtiv (Shemot 23) reshit bikkure admatcha tavi bet Adonai‏ elohecha, bizman sheyyesh lecha bayit yesh lecha bikkurim, en lecha bayit en lecha bikkurim:

Aval maasar dagan vechulei. nohagim bifne habbayit. veshello bifne habbayit. dikdushat haaretz lo batla, hilkach tzarich lehaferish terumot umaasrot. umaasar behema, tzarich lehaferish haasiri. uvemassechet bechorot amru shebbittelu maasar behema delo leto bah lide takkala:
Hammakdish shekalim uvikkurim. deen nohagim ella bifne habbayit, im hifrishan shello bifne habbayit kadshe:

Bikkurim kodesh enan kodesh. kevan divhedya ketiv behu (Shemot 23) tavi bet Adonai‏ elohecha, afillu hifrishan bediavad lo kadshe, veen shem bikkurim chal alehen shello bifne habbayit. verambam peresh, hammakdish levedek habbayit shekalim uvikkurim sheyyesh lo kevar. uleferusho lo itbarer taama derabbi shimon ammay shekalim kadshe uvikkurim lo kadshe. vahalacha kerabbi shimon:
Ketanna vat yisrael. vehi yetoma, kidfareshna beshilhe firkin dilel. vehosif kan keshennichnesa lachuppa af al pi shello nivala. demeedut dilel lo shamanu sheochelet batteruma ella keshennivala:
Shehurhana. shennitmashkena bide nachrim:
Veedeha. otan sheheidu shehurhana:

Haaminu shello nistera veshello nitmaa. vedavka lezot sheedeha meidim aleha shello nitmea, hu deamre rabbanan haaminu lah, veshello kaddin richakuha bene mishpachtah. aval im en lah edim, kol ishsha shennechbesha al yede mamon bizman sheyyad hannachrim takkifa, asura levalah kohen, lo shena hurhana middatah velo shena nechbesha:
Al sefek bet happeras. kegon teruma shennichnesa levet happeras, dehu sade shennecherash bah kever vesafek im yesh bah etzem kasseora min hammet:
Veal sefek afar habba meeretz haammim. dechol afar habba meeretz haammim mesappekinan leh berakav shel met. ushene elle, eretz haammim uvet happeras, gazru bahem sheyyihyu metammeim bemagga uvemassa:
Veal sefekan shel bigde am haaretz. dechullehu mesappeka lan im yashva alehen ishto nidda:
Veal sefek kelim hannimtzaim. delo yadinan im temeim hen:
Veal sefek rukkin. deshemma shel zav vezava hen, o denidda veyoledet:

Me ragle adam shehen keneged me ragle vehema. revuta kamashma lan, delo amrinan middehane divhema hane nammi divhema, veaf al gav deikka tere sefeke lekulla, safek divhema safek deadam, vaafillu im timtze lomar deadam, shemma deadam tahor. verambam peresh al pi hattosefta, kegon shennitarvu me ragle adam tame im me [ragle] behema chatzi bachatzi beshave, vezehu shekkeneged me ragle behema, umesappeka lan im batlu marehen shel me ragle adam veyihyu kullan tehorin, o lo batlu veyihyu kullan temein:
Al vadday maggaan shehu sefek tumatan. yodea vadday shennaga bahen teruma, aval eno yodea im hen temeim o lav, kidfareshna sefeka dechullehu:

Vachachamim omrim birshut hayyachid tolin. al sefek maggaan. velo sorfim mishshum dahave sefek sefeka lekulla, safek naga safek lo naga, vaafillu im timtze lomar naga, safek temeim safek tehorim. veen halacha kerabbi yose deamar al sefek maggaan sorfin:

Hazzorek. kikkar leven hammaftechot. lo shena zarak kikkar tahor leven maftechot temeot, velo shena zarak maftechot temeot leven hakkikkarot, velo noda im naga hakkikkar hattahor bammaftechot hattemeot, tahor hakkikkar, disvira leh lehay tanna zorek kemi sheen bo daat lishshael dame:

Rabbi yehuda omer kikkar leven hammaftechot tame. disvira leh lerabbi yehuda zorek kemi sheyyesh bo daat lishshael dame, usefeko tame. mihu keshezzarak [mafteach tame ben kikkarot], tahor, hoil vehattuma enah nacha bammakom ella overet al hattahor, sefeko tahor. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda. vechikkar umaftechot denakat bematnitin, hu haddin lechol shear devarim hannizrakim, ella mishshum deorchayhu deeynashe lizrok kikkar umaftechot ze laze, mishshum hachi nakat hane:

Shelosha asar shofarot. tevot tzarot millemala urechavot millematta akummot keen shofar, mippene harammaim shello yuchelu lehachenis yadan letochan lehareot atzman keillu notnin letochan, venotlin mittochan. ulekamman mefaresh lamma shelosha asar shofarot ushelosha asar shulchanot, uveeze makom munnachim:
Shelosh esre hishtachavayot. lekamman mefaresh hechan hayu:
Keneged dir haetzim. lishka sheshsham hayu otzrim kol atze hammaaracha, vehi hayta bemiktzoa mizrachit tzefonit shel ezrat nashim:

Sheshsham haaron nignaz. sheyyoshiyyahu hammelech tzivva ugenazuhu lematta bematmoniyyot akummot vaakalkallot shebbana shelomo bizman shebbana et habbayit veyada shessofo lecharev. vehayenu dichtiv bedivre hayyamim (2 la) beyoshiyyahu, vayyomer lalviyyim hammevinim [vegomer] tenu et aron hakkodesh babbayit asher bana shelomo vechulei. veimmo nignaz matte aharon, vetzintzenet hamman, utzelochit shel shemen hammishcha:
Shehaya mitassek. bimlachto, matlia et haetzim, uvaal mum haya, umelachtan shel baale mumin lehachin etzim lammaaracha, vechol etz shennimtza bo tolaat pasul lammizbeach:
Shehi meshunna. lo hayta haeven shava lishar avne haritzpa, vehevin shennistalleka mishsham vehuchzera:
Beyichud. beverur:

En mochrin behema gassa. degazrinan mechira attu sechirut vehasheala, shehi vehemto shel yisrael, veyaase vah hannachri melacha veshabbat. veal yede sarsur delekka leachlufe vischirut, sheen hassarsur maskir, share lemachrah:
Shelemim ushevurim. sheaf hashshevurim chazu limlacha, shettochanim bahem:
Rabbi yehuda mattir bishvura. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Ben betera mattir besus. vaafillu hassus shehatztzayyadim meviim alav haofot shetztzadin bo. kasavar hachay nose et atzmo. verabbanan savre, davka adam nose et atzmo, hilkach im lo haya meyuchad ella lirkov alav muttar, aval lehavi vaal chay acher chutz meadam, asur. veen halacha keven betera:
Tinok shennimtza vetzad issa. tinok tame shennimtza betzad issa tehora vachaticha shel issa zo beyado:

Rabbi meir metaher. rabbi meir letaameh dechayesh lemiuta vesavar derov tinokot metappechim beissa, veshemma lakach hu atzmo et habbatzek vetimme et haissa, umiut en metappechim veshemma adam tahor lakach venatan lo, veissa zo bechezkat tohora omedet, semoch miuta lachazaka veittera la rubba, vehave palga ufalga vetahor leinyan tinok sheen bo daat lishshael:
Vachachamim metammeim. letaamayhu delo chayshe lemiuta, verov tinokot metappechim. vahalacha kachachamim:
Nekirat. nekavim nekavim yesh baissa mechamat hattarnegolim shenikkeru bah:

Sheyyenaggevu et pihem baaretz. derech hattarnegolim leachar sheshshatu menaggevin pihen baaretz, hilkach im yesh karka mafseket ben mashkin lakkikkarot kede sheyyuchelu lenaggev bah pihen leachar sheshshatu, hakkikkarot tehorim. veim lav, temeim, shehare nitmeu bemashkin temeim shehaya befihen shel tarnegolim. veaf al gav divsheyyesh karka mafseket mesappeka lan im niggevu pihen im lo, have sefek tuma bedavar sheen bo daat lishshael, usefeko tahor:
Shehu fikkeach. veen darko lishtot kol zeman shehu motze leechol, shehu omer kol shaa mashkin metzuyin veen kol shaa ochalin metzuyin. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov:
Kol harukkin hannimtzeim birushalayim tehorim. velo machazikinan lehu berukko shel zav vezava shehen metammein adam vechelim, mishshum deazlinan batar rubbah:

Chutz mishshel shuk haelyon. lefi shekkovsin nachrim hayu metzuyin sham, vachachamim gazru al hannachrim sheyyihyu kezavin lechol divrehen verukkan tame. veit deamre, lefi sheshshuk haelyon lo hayta derisat haregel metzuya sham, vezavin vezavot shemmitboddin umitrachakin mibbene adam hayu metzuyin sham:

Shebbaemtza temeim. mishshum dezavin vezavot shechiche umehallechim beemtza derachim, vehattehorim mistallekim letzidde hadderachim, mekom sheen derisat haregel metzuya, umazhirin lechol tame shello yigga bahen. aval bishat haregel, sherov yisrael tehorin, hattemeim mistallekim latztzedadim shello yetammeu et haam, vehattehorim holchim beemtza hadderachim, hilkach bishat haregel rukkin hannimtzaim baemtza tehorim veshebbatztzedadim temein. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Kalal shel chattat. keli cheres sheefer para munnach bo. targum vechaddah al shichmah (Bereshit 24) vekuleta al katpa:

Shennetano al gabbe hashsheretz. velo nitma hakkeli sheefer happara betocho, deha en keli cheres mittamme miggabbo, af al pi chen haefer tame, mishshum demunnach bemakom tame, vehattora amra (Bamidbar 19) vehinniach michutz lammachane bemakom tahor:
Sherabbi eliezer metaher. desavar hoil vehakkeli shehaefer betocho tahor hu, shappir karena beh makom tahor. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Al mi shennazar shete nezirut. setam. vechol setam nezirut sheloshim yom:

Sheim gillach et harishona yom sheloshim. dilchattechilla lo mibbaya leh legalleach ella yom sheloshim veechad, kede shettihye nezirut sheloshim yom gemurim. veim gillach yom sheloshim, alta lo nezirut, deamrinan miktzat hayyom kechullo:

Veim gillach yom shishshim chaser echad yatza. sheyyom sheloshim shel nezirut rishona ole lechan ulechan, vechevan sheyyom sheloshim shel rishona nimne gam min hannezirut hashsheniyya, nimtzeu sheloshim yom shel nezirut sheniyya kalim beshishshim chaser echad:
Hakkol yissaref bifnim. bevet haddeshen haggadol shehaya baazara, sheshsham sorfim pesule kadshe kadashim, shekkol sheppesulo bakkodesh sorfin oto bakkodesh:
Chutz mishshennitma beav hattuma bachutz. dechevan dachamira tumato veera pesulo bachutz, en lehacheniso laazara lesarfo, hoil velo haya pesulo bakkodesh:

Chutz mishshennitma bivlad hattuma bifnim. deit beh tarte, tumato bifnim vekila tumato. aval nitma beav hattuma en lehashehot hattuma bifnim ad shettissaref, ella yotzienna miyyad veyisrefenna bachutz:
Vehechan hayu hishtachavayot. shelosh esre hishtachavayot ditnan leel, hechan hayu osin otan:

Shaar haelyon. har habbayit haya meshuppa veole mimmizrach lemaarav, vehashshaar hassamuch lemaarav hu shaar haelyon. veacharav shaar haddelek, hu shaar shel lishkat haetz shehayta bidrom haazara, veal shem shemmachnisin derech sham atze hammaaracha sheddolkim al hammizbeach nikra shaar haddelek:
Shaar habbechorot. shemmachnisin sham habbechorot hannishchatim bedarom:

Hammayim mefakkim. kedichtiv bichezkel (47) vehinne mayim mefakkim min hakkatef hayyemanit, vehayenu darom shekkaruy yamin, kedichtiv tzafon veyamin. veraa yechezkel binvua shehayu yotzim mibbet kodesh hakkadashim dakkim kekarne chagavim, ucheshemmaggiim leshaar ze mitgabberim venaasim kimlo pi pach katan, vehayenu dekare lehu mayim mefakkim:
Shaar hakkarban. sham machnisim kadshe kadashim sheshshechitatan batztzafon:
Shaar hannashim. shebbo hannashim nichnasot lismoch al karbanan ledivre rabbi yose deamar nashim somchot reshut, uledivre rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon laamod al karbanan:
Shaar hashshir. derech sham hayu machnisin kele shir:
Shebbo yatza yechanyahu vigloto. shennichnas levet hammikdash lehishtachavot velittol reshut keshehalach baggola levavel, veyatza derech oto shaar:
Shaar nikanor. meforash beyoma [lach] perek amar lahem hammemunne:

Pishpashin. shearim ketannim betoch hashshearim haggedolim. veaf hem mimminyan shelosh esre shearim. veaf al gav degam leshaar bet hammoked haya lo pishpash, lo chashev leh, lefi shehaya katan beyoter, aval ellu hayu gedolim ketzat. vehach matnitin dishlosh esre shearim mokminan la bigmara bayrushalmi keabba yose ben chanan. aval chachamim omrim shiva shearim hayu laazara, veinhu savre dehanach shelosh esre hishtachavayot keneged shelosh esre peratzot sheppartzu malche yavan baazara, uchesheggavru malche chashmonay venitztzechum vegadru otam peratzot, tiknu shelosh esre hishtachavayot, keneged kol pirtza gedura hishtachavaya:

Derech yerida levet hattevila. shene derachim hayu lammikve, beechad yordim uveechad olim, shello yiggeu hattemeim battehorim. veshel derech yerida vadday temeim, lefi shennaflu miyyad hammeviam lattevila:
Shello kiridatan aliyyatan. deviridatan vadday temeim hayu, lechach haya moridan levet hattevila, uvaaliyyatan taharu leachar shehitbilan:
Rabbi yose omer kullan tehorin. delo gazru al sefek kelim birushalayim. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Magrefa. keli sheggorfim vechonsim bo atzmot hammetim keshehem mefuzzarim:
Meritztza. keli sherotztzim umeshabberim bo atzmot hammet kesherotzim lehachenisam bassal leholichan mimmakom lemakom:
Aruchot shel nachtomim. peshute kele etz, shehannachtomim orchim sham kikkarot shel lechem beshaa sheosin happat. aruchot, kemo aruchot:
Shehen temeot midderabbanan. dinhi demin hattora peshute kele etz en mekabbelin tuma, rabbanan gazur alayhu, kidmuchach bemassechet kelim perek 2:
Sherabbi eliezer metaher. desavar lo chashive kelim kelal, vaafillu kifshute kele etz lo havu. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:

Shechittecho chulyot. shechittecho lattannur berachbo lechulyot vehinniach chulya al gabbe chulya venatan chol ben chulya lechulya, vetach oto betit veasa lo tefela shel tit saviv leabboto lishmor chummo kadderech sheosim lattannurim:

Sherabbi eliezer metaher. dechevan deyesh chol ben hassedakin, keshavur dame. vachachamim metammeim, shehattefela osa et kullo echad umechabberet et hassedakim, veaf al pi sheyyesh chol ben chulya lechulya. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:

Shemmeabberin et hashshana bechol adar. ad esrim vetisha baadar yesh zeman levet din lomar meubberet hashshana, vehachodesh habba hu adar sheni. aval beyom sheloshim laadar en yecholim leabber et hashshana, hoil verauy lekavo nisan, kamforash bifsachim perek makom shennahagu [daf 56]:
Al tenay. im yirtze hannasi tihye meubberet veim lav lo tihye meubberet:

Sefek mashkin leochalin tame. kasavar rabbi yose tumat mashkin letamme acherim deorayta, dedaresh kera vechol mashke asher yishshate bechol keli yitma, letamme et acherim, hilkach sefek mashkin letamme ochalin, tame:

Ulechelim tahor. detumat mashkin letamme kelim midderabbanan, mishshemona asar davar sheggazru bo bayyom. vetanna kamma defaleg aleh derabbi yose daresh vechol mashke asher yishte bechol keli yitma, aval lo letamme et acherim, vetumat mashkin letamme ochalim umashkin derabbanan, hilkach sefek tumat mashkin letamme acherim tahor. veen halacha kerabbi yose:

Zo tohorat perishut. ditnan, bigde am haaretz midras lapperushim, uvigde perushim midras leochle teruma. veim nistappek echad min happerushim sheochlin [chullehen] betohora, im naga bevigde am haaretz im lo naga, vechen ochel teruma shennistappek im naga bevigde happerushim venitma bahen latteruma, sefekan tahor:
Sefek sheratzim. hishlich sheretz ben hakkikkarot, safek naga bakkikkarot beshaa sheavar alehen, safek lo naga, im matza oto sheeno nogea, hare hakkikkarot kishat metziatan usefekan tahor:
Ad shello nizkak lattuma. beferek Adonai‏ dingaim mefaresh ketzad:
Sefek nezirut. kegon sheamar hareni nazir im yesh bakkeri hazze mea kor, halach umetzao shennignav o sheavad, safek haya bo, safek lo haya bo, muttar lishtot yayin ulehittamme lemetim:
Sefek bechorot. safek im hu peter rechem im lav:
Echad bechore adam. patur millatet chamesh selaim lakkohen:
Echad bechore vehema temea. peter chamor:
Shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya. deamar leh lakkohen, ayte reaya dehu bechor ushekol:

Shamati shemmakrivim af al pi sheen bayit. lefi shekkedushsha shekkiddesh shelomo et habbayit, kiddesha lishatah vekiddesha leatid lavo. vechen kedushshat yerushalayim kidsha leolam. aval kedushshat shear eretz yisrael lo kiddesha bechibbush rishon ella lishatah, ad shechazru ole bavel vekiddeshuha kedushsha sheniyya, veotah kedushsha kiddesha leatid lavo:

Echad tame. lav tame vadday shehu yadua deshel zav o shel zava, deim ken birshut hayyachid lisrof kishar kol sefek tuma, ella echad tame shehu missetam rukkin, veechad tahor deyadua shehu shel adam tahor. vechevan daafillu naga vadday betame ze shehu setam rukkin eno ella midderabbanan, hasheta deikka safek naga battahor, tolin birshut hayyachid ben ammagga ben ammassa ben ahesset ben belach ben beyavesh. velo yavesh kol kach sheen yachol lachazor ulehashrot kemot shehaya, dehahu tahor gamur afillu vadday dezav, ella deyachol lachazor ulehashrot lichmot shehaya:

Veal maggaan birshut harabbim bizman shehem lachim. i efshar shello yidbak mehen kol shehu beguf hannogea bahen, veyetze mikkelal sefek tuma birshut harabbim, vedin reshut hayyachid yesh lo keshennidbak kol shehu beguf haadam. aval rok yavesh sheeno nidbak, im naga bo have sefek tuma birshut harabbim disfeko tahor:
Veal massaan ben lachin ben yeveshin. dichshennitlesha hattuma birshut harabbim venisset al gabbe adam, la chashiva od tuma birshut harabbim, ella hare hi ketuma birshut hayyachid, kedaamaran:
Haya rok yechidi. meharukkin hannimtzaim, safek shel adam tame safek shel adam tahor:
Venaga bo unesao vehissito. afillu birshut harabbim, veachar kach naga batteruma:
Sorfim alav et hatteruma. keditnan beresha, al vadday maggaan shehu sefek tumatan sorfin et hatteruma:

Maot shennimtzeu. karov lashshekalim yippelu lashshekalim. devatar karov azlinan, dichtiv (Devarim 21) vehayta hair hakkerova el hechalal. vehaomer rov vekarov halech achar harov, moke matnitin kegon sheshshekalim unedava shavin:

Mechetza al mechetza yippelu lannedava. dachamira mishshekalim, dechullah olot, aval shekalim meviin mehen peamim chattaot shenneechalim lakkohanim. veod, dishyare shekalim lechomot hair umigdeloteha:
Mechetza al mechetza yippelu lallevona. dilvona hi atzmah karban. veetzim machshire karban:

Mechetza al mechetza yippelu legozle ola. bayrushalmi parech, bishlama karov legozle ola, kevan demiddeorayta azlinan batar kureva have keillu vadday hen miggozle ola, ella mechetza al mechetza, demissefeka shadinan lehu legozle ola lechumra, haishsha shehevia hammaot hallalu bema titkapper, shemma mikkinne chova naflu, uchesheatta makriv mehen gozle ola bema mitkapperet haishsha. umeshane, bet din hammemunnim al hakinnin lokchim mishshel tzibbur kefi otan maot shennimtzeu, umaknin otan levaale hammaot shennimtzeu, umakrivin mehen kinnin al hassafek, vehachattat lo tehe neechelet:

Lo hayu mannichin oto leechol harebe. afillu min hammaachalim sheen meviim lide chimmum, umonim mimmennu legamre kol maachol hammevi lide chimmum vekeri, kegon chalav uvetzim uvasar shamen veyayin yashan vechayyotze bahen:

Al hachereshet shehissiah aviha. af al gav dehavya eshet ish gemura shehare kibbel aviha kiddusheha keshehi ketanna, afillu hachi yotza beget umekabbelet et gittah keshehi chereshet, veaf al pi sheen lah daat, lefi shehaishsha mitgareshet beal karchah, hilkach lo bainan datah:
Veal ketanna vat yisrael shennisset lechohen. vehi yetoma, delo hayu nissueha ella midderabbanan, sheochelet batteruma, derabbanan. velo gazrinan teruma derabbanan attu teruma deorayta:
Marish. kora:
Bira. bayit gadol:
Mippene takkanat hashshavim. sheim atta matzricho lekakea birato ulehachazir marish atzmo, yimmana millaasot teshuva:
Shello noda larabbim. shehi gezula:
Shehi mechapperet. veen tzarich lehavi acheret:
Mippene tikkun mizbeach. shello yihyu kohanim atzevim sheachlu chullin shennishchatu baazara, venimtza mizbeach batel, shennimnaim millaavod avoda:
Nimin. 440 belaaz:
Esrim vearbaa chutin. lefi shehi asuya mittechelet veargaman vetolaat shani vashesh, vechol min umin chuto kaful shesh. kidita beyoma:
Arkah arbaim verachbah esrim. kemiddat petach haulam, shehaya gavho arbaim verachbo esrim:

Umishshemonim ushetayim ribbo. kach haya minyan hachutim shehi naaset mehen. perush acher, minyan dinre zahav shehayu motziin aleha. veyesh sefarim shekkatuv bahen uvishmonim ushetayim rivot, kelomar dishmonim ushetayim nearot betulot hayu mitassekot baasiyyatah:

Ushelosh meot kohanim hayu matbilin otah. dechelim hannigmarim af al pi shennigmeru betohora tzerichim tevila lekodesh, kidita bemassechet chagiga. ushelosh meot kohanim ditnan bematnitin leshon guzma vahavay hu, delo haya tzarich kol kach kohanim lehatebilah:

Al shel shayish menichin et haevarim. achar hannittuach mesadderin otan al hashshulchan ad sheyyaalum hakkohanim. velo asaum shel kesef o shel zahav deha en aniyyut bimkom ashirut, lefi shehazzahav vehakkesef martichim umasrichim vehashshayish metzannen veshomer habbasar shello yasriach, velo hayu somchin al hannes shello hisriach besar hakkodesh meolam:
Veal shel kesef kele sharet. shemotziin bechol boker tishim ushelosha kele sharet, keditnan bemassechet tamid:
Notnim lechem happanim bichnisato. achar shenneefa, ad sheyyesadderuhu al hashshulchan:
Veal shel zahav bitziato. vehaya munnach sham ad zeman chilluko:
Shemmaalin bakkodesh velo moridin. dechevan shessillekuhu meal hashshulchan shel zahav en moridin oto lahanicho beshel kesef:
Itzterobbalin. pera dearza:
Benot shuach. min mimmine hatteenim haggedolim hallevanim. asur leyisrael limkor ellu leovde avoda zara:
Petotarot. biftotrotehem kaamar, kelomar bookatzin shellahem shehem nitlin bo. demissetama haoved avoda zara rotze lehakerivan tikrovet laavoda zara:
Tarnegol lavan ben hattarnegolin. lakach haoved avoda zara miyyisrael tarnegolim harebe, muttar limkor benehem tarnegol lavan. dechevan deshakel acharine lav laavoda zara vae lehu:

Uferushan asur. im peresh delaavoda zara vae lehu, asur. veitzterich lemitne, desalka datach amena hay gavra lav laavoda zara vae lehu, vehay dekaamar hachi, savar ki hechi dehahu gavra avik bah kulle alma nammi aviku, veema hachi ki hechi deletvu li, kamashma lan:
Dekel tav. perot dekel meshubbach shepperotav regilin lehakeriv mehen laavoda zara:
Vechatzav. kanim sheosin mehen hatztzukera:
Veniklivam. min esev meshubbach meod. vahalacha kerabbi meir:
