Sefek mashkim littame. mashkim tehorim shennolad bahen safek im kibbelu tuma im lav, sefekan tame, kedimfaresh veazel:
Letamme tahor. veim hammashkin temein veyesh lanu safek im timmeu haddavar hattahor im lav, sefeko tahor:

Uzerakah leven hakkikkarot kulei‏ sefeko tahor. uchegon shehaya lanu safek im leachar shennach hammakkel nagu hammashkim bakkikkarot o lo nagu. dei bishat zerika, have leh tuma sheen lah makom, vaafillu besheretz deorayta sefeko tahor, kevan shehattuma nizreka. veim tomar akkatti teppuk leh [detahor] afillu besheretz mishshum deen bo daat lishshael. veyesh lomar deikka leokme matnitin kesheadam ochez hakkikkarot:
Veet shennitma bivlad hattuma ben bachutz ben bifnim yissaref bifnim. dechevan detahor middeorayta, afillu nitma bachutz yesh lekayyem bo serefato bakkodesh:
Ayil kamtza. min chagav hu. targum kachagavim kekamtzin:
Dachan. tahor umuttar baachila:
Veal mashke bet mitbechayya. haddam vehammayim shehem bevet hammitbechayim shebbaazara:

Deinun dachyan. ikka man deamar dachyan tehorim legamre. detumat mashkin lav deorayta ella rabbanan hu degazur behu tuma, uvehane lo gazur. veikka leman deamar dachyan tehorim milletamme acherim, aval tumat atzman yesh lahen, deyesh lemashkin tuma min hattora lehittamme, velo matzu rabbanan letaher ma shettimmea hattora:

Udeyikrav bemita mesaav. hachi kaamar, vechol deyikrav vadday lemita, mesaav. aval safek, afillu tumat met chamura, tahor. vechol shekken tumat sheretz kalla. usefek tuma birshut harabbim ba lehattir. veaf al gav disfek tuma birshut harabbim tahor deorayta hu, dechol issur sefek tuma missota yalfinan, deappik la kera bilshon tuma, venistera vehi nitmea, maggid lecha hakkatuv sheal hassafek asura, uma sota reshut hayyachid, shehare en setira birshut harabbim, af tumat safek enah ella birshut hayyachid, mikkol makom kodem shebba yose ben yoezer hayu omrim halacha veen morin ken, uva hu veheid shemmorin ken lechattechilla letaher kol sefek tuma birshut harabbim:
Vekaru leh yose sharya. lefi shehittir shelosha devarim shehayu nohagin bahen issur. shekkol bet din shemmattir shelosha devarim sheen hahetter shellahen pashut, karu leh be dina sharya:

Sefek mayim sheuvim. safek im naflu lemikve ze mayim sheuvim ufesaluhu, o lo naflu. o sherainu shennaflu bo mayim sheuvin, safek im haya bahen shelosha luggin shehu shiur kede lifsol et hammikve, o lo haya bahen kashshiur. vechullehu shear sefekot meforashim lekamman befirkin:
Hizza veshana. hizza bashshelishi, veshana bashshevii:

Ellu vaellu teluyot. af al gav devishnayim shehalchu mokminan kol chad bechezkat tohora, keditnan lekamman, hacha gabbe chad bitre zimne lo shayyach letaher bakkayyamot, daafillu bishnayim keshebbau lishshael bevat achat, temein. vechad afillu baze achar ze kevat achat dame:
Vehashsheniyyot yissarefu. devadday tame haya keshennaasu:

Aval mocher hu mishsheyyikkatzetz. shello yehe mocher lo hamechubbar ella leachar sheyyikkatzetz. aval kol zeman shehu vimchubbar, lo, shennimtza noten lo chanaya vakkarka, vehattora amra (Devarim 7) lo techannem, lo titten lo chanaya bakkarka:
En maskirin lahem battim. gezera mishshum mechira deissura deorayta hu:
Veen tzarich lomar sadot. deikka tarte deissura, chanaya vakkarka umafkian min hammaasrot:
Uvesureya. aram tzova, shekkavash david veenah kedosha kikdushshat haaretz:

Maskirin lahem battim. velo gazrinan attu mechira. dei nammi ate lide mechira lo avar addeorayta, dechi chetiv lo titten lahem chanaya, beeretz yisrael ketiv. umihu mechira lechattechilla lo, mishshum mechira deeretz yisrael:
Aval lo sadot. deikka tarte leissura:
Uvechutza laaretz. dimrachak, velekka lemigzar mechira dehatam attu mechira deeretz yisrael:
Mochrin battim umaskirin sadot. aval mechira desadot lo, kevan deikka tarte:
Rabbi yose omer kulei. vahalacha kerabbi yose. uvilvad shello yaskir beeretz yisrael lishlosha nachrim beyachad, shello yaase shechuna shel nachrim:
Lishkat chashaim. al shem shehannotnim betochah maot notnim beseter, vehammitparnesim mimmenna notlim beseter:
Lelishkat bedek habbayit. lallishka shennotnim bah kol kadshe bedek habbayit:
Shochet bah miyyad. devadday hitbiluha bealeha meetmol kede sheyyihye lah haarev shemesh utehe reuya lishchot bah hayyom beerev happesach:

Bishlosha asar shone umatbil. kelomar af al gav deikka lememar kevar hitbiluha bealeha, tzarich hammotzah lehatebilah shenit, deshemma lo hitbiluha bealeha, dehaya lahem shehut lehametin ad samuch lachashecha, veaf al pi shello gazru al sefek kelim birushalayim, mishshum chumra dekadashim hitzrichuha tevila. verambam peresh shone lehazzot aleha, deshemma nitmea bemet vehizza aleha bashshelishi, veatta shone umazze aleha veachar kach matbilah:
Kofitz. sakkin gadol asuy lachtoch basar velishbor bo atzamot:
Baze uvaze. ben bishlosha asar ben bearbaa asar:

Shone umatbil. lefi sheen hakkofitz rauy ella lachagiga, sheshshevirat etzem muttar bah. uvigmara bifsachim (daf 70) moke matnitin bizman shehaya hannasi goses bishlosha asar, sheim yamut yihyu kol hatztzibbur temeim veyukrav happesach betuma velo yihyu tzerichim letaher hakkelim. hilkach, sakkin shetztzarich lishchitat happesach, dechad sefeka hu, shemma lo yamut hannasi veyaasu et happesach betohora, matbilin oto, vachazaka shettiharuhu beyom shelosha asar kede lishchot bo et happesach bearbaa asar. aval kofitz, ditre sefeke, shemma yamut hannasi veyaasu pesach betuma veaz en meviin chagiga veeno tzarich lakkofitz, veaf im lo yamut shemma yihyu happesachim merubbim velo yaasu chagiga bearbaa asar, hilkach lo matbele leh vechezkato shello tiharuhu:

Chal arbaa asar lihyot beshabbat shochet bah miyyad. velo amrinan kevan deshabbat hu lo nishchot bah missefeka shemma temea hi venimtza happesach tame umechallel et hashshabbat shello bimkom mitzva. verabbotay pershu, shochet bah miyyad, bakkofitz kaamar, deaf al gav deen chagiga beshabbat, mikkol makom chazaka shehitbilah meerev shabbat letzorech chagigat chamishsha asar:
Bachamishsha asar shochet bah miyyad. lefi shekkol haam yodim shehazzaa utevila asura beyom tov, umatbilin et hakkol millifne yom tov:
Nimtzet. hakkofitz:
Keshura lesakkin. amrinan vadday hitbiluha im hassakkin. aval rambam peresh, nimtzet sakkin setama keshura im sakkin acheret yedua, hare hi kassakkin hayyedua, im temea temea veim tehora tehora:
Rabbi eliezer omer shelashtan shavin. kedimfaresh veazel, delet leh lerabbi eliezer tohoratah shel teruma tuma hi etzel hakkodesh:
Hashshelishi shebbechullan. lo mashkachat shelishi bechullin ella im ken naasu al tohorat teruma. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:

Leachar edehen muttar. vechen halacha. uvaggola sheen anu yecholim lehaamid atzmenu millissa velitten immahem, sheikkar parnasatenu mehem, veod mishshum yira, eno asur ella yom edam bilvad. veyom rishon hu yom edam shel notzrim lefichach asur laset velatet im hannotzrim bechol yom rishon vechen bechol yom ed shellahem sheosim oto kegon natal ufashkvo aval shear yeme edam sheosim leshem hakkedoshim shellahem sheen tofsim bahem shem elahut muttar. vehaidna nahug alma hetter afillu vechol yom edam, mishshum dekim lehu lerabbanan begavvayhu delo azle umodu. [dechol hane deittasre vezo hammassechta mayre veovde elilim vaavoda zara mammash]:

Baale egoz. hakkelippa hachitzona shel egoz, dehaynu hakkelippa hayerukka keshehi lacha. im asaah kemin marzev lihyot hammayim hazzochalim nichnasim bah umekallechim mimmenna lachutz, din zochalim yesh lammayim hamekallechim mimmenna, vehem kesherim leme chattat velitvilat zavim vechulei. velo amrinan hoil venichnesu betoch kelippa zo sheyyesh lah bet kibbul umishsham mekallechin lachutz shuv lo yihye lahem din zochalim, lefi sheotah kelippa enah chashuva keli:
Lifne lishkat haggazit. sanhedri gedola sheyyoshvim belishkat haggazit:
Hare ellu tehorim. akkabbetza ochalim veakkazzayit min hammet vechazzayit min hannevela vechaadasha min hashsheretz kae:
Hinnichan baggeshamim venitpechu temein. dechol hashshiurim batar godlayhu azlinan. umehacha kayma lan deen dichuy etzel issurim:

Safek naga safek lo naga sefeko tahor. vaafillu birshut hayyachid, vaafillu adam sheyyesh bo daat lishshael ochez battuma. sheen lattuma makom shettehe nacha bo, shekkol zeman shehi befi hachulda o befi hakkelev enah chashuva nacha bammakom, ella tuma overet hi, hilkach sefeko tahor, vaafillu ochez battuma haadam sheyyesh bo daat lishshael:
Veen hashshoshannim ella vimkom hattuma. shei efshar sheyyikkach hashshoshannim ella im ken yikkanes levet hakkevarot:
Tahor. kevan deikka lemitle beacher, shemma likketan acher unetanan lo, detinok en bo daat lishshael usefeko tahor:
Vechen chamor. shehaya omed bimkom tohora velo yadinan im nichnas bimkom tuma:
Kelav tehorim. lefi sheen bo daat lishshael:

Sheyyihyu hakkohanim neotim bahen. davka laachilat hakkarbanot. aval laachilat chullin, afillu limloach chullin hanneechalin baazara im hakkarbanot kede sheyyehu hakkarbanot neechalim al hassova, en neotim bahen:

Shello yihyu moalin beefrah. demin hattora en moalin beefrah, dichtiv (Bamidbar 19) chattat hi, bah moalin veen moalin beefrah. kevan dechazu deka mezalzele bah, gazru beefrah meila. kevan dechazu deka parshe [meefer] hazzaot, okmuha addeorayta:

Veal hakkinnin happesulot. hammechuyyavin kinnin meviin maot venotnim lashshofar, uvet din lokchin hammaot vekonim bahen kinnin, vehabbealim holchim lahem vesomchim al bet din sheyyakrivu kinnehen, veim parchu hakinnin o nimtzeu pesulim, tenay bet din hu sheyyikkechu acherim middeme hallishka, umaknim otam labbealim, veyotzin bahen yede chovatan:

Rabbi yose omer. oto shehu ragil lesappek et hakkinnin, sheppasak damim im haggizbarim limkor lahem kol hakinnin hatztzerichim, hu chayyav lehachelif kol sheyyimmatze bahen pesul, keditnan leel perek hatteruma, eno mekabbel meotav ad sheyyihye hammizbeach meratztze, veim hechmitz hayyayin o hitlia hassolet machazirin oto lammocher, kach im nifsal haof achar lekichato machaziro lo, vehu machazir et haddamim. vahalacha kerabbi yose, dehachi amrinan bayrushalmi, tenay bet din hu, hammesappek et hakkinnin mesappek et haovdot veet happesulot:

Musaf hayyora shel sholke zetim. derech sholke zetim vetzabbaim, sheyyesh lahem yorot gedolot, veosim lahem tosefet tit al sefatam sheyyaalu bah hammayim beet retichatam. veshel sholke zetim tame, lefi sheotah tosefet tzericha lakkeli umishtammeshin bah, vehattora amra gabbe tannur vechirayim (Vayikra 11) utemeim yihyu lachem, vedarshinan lachem, kol shebbetzarchechem, kelomar haddavar min hakkeli sheattem tzerichim lo umishtammeshin bo hu shemmekabbel tuma:
Veshel tzabbaim tahor. sheen hatztzabbaim mishtammeshim beotah tosefet lefi sheyyereim shemma yippased tzivam:
Shiva devarim. vekachashev lehu veazel:
Nachri sheshshalach olato. dedarshinan ish ish, melammed shehannachrim nodrim nedarim unedavot keyisrael:
Shettehe minchato. asirit haefa shekkohen gadol makriv bechol yom machatzitah babboker umachatzitah baerev:
Kereva mishshel tzibbur. dichtiv (Vayikra 6) chak olam, chok ze yihye mishshel olam, kelomar mishshel tzibbur, dehaynu mitterumat hallishka:
Rabbi yehuda omer mishshel yorshim. dichtiv (sham) vehakkohen hammashiach tachtav mibbanav, vehachi mashma, vehakkohen hammashiach shemmet, tachtav echad mibbanav yaase otah:

Ushelema hayta kereva. keshehi baa mishshel tzibbur lerabbi shimon o mishshel yorshim lerabbi yehuda, issaron shalem hayta kereva velo chatzi issaron. verabbi yehuda mappik leh middichtiv mibbanav yaase otah, keshehaechad mibbanav makriv leachar shemmet aviv, dehaynu hayyorshim, yaase otah velo chetzyah. vahalacha kerabbi yihuda, shemmishshel yorshim hi baa. veha ditnan bematnitin ditnay bet din hu ledivre rabbi shimon shettehe baa min hatztzibbur, velo min hattora, mefaresh bigmara dishte takkanot havu, bitchilla middeorayta kereva mishshel tzibbur, middichtiv chak olam kidamrinan, kevan sherau deka middachaka lishka, hitkinu denigbu miyyorshim, kevan dechazu deka pashu bah, okmuha addeorayta. venimtzet achshav kereva min hatztzibbur bitnay bet din, deukemuha addeorayta:
Hashshemen techilla leolam. veaf al pi shekkarash eno yotze mittorat mashke:
Rabbi shimon shezuri omer af hayyayin. shekkarash eno yotze mittorat mashke. veen halacha kerabbi shimon shezuri:
Gush shel zetim. zetim harebe mechubbarim yachad. uvegush tame ayre:

Kabbetza mechuvvan tahor. hattannur. deen ochel metamme keli. umashke hayyotze min haggush mechamat hessek en lo bamme yetamme, demikkevan deyatzat tippa rishona chaser leh mikkabbetza. aval kesheyyesh baggush yoter mikkabbetza, kesheyyatzat tippa rishona adayin nishar baggush kabbetza, venitmea hattippa baggush, vechazra lihyot techilla, vetimmea hattippa et hattannur, shemmashkin metammeim keli:
Im hayu ferudim. im hayu hazzetim perudim, sheenan gush:
Afillu hen mea. kelomar afillu hen shiur mea betzim en mitztarfin lechabbetza letamme et shemen hayyotze, lihyot techilla:

Bechezkat tohora. veaf al gav disfek tuma birshut hayyachid sefeko tame vehay mavoy reshut hayyachid hu, afillu hachi kevan disfeka have bedavar sheen bo daat lishshael, kegon cheresh shote vekatan, sefeko tahor, dehachi yalfinan mikkerae dichtiv [vayyikra 7] vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel, mashma vadday tame lo yeachel, safek tame yeachel, uchetiv kol tahor yochal basar, vadday tahor hu deyochal, ha safek tame safek tahor lo yochal, ella lav shema minna kan sheyyesh bo daat lishshael kan sheen bo daat lishshael:

Vechol happikkeach. sheyyesh bo daat lishshael. im lo yada im halach bimkom tuma im lav, bechezkat tuma hu. disfek tuma birshut hayyachid sefeko tame, missota yalfinan, disfeka hi im nitmet im lav, vesafek ze bemakom setira hu dehaynu reshut hayyachid, veamar rachamana venistera vehi nitmaa, vesota yesh bah daat lishshael im nitmea im lav:

Al zochalin sherabbu al hannotfim. zochalin hen kegon neharot shehem niggarim al gabbe karka. leshon zochale afar (Devarim 32). vedinan kemayan, shehen metaharim bezochalin uvechol shehen, vehen kesherim lekaddesh bahen me chattat velitvilat zavim.

Notfim. hen kegon me geshamim, vedinan kemikve letaher bearbaim sea uveashboren, ufesulim leme chattat, sheenan mayim chayyim, vechen litvilat zavin. ucheshennitarvu zochalin benotfin verabbu hazzochalin, dinan kezochalin, uchesherim lekaddesh bahen me chattat velitvilat zavim, umetaharim bezochalim uvechol shehen:
Bevirat happilya. shem makom:
Harotev vehaggerisin. shehen mashke tofeach. shehen lachin kol kach sheyyesh bahen tofeach al menat lehatepiach:
Hare ellu techilla. dachashuvim kemashkin:
Karshu hare ellu sheniyyim. dechevan shennikreshu, chashuvim koochalim shennagu bemashkin:

Chazru venimmochu kabbetza mechuvvan tahor. deyatza mehen torat ochel veyarad alehen torat mashke, ufarcha tumato keshennishtannu, veen lemashke ze mi sheyyetammeennu, dimchi yatzat tippa rishona amit haochel mikkabbetza, ufachot mikkabbetza en metamme acherim. aval yoter mikkabbetza tame, kedimfaresh taama, dimchi yatzat tippa rishona nitmet otah tippa bechabbetza ochel tame, ucheshennimcha achar kach kullo chazra hattippa vetimmea et hakkol:

Halacha lemoshe missinay. shehera lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe besinay dor dor vedorshav, veherahu sheen eliyyahu ba letamme uletaher, lerachek ulekarev, levarer sefek mishpachot hametummaot mi nitma umi lo nitma, ella yannichem vehem kesherim leatid lavo, dahalacha hi mishpacha shennitmea nitmea:
Ella lerachek hamekoravim bizroa. shehakkol machazikim otan bifsulim, ella shennitkarvu bizroa. aval mishpacha shennitmea mechamat shello noda pesulah, yannichenna bechashrutah:
Bet tzerifa. kach shem hammishpacha:
Verichakah. hichriz alehen shehen pesulin:
Ben tziyyon. eynash allima hava uvaal zeroa:
Veod mishpacha acheret hayta sham. shehayta pesula:

Vekervah ben tziyyon bizroa. vehichriz alehen shehen kesherim lehitchatten bahem. vechas hattanna al kevod habberiyyot velo hizkir shem hammishpacha happesula shekkervah ben tziyyon bizroa kemo shehizkir shem hammishpacha hakkeshera, lelammedcha kamma tzarich adam lizzaher shello lesapper bignut chavero, velihyot kose kalon. im kach bifsulim, kol shekken bichsherim:
Kegon ellu. shekkashrutan ufaslutan yedua, ella shennitrachaku bizroa venitkarvu bizroa:
Lekarev aval lo lerachek. hammishpacha hakkeshera shennitrachaka bizroa, hu mekarev. aval eno merachek otah shennitkarva bizroa:

Shenneemar veheshiv lev avot al banim. sheatid lomar beruach hakkodesh ze mibbene banav shel ze. uledivre rabbi shimon, avot ellu hachachamim, uvanim ellu hattalmidim, sheyyihye lev kullan shave velo yippol benehen machaloket:
Kalenda. shemona yamim achar tekufat tevet:

Setarnura. shemona yamim kodem hattekufa. lefi sheraa adam harishon yom shehaya mitmaet veholech, amar, oy li shemma vishvil shessarachti chozer haolam letohu vavohu, amad veyashav shemona yamim betaanit [uvitfilla], kevan shennafla hattekufa veraa yom shemmaarich veholech, amar minhago shel olam hu, amad veasa shemona yamim tovim. leshana acheret, asaan leellu vaellu yamim tovim. hu kevaam lashshamayim, vehem kevaum laavoda zara:
Keratesim. yom tefisat bo malchut, ukevaum yom ed:
Genusya. yom shemmaamidin bo melech:
Yom halleda. yom shennolad bo hammelech:
Serefa. shessarfu alav kele tashmisho kederech shessorfin al hammelachim:
Yesh bah avoda zara. kelomar oto hayyom yesh lahem ed laavoda zara, vechen mishshana leshana kol yeme veno. vechol hanach dechashvinan ad hasheta, chashive lehu vaasurim shelosha yamim lifnehem:
Aval yom tiglachat zekano. sheeno zeman hakkavua larabbim ella kol echad keshemmegalleach ose yom ed:
Uvelorito. shemmanniach belorit meachorav kol hashshana kullah veeno megallechah ella mishshana leshana, veyom shemmegallechah ose yom ed:
Veyom sheala min hayyam. umakriv zevachim laavoda zara al shennitztzol. bechol hanach eno asur ella oto hayyom velo lefanav, delo chashive chulle hay:
Echad sheamar nagati vaze. ahashsheretz vehatztzefardea deresha kae, ditzfardea doma letzav vetau beh:

Shedderech bene adam lahaloch. shei efshar leadam limnoa atzmo shello yelech birshut harabbim, hilkach sefek shevilin tahor. aval magga efshar leadam shello ligga, hilkach ki mesappeka leh i naga i lo naga, sefeko tame. veen halacha lo kerabbi akiva velo kerabbi yose:

Leolam maaser. afillu kol hashshana kullah. lefi sheole regalim enan maspikin lehotzi kol maaser sheni shellahen bargalim, umenichin otan likrovehen o leohavehen leechol otan kol hashshana birushalayim, veikkar mitzvat achilat maaser sheni hi shelamim, lefichach rov behemot hannimkarot birushalayim bechol yemot hashshana hen nikkachot bechesef maaser. veaf al gav deikka lememar shemma min hammochrim naflu venitchallelu kevar, kevan delokchim havu rubba, shehare kamma anashim lokchim mittaggar echad, amrinan delokchim hen velo nitchallelu vahare hen maaser:
Uvehar habbayit chullin. vaafillu baregel, sherov maot shebbeyad bene adam az hen shel maaser, afillu hachi havu chullin, deazlinan batar rubba deshatta, veemur mikkame haregel naful:
Birushalayim. shello beshuk habbehemot:

Bishat haregel hakkol maaser. velo azlinan batar rov shatta, lefi sheshvake yerushalayim asuyim lehitkabbed bechol yom, vei naful mikkodem kevar nimtzeu. aval har habbayit lo haya asuy lehitkabbed, lefi shehu gavoah, veharuach mechabbed umesir kol haavak, vegam en adam rashshay likkanes behar habbayit baavak shebberaglav, lefichach en avak matzuy sham:
Kol davar sheyyesh bo nezek larabbim. kegon kele milchama charavot uremachim:
Basilki. tira gevoha. vesham yoshvim ladun bene adam umappilin otam mishsham umetim:
Gardom. binyan echad, vehu asuy ladun dine nefashot:
Itztadya. mekom sechok shemmeviim sham shor naggach vehoreg et haadam:
Bima. keen migdal katzar vegavoah. asuy kede lidchof haadam mishsham vehu met:
Bimosyaot. binyanim sheenam lo letzorech avoda zara velo lehamit bene adam:
Kippa. 358 belaaz. derech ovde avoda zara lehaamid avoda zara bevet merchatzaotehem:
Hashsheretz. sheretz metamme bemagga velo bemassa:
Tzefardea. tahor. ulefi shetztzefardea dome letzav vetau beh, mishshum hachi nakat tzefardea:
Kazzayit min hammet. metamme beohel. unevela enah metammea beohel:
Etzem min hammet. metamme behesset, veetzem dinvela tahor:
Gush mibbet happeras vegush meeretz haammim. metammeim bemagga uvemassa veen metammein beohel:
Shene shevilin echad tame. sheechad mehen kever muttal bo lerachbo, umemalle et kullo, veen over bo shello yaahil:
Heehil al achad mehen. al kazzayit min hammet vechazzayit min hannevela kae:
Hissit echad mehen. [al etzem min hammet veetzem min hannevela, vechen] aggush meeretz tehora vegush mibbet happeras vegush meeretz haammim kae, dimtammein behesset:

Rabbi akiva metamme. disvira leh lerabbi akiva disfek tuma birshut harabbim sefeko tahor hane mille kesheasa tohorot, kevan deen lahem takkana keshennitmeu. aval legabbe gavra lehatzericho tevila vehazzaa, sevira leh detzarich tevila vehazzaa, shemma hayyom umachar yitbarer haddavar shennitma:
Vachachamim metaharim. daafillu gavra deit leh takkanta lo matzrechinan leh tevila vehazzaa. vahalacha kachachamim:
Ir sheyyesh bah avoda zara. sheyyom ed [yesh] livne hair hayyom laavoda zara shebbair:
Chutza lah. vaafillu samuch lair meod muttar laset velatet im hayyoshvim chutz lair, sheen nimshachim achar otah avoda zara. shekken minhagam yom ed shel ellu eno cheyom ed shel ellu:
Mahu lelech lesham. beotah hair beyom avoda zara shellahem:

Bizman shehadderech meyuchedet leotah hair. shehadderech hakkevusha mikkan leotah hair, meyuchedet leotah hair levaddah, asur lelech sham, mippene shennire chimhallech sham laavod avoda zara. veim haya derech maslul holech gam leir acheret, muttar, sheharoe omer lemakom acher hu holech:
Hayu vah chanuyyot meuttarot. vesiman hu lahem sheotam chanuyyot shel avoda zara, littol hakkemarim mehem meches:

Vesheenan meuttarot muttarot. divotam sheenam meuttarot lo shakle minneh meches laavoda zara velo mate laavoda zara hanaa minnayhu. ulemizban minnayhu davar hammitkayyem, share veyom edam, shessetamo hammocher atzev velo azel umode:
Evarim olot. kevan shemmenuttach kederech hannittuach hameforash beolot, beyadua shehen shel olot:
Chatichot chattaot. deen ochlim baazara ella chattaot vaashamot:
Uvirushalayim zivche shelamim. derov basar hanneechol birushalayim have shelamim:
Ze veze. ben shennimtza baazara ben shennimtza birushalayim:

Teubbar tzuratan. lefi shennifselu behessach haddaat vaasurin baachila, veen lezalzel bahen ulesarfan ad sheyyippaslu bevadday, hilkach bau ibbur tzura, hayenu sheyyippaslu benotar. veibbur tzura dishlamim hayenu ad yom shelishi:
Nimtzeu vaggevulim. beare yisrael:
Evarim nevelot. shekken derech shechotchin hannevelot leevarim umashlichin barchovot sheyyochlum hakkelavim:

Chatichot muttarim. sheen regilin lachtoch hannevelot lachatichot, ella hakkesherot regilin lachtoch lachatichot ketannot lemachran leyisrael o latet otah betoch hakkedera. vedin ze beir shekkullah yisrael, aval bair sheyyesh bah nachrim, afillu chatichot asurim:
Shehabbasar merubbe. veen chotchin habbasar lachatichot ketannot ella mevashshelim oto evarim:
Hayu memashkenin et motzeha. hammotze ola o shelamim hayu memashkenin oto ad sheyyavi nesacheha mishshello, shelosha esronim lappar ushene esronim laayil veissaron lakkeves:
Mannichin otah uvorchim. kede shello lehitchayyev binsacheha:

Tekalin chadtin. kedimfaresh bematnitin, shebbo notnin shikle shana zo, ucheshemmaggia zeman hatteruma, haggizbar motzi kol shekalim shebbashshofar venotnam lelishka kede sheyyitremu mehem. vehashsheni katuv alav tekalin attikim, umi shello hevi shiklo beotah shana mevio beshana sheachar kach venotno beoto shofar, vehaggizbar notlam venotnam bishyare hallishka. vehashshelishi katuv alav kinnin, vehem torim gedolim. veharvii gozle ola, bene yona ketannim, vechullan olot. aval hammeviim kinne chova notnim hammaot o haofot leyad hakkohen, velo hayu notnim maot lashshofar. umefaresh taama bayrushalmi, mippene hattaarovot, shemma yamut echad mibbaale kinnin, venimtza deme chattat shemmetu bealeha deazla lemita meorevet bahen. aval rabbanan lo chayshe lehachi, vesavre divshofar shel kinnin mesimin deme kinne chova, uvechol hammaot hannimtzaim bo makrivin ken echad chattat veechad ola, vehashsheni kullan nedava ukerevim olot. vahalacha kachachamim:
Etzim. vehammitnaddev etzim lammaaracha noten demehen letocho:
Levona. hammitnaddev levona noten damim letocho, vehaggizbarim lokchim hammaot shebbashshofar vekonim mehen levona umaktirim al hammizbeach:

Zahav. hammitnaddev zahav notno sham o deme shavyo, vehu lakkapporet, kelomar lichle sharet. shehammizrakot nikreu kefore zahav beezra uvedivre hayyamim, lefi shehakkohen mekanneach etzbao bahem ben hazzaa lehazzaa, uven mattanot shel chattat, shehashshirayim shebbaetzba pesulim:

Shishsha lindava. shishsha shofarot hannotarot hen lindava, haechad katuv alav motar chattat, hashsheni motar asham, hashshelishi motar kinne zavim vezavot veyoldot, veharvii motar karbenot nazir, hachamishshi motar asham metzora, hashshishshi nedava setam. umi shehifrish maot lechattat vekana chattato venittotru min hammaot, mashlich hammotar lashshofar shekkatuv bo motar chattat. vechen motar asham mashlich lashshofar shekkatuv bo motar asham, vechen kullam. veshofar shekkatuv bo nedava setam, kol mi shemmitnaddev davar lammizbeach noten letocho:

Parochet shennitmet bivlad hattuma. shennaga bemashkin temeim, shechachamim gazru al hammashkin shemmetammein kelim, gezera mishshum mashke dezav vezava kegon rukko veshichvat zaro shehem av hattuma umetammein adam vechelim middeorayta:
Matbilin otah bifnim. veenah teuna shilluach michutz lemachane shechina, kevan shello nitmet ella bivlad hattuma:
Umachnisin otah miyyad. sheenah teuna haarev shemesh:
Nitmet beav hattuma. besheretz o binvela:
Matbilin otah bachutz. dituna shilluach, kidamrinan beferek batra deeruvin, hammachnis teme sheretz bemikdash chayyav:
Veshotchin otah bachel. chutz laazara:
Sefek karbanot. ketzad, haishsha sheyyesh aleha sefek chamesh ledot vechulei: mevia karban echad. chattat haof habba al hassafek:
Veochelet bazzevachim. shehakkarban hazze ligmor tohoratah ba vahare hu kitvila, sheim nitmet haishsha kamma tumot, tevila achat ola lechullan, af karban ze ken:
Veen hashshear aleha chova. lo hitzrichuha chachamim lahavian. sheaf haechad bekoshi hittiru lehakeriv sefek melikat chullin lammizbeach, ella kede laasot lah takkana littaher leechol bakkadashim:
Rippuy mamon. behemto:
Rippuy nefashot. gufo. veim amar lo sam peloni yafe lecha, afillu rippuy nefashot muttar lehitrappeot mimmennu:
Aval lo veno leveno. vei roe vemara, muttar. dememar amar hannachri, hoil umistapper hachi adam chashuv hu, umityare lehargo:

Shivat yamim. mafrishin kohen gadol. shekkol avodot yom hakkippurim en kesherot ella bo, [yoma lev: uvechamma mekomot]. shenneemar gabbe yom hakkippurim (Vayikra 16) vechipper hakkohen asher yimshach oto. vehaferasha zo, nafka lan middichtiv beshivat yeme hammilluim (sham 8) umippetach ohel moed lo tetzu shivat yamim, uchetiv batreh (sham) kaasher asa bayyom hazze tzivva Adonai‏ laasot lechapper alechem, vedarshu rabbotenu, laasot, ze maase para, lechapper alechem, ze maase yom hakkippurim. shehakkohen hassoref et happara vehakkohen haoved beyom hakkippurim shenehem teunim haferasha mibbetam shivat yamim kemo shehayu teunim aharon uvanav beshivat yeme hammilluim:

Lelishkat palhedrin. pekide hammelech nikraim palhedrin. umittoch shehakkohanim haggedolim shehayu bevayit sheni achar shimon hatztzaddik hayu notnim mamon kede leshammesh bichhunna gedola, umittoch shershaim hayu lo hayu mashlimin shenatan vehayu mitchallefin kol shenem asar chodesh kifkide hammelech shehammelech machlifan kol shana, lechach nikret lishka zo lishkat palhedrin:
Umatkinin lo. umazminin kohen acher lihyot kohen gadol tachtav, im yeera lo keri o shear tuma:

Im ken en laddavar sof. im ken dechayyshat lemita en laddavar sof, shemma gam zo tamut. ella letuma dishchicha chayshinan, lefichach matkinim lo kohen acher, lemita delo shechicha sheyyamut met befeta pitom lo chayyshinan hilkach en matkinin lo ishsha acheret. vahalacha kachachamim:

Lo yifchot mishshene gizrim. hammitnaddev etzim setam lo yifchot mishshene gizrim, keotam shemmesadderim al hammaaracha, veyadua haya shiuran. vedavka hammitnaddev etzim setam, aval harotze lehavi afillu etz echad, yavi:

Lo yifchot min kometz. shezzehu shiur hallevona habbaa im hammincha, dichtiv (Vayikra 6) veherim mimmennu bekumtzo missolet hammincha umishshamnah veet kol levonatah, ma harama demincha kometz, af levona kometz. vedavka hammitnaddev setam, aval im ratza lehavi afillu kort shel levona mevi. vehammitnaddev zahav setam, lo yifchot middinar zahav. vehu shehizkir tzurat matbea, aval im lo hizkir matbea ella zahav setam, mevi afillu tzinnora, shehu kemin mazleg katan:

Asham hu ashom asham laAdonai. vekashe kera resheh lesefeh, deasham hu mashma bahavayato uvehilchato hu, shehu neechal lakkohanim, veasham laAdonai‏ mashma shekkullo laAdonai. vedarash yehoyada hakkohen, ashom asham laAdonai, kol shehu ba mishshum chet umishshum ashma, kegon hifrish maot lechattat veasham venittotru mehem, yillakach beoto hammotar olot, habbasar laAdonai‏ vehaorot lakkohanim, venimtzeu shene hammikraot kayyamim, asham laAdonai‏ habbasar, veasham lakkohanim haorot. vehechan matzinu midrash ze bihoyada, dichtiv bimlachim (2 12) bihoyada kesef asham vechesef chattat lo yuva bet Adonai‏ lakkohanim yihyu, vei efshar lomar asham dechesef shekkadash leshem chattat uleshem asham yehanu mimmennu hakkohanim, ella al karchacha hachi kaamar, yaasu mimmennu davar sheyyehanu bo hakkohanim, vehayenu olot, shehaorot lakkohanim:
Vekorin lefanav. kol shivat hayyamim:
Beseder hayyom. befarashat achare mot:
Ishi. adoni:

Shemma lo lamadta. bemikdash sheni hayu tzerichin lechach, shehayu maamidin kohanim gedolim sheenam mehugganim al pi hammalchut, deillu bemikdash rishon lo hayu maamidin kohen gadol ella haggadol shebbakkohanim bechachma benoy bechoach uveosher, veim lo haya lo osher echav hakkohanim megaddelin oto mishshellahem, shenneemar (Vayikra 21) vehakkohen haggadol meechav, gaddelehu mishshel echav:
Sheyyehe makkir. mitbonen babbehemot haovrot lefanav latet el libbo hilchot seder hayyom:

Heid rabbi yehoshua al dam nevelot shehu tahor. milletamme kannevela bechazzayit. aval metamme birviit. sheen lecha davar sheyyetamme damo chivsaro ella hashsheretz bilvad. uleel [resh perek Adonai] ditnan dam nevelot bet shammay metaharin, legamre hayu bet shammay metaharim. uvet hillel metammein, aval lo kannevela shemmetamme bechazzayit, ella birviit:

Shennaga tame vemiktzato shettimme et kullo. maala asu bakkodesh uveefer chattat, sheaf al pi shehem gufim chalukim, im munnachim betoch keli echad venaga davar shehu metamme lakkodesh bemiktzatan, nitmeu kullan, shehakkeli metzarfan lehachashivan keillu hen guf echad. veassemchu akkera dichtiv (Bamidbar 7) kaf achat asara zahav melea ketoret, hakkatuv asa lechol ma shebbechaf achat:

Hosif rabbi akiva. deillu meeduto shel rabbi shimon ben betera lo shamanu ella al hattame, uva rabbi akiva vehosif afillu tevul yom sheeno metamme ella posel bilvad, im naga bemiktzatan pasal et kullan. verambam peresh, dimeeduto shel rabbi shimon lo shamanu shemmetzaref ella keli sheyyesh lo toch, aval keli sheen lo toch lo shamanu shemmetzaref, uva rabbi akiva vehosif sheafillu solet uketoret ulevona vegechalim sheenan betoch keli, ella tzevurim umunnachim al luach o daf sheen lo toch, hare hen keillu munnachim betoch keli, venaasim keillu hen guf echad:
Vehaggechalim. otan shekkohen gadol chote bammachta beyom hakkippurim. im naga tevul yom bemiktzatan, nifselu kullan. umaala asu bahen, sheen haggechalim bene kabbole tuma:
Sefek tuma tzafa al pene hammayim. safek im naga betuma shetztzafa al pene hammayim o lo naga:
Ben bakkelim ben bakkarka. ben shehammayim bechelim ben shehammayim bakkarka, tahor, dachashiv keillu en makom lattuma:
Bakkelim tame. dachashive keillu yesh makom lattuma. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:

Sefek yeridato tame. shedderech adam kesheyyored livrecha shel mayim, shekkol davar shebbammayim ba alav, mechamat hahesset shemmatchil lirchotz et atzmo. aval kesheole min hammayim, haddevarim shebbammayim mitrachakim mimmennu veholchim letzidde habberecha:

Afillu en sham ella melo haadam vehattuma. shehammakom tzar bederech shei efshar lo shello yigga, afillu hachi tahor, kasavar detuma tzafa enah metammea. kach matzati. aval rambam peresh, kol zeman shello yada bevadday shennaga battuma, tahor. nire sheim haya bederech shei efshar lo shello yigga, tame:
Hayu menakkerin bahen. im hishlichu hachulda et hashsheretz, vehakkelev et hannevela, mippihem al haaretz vehayu menakkerim bah, hare yesh makom lattuma usefekah tame:

Lo faslu et tziran. dehekellu betzir shel chagavim temeim sheeno oser taaravto, mippene sheen lahem dam veeno ella lachluchit bealma. vezo hayta mishna rishona. veeduto shel rabbi tzadok hosif al mishna rishona lomar shehu tahor, delo mibbaya deeno oser et taaravto ella afillu hu atzmo tahor:
Hu zorek et haddam. shel temidim, kede sheyyehe ragil baavoda:
Umetiv et hannerot. medashshenan min haefer shel happetilot shekkavu:
Ushear kol hayyamim. im yirtze lehakeriv kol karban sheyyirtze makriv, veen anshe hammishmar yecholin leakkev al yado:
Makriv chelek barosh. rosh hu lehakeriv kol chelek sheyyivchar:
Venotel chelek barosh. bachalukkat hakkadashim notel mana yafa sheyyivchar lo. vehane mille bekadshe mizbeach, aval bekadshe gevul echad kohen gadol veechad kohen hedyot cholkim beshave:

Haochel ochel sheni lo yaase bevet habbad. lo yitassek laasot shemen bevet habbad, deha mode rabbi yehoshua leel lerabbi eliezer shehaochel ochel sheni hu atzmo naase sheni ufosel et hatteruma umetamme mashkin lihyot techilla, (dehaynu hashshemen):
Al gav hakkodesh. al tohorat hakkodesh:
Hare ellu chechullin. veen baim lichlal shelishi:

Hare ellu chitruma. veyesh bahem shelishi. vehane tannae tarvayhu sevira lehu chullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh lav kekodesh damu, vesheen lecha davar sheose revii bakkodesh ella kodesh mekuddash bilvad, ufeliga ammatnitin dilel dekatane hashshelishi shebbechullan posel leochale kodesh:

En maamidin behema befundekaot. haasuyin lehitachsen sham ovre derachim. lefi shehannachrim chashudim al harvia. afillu nekevot etzel nekevot asur, lefi shehannachrim metzuyim etzel neshe chavrehem ufeamim sheeno motzah umarbia et habbehema:
Velo tityached ishsha immahen. afillu beyichud shekkayyotze vo etzel yisrael muttar, kegon sheishto immo, etzel nachri asur, denachri en ishto meshammarto:
Lo teyalled et hannachrit. mippene shemmegaddelet ben laavoda zara. uvesachar, mutteret, mishshum eva:
Aval nachrit meyalledet bat yisrael. bizman sheacherot omdot al gabbah. aval benah levenah lo, shechashuda al shefichut damim shemma tahargennu:

Almanat issa. mishpacha achat shennitarev bah sefek chalal, kol echad mibbene hammishpacha safek im hu oto safek shennitarev bahen im lav. veishsha shennisset leechad mibbene otah mishpacha umet balah, hi keruya almanat issa, shekkemo shehaissa nillosha umeorevet, kach zot haishsha meorevet missefekot. safek im balah hu oto sefek chalal, vaafillu im hu oto sefek chalal shemma eno chalal lefi haemet. verabbi yehoshua machshir otah lakkehunna, sheyyesh kan sefek sefeka ulekulla. verabban gamliel savar af al gav divalma sefek sefeka lekulla, hacha shane, demaala asu beyochasin:

Shehaissa cheshera letamme uletaher. kelomar shehammishpacha shennitarev bah sefek chalal hare hi bechezkat kashrut kishar hammishpachot hameyuchasot, uchemo sheshshear hammishpachot omrot zo temea umitrachakim mimmenna vezo tehora umekarvim otah, kach mishpacha zo shennitma bah sefek chalal, en yecholim lomar hoil venitma bah safek en tzerichim yoter livdok keshennosim nashim ezo nitmea veezo tehora, kede lerachek hattemea ulekarev hattehora:
Kibbalnu edutechem. neemanim attem beenenu umaaminim anu shekkach shematem:
Shello lehoshiv bet din al kach. lehattir almanat issa lechattechilla:
Hakkohanim shomim lachem lerachek. im tomru asura:
Aval lo lekarev. im tomru mutteret. ufesak halacha, shealmanat issa asura lehinnase lakkehunna lechattechilla, veim nisset lo tetze:

Velad shelamim lo yikrav shelamim. ella konso lechippa umet. mishshum gezera, dei amart velad shelamim yesh lo takkana, ate leashhoye laem ad shetteled vigaddel adarim min havveladot veate behu lide gizza vaavoda:

Veachalnu veladah shelamim bechag. bechag hashshavuot kaamar. sheim haya mamtin umetzappe lechag hassukkot, nimtza over baase, shenneemar (Devarim 12) uvata shamma vahavetem shamma, demashma beregel rishon shettavo shamma have kol nedarim shealecha. mihu belav delo teacher eno over ad sheyyaavru alav shalosh regalim:
Lifne edehen shel goyim. shem kinnuy lignay lechaggehem ulemoadehem:
Laset velatet. limkor veliknot. mishshum deazle umodu laavoda zara beyom edam:
Lehasheilan. behema vechelim, mide dehadra veena:
Lehalevotam. maot. delo hadere veen, demilva lehotzaa nittena:
Lefaran. keshehen nifraim azlu umodu laavoda zara veyom edam:
Mippene shehu metzer. al meotav sheenam chozrim lo, velo azel umode:
Sameach hu leachar zeman. lemachar beyom edo, veazel umode. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda. vedavka vemilva vishtar asur lehippara mehem, aval bemilva al pe share, mippene shehu chematztzil miyyadam:
Sefek yadayim littame. mi shehayu yadav tehorot vesafek naga beochalim temein o bemashkin temein venitmeu yadav, safek lo naga velo nitmeu yadav:
Uletamme. hayu yadav temeot, safek naga beochalim umashkin vetimmean, safek lo naga:
Velittaher. hayu yadav temeot vetiharan, safek nitharu karauy im lav. bechol hassefekot hallalu, sefekan tahor:
Sefek reshut harabbim. sefek tuma birshut harabbim, tahor, shekken matzinu tzibbur osim et happesach betuma, im tuma vaddait huttera latztzibbur, kal vachomer sefek tuma:
Sefek divre sofrim. kegon kol hanach dachashiv, dechullehu mishshemona asar davar sheggazru bo bayyom, umeforashin hen bemassechet shabbat perek kamma:
Aval davar shehu av hattuma vehu middivre sofrim. kegon dam tevusa, venachrim sheasaum kezavim, vechayyotze baellu, im nistappek im naga bahen im lo naga:

Sefeko tame. umihu av hattuma middivre sofrim shehu atzmo missafek, kegon bet happeras deikka sefeka im yesh bo etzem kasseora im lav, beha tenan leel deal vadday maggaan sorfin, veal sefek maggaan en sorfin, dahave sefek sefeka:
Shemmassiin haishsha al pi ed echad. ishsha shehalach balah limdinat hayyam uva ed echad veamar shemmet, massiim et ishto al piv:

Bedir haetzim. lishka sheshsham hayu otzrim kol atze hammaaracha, vehi hayta bemiktzoa mizrachit tzefonit shel ezrat nashim. umatzu sham atzamot shel metim, veamru chachamim, melakket etzem etzem vehakkol tahor, velo chayshinan shemma nitmeu bahem adam vechelim, mishshum deezrat nashim din reshut harabbim yesh lah vehave sefek tuma birshut harabbim disfeko tahor. uvemassechet zevachim perek batra [daf 113] mayte gemara sheratzu ligzor tuma al kol yerushalayim bishvil otan atzamot shennimtzeu bedir haetzim, ella sheamar lahem rabbi yehoshua lo busha uchelimma hi lanu shennigzor tuma al ir avotenu:

Uvilvad shello yigga bammashkin. kegon shedderachan bifshute kele etz sheenan mittammeim, dehashta en kan mi sheyyetamme hammashkin ella hazzagin shennaga bahen teme met, shehare lo nizhar minnegiatan ella mishsheyyatza mashke, ucheshehammashkin nogim bazzagin kevar chasar shiur kabbetza, veen ochel metamme befachot mikkabbetza:

Yoter mikkabbetza tame. shekkevan sheyyatza tippa rishona nitmet bechabbetza, deaf al gav deen mashke hannivla baochel mekabbel tuma immo, mashlim hu et shiuro. dedichvateh ashkechan besamuch gabbe kazzayit min hammet umin hannevela shennitmaatu bachamma vehinnichan baggeshamim vetafchu, digshamim hammuvlaim mashlimin lechashshiur:
Sefek adam. safek heehil al haadam:
Tame. sheyyesh bo daat lishshael. veeno tahor mittaama shehattuma befi haorev vehi tuma overet, dechol hammaahilin chashuvot yesh lattuma makom, vaafillu hannizrakin:
Sefek kelim. safek heehil al hakkelim:
Tahor. sheen bahen daat lishshael:
Hamemalle vaasara delayim. ze achar ze:

Venimtza sheretz beachad mehen hu tame vechullan tehorin. vehane mille kesheen [laddeli] oganim. aval yesh lah oganim, kullan temeim, deshemma hashsheretz haya barishon, vehay delo nafal im hammayim emur oganim ikkevuhu:
Haelyon tahor. velo chayshinan shemma min haelyon nafal lattachton:

Im temeot temeot. ki ha ditnan lekamman beferek hashsheretz vehatztzefardea [mishna 7] naga beechad ballayla veen yadua im chay im met uvashshachar amad umetzao met, chachamim metammeim, shekkol hattumot kishat metziatan. vedavka bimkom metziatan, lemaote naga beechad ballayla bezavit zo ulemachar metzao met bezavit acheret vechayyotze baze:

Im mechussot mechussot. kegon keli cheres hammukkaf tzamid patil, lo amrinan shemma beshaa shehaya hammet baohel haya megulle veachshav mechusse, o im metzao megulle lo amrinan shemma beshaa shehaya hammet (beohel) haya mechusse umukkaf tzamid patil:
Machat shennimtzet melea chaludda. shemmeakkevet et hattefira, dachaludda kazo metahartah mide tumatah:
O shevura tehora. velo amrinan shemma keshehayta shelema nitmea uchesheyyetakkenuha vetachazor shelema tachazor letumatah hayeshana. vehayenu perusha deim tehorot tehorot ditnan leel:

rashi: Ze shalosh regalim. ramaz lo: atta mevakkesh laakor umma hachogeget shalosh regalim bashana? (tanchuma):
Hitallalt. ketargumo, leshon genay uvizzayon:
Lu yesh cherev beyadi. genut gedola haya lo davar ze beene hassarim — ze holech laharog umma shelema befiv uleaton zo tzarich kele zayin:

Hahasken hiskanti. ketargumo, vechen "halel yiskan gaver" (Iyov 22); verabbotenu dareshu mikra ze battalmud, ameru leh may tama la rechavt assuseya? amar lehu birtiva sheday leh 26', kidita vemassechet aza (Daf 4):
Haumnam lo uchal kabbedecha. nitnabbe shessofo latzet meimmo vekalon (sham):
Ulay yikkare Adonai likrati. eno ragil ledabber immi bayyom:
Vayyelech shefi. ketargumo yechidi, leshon shofi vesheket, sheen immo ella shetika:
Vayyikkar. leshon aray, leshon genay, leshon tumat keri, kelomar bekoshi uvevizzayon, velo haya nigle elav bayyom ella bishvil leharot chibbatan shel yisrael (Bereshit Rabba 52):

Et shivat hammizbechot. shiva mizbechot arachti en ketiv kan, ella et shivat hammizbechot, amar lefanav avotehem shel ellu banu lefanecha shiva mizbechot vaani arachti keneged kullan, avraham bana arbaa — "vayyiven sham mizbeach laAdonai hannire elav" (Bereshit 12), "vayyatek misham hahara" vego' (sham), "vayyeehal avraham" vego' (Sham 13), veechad behar hammoriyya; veyitzchak bana echad — "vayyiven sham mizbeach" vego' (Sham 26), veyaakov bana shettayim, echad bishchem veechad bevet el:
Vaaal par vaayil bammizbeach. veavraham lo heela ella ayil echad (tanchuma tzav):
Ki merosh tzurim erennu. ani mistakkel bereshitam uvitchillat shorshehem vaani roe otam meyussadim vachazakim ketzurim ugevaot hallalu al yede avot veimmahot (tanchuma):
Hen am levadad yishkon. hu asher zachu lo avotav — lishkon badad, ketargumo:

Uvaggoyim lo yitchashav. ketargumo, lo yihyu naasin kala im shear haummot, shenneemar (Yirmeyahu 30) "ki eese chala bechol haggoyim" vego', enan nimnin im hashear. daa — keshehen semechin en umma semecha immahem, shenneemar "Adonai badad yanchennu" (Devarim 32), ucheshehaummot betova hen ochelin im kol echad veechad veen ole lahem min hacheshbon, vezehu vabagoim lo yatachashab (tanchuma):
Vayyagor. leshon mora, kemo "guru lachem" (Iyov 19):
Vayyakotz moav. katzu vechayyehem:

Ukesamim beyadam. kol mine kesamim, shello yomar en kele tashmishi immi; daa — kesem ze natelu veyadam zikne midyan, ameru im yavo immanu bappaam hazzot yesh bo mammash, veim yidchenu en bo toelet, lefichach kesheamar lahem "linu fo hallayla" ameru en bo tikva, hinnichuhu vehalechu lahem, shenneemar "vayyeshevu sare moav im bilam", aval zikne midyan halechu lahem (sham):
Shatu. leshon "sheiyya" (Yeshaya 24:12) gatyrnt belaaz. veyesh omerim: shatu kemo samu, kemo "lemaan shiti ototay" (Shemot 10:1):
targum: La tidchal mimatzuta deam dachazor chazor itkenashu alai:

rashi: Ki hikkita et kol oyevay lechi. makkat bizzayon hi, kema deatt amar: "yitten lemakkehu lechi" (Eicha 3:30), "bashevet yakku al hallechi" (Micha 4:14). umidrash aggada: makkat happe, kema deatt amar: "vaytzav el beto vayyechanak" (Shmuel 2 17:23):
Shinne reshaim. gevuratam:
targum: Kum Adonai perok yati elohai arum macheta kol baale devavay al lisathon kache rashie tibbarta:

rashi: LaAdonai hayshua vego'. alav lehoshia et avadav veet ammo, veal ammo muttal levarech ulehodot lo sela:
targum: Min kodam Adonai purekana al amach birchatach leolmin:

rashi: Balak ben tzapor vegomer'. aapi sheeni chashuv beenecha, chashuv ani beene hammelachim (sham):

targum: Ma titmakkechin nafshi uma tirgeshi alai orichi lelaha arum tuv ashabbechineh befurekaneh demin kadamoy di hu elahi:

rashi: Ki chabbed achabbedcha meod. yoter mimma shehayita notel lesheavar ani noten lecha (sham):

Melo veto kesef vezahav. lamadnu shennafsho rechava umechammed mamon acherim, amar rauy lo litten li kol kesef vezahav shello, shehare tzarich liskor chayyalot rabbot, safek notzeach safek eno notzeach, vaani vadday notzeach (sham):
Lo uchal laavor. al korcho gilla shehu virshut acherim, venitnabbe chan sheeno yachol levattel habberachot shennitbarechu haavot mippi hashechina (sham):

Vayyachavosh et atono. mikkan shehassina mekalkelet et hashura, shechavash hu beatzmo; amar hakkabbah rasha kevar kedamecha avraham avihem, shenneemar (Bereshit 22) "vayyashkem avraham babboker vayyachavosh et chamoro" (tanchuma):
Im sare moav. libbo kelibbam shave:

Bemishol. ketargumo "bishvil", vechen "im yispok afar shomeron lishalim" (Melachim 1 20) — afar hannidbak bechappot haraglayim behilluchan, vechen "mi madad beshoolo mayim" (Yeshayahu 40) — beraglav uvehillucho:
Gader mizze vegader mizze. setam gader shel avanim hu:
Vattillachetz. hi atzmah:
Vattilchatz: et acherim — et ragal balam:

Vayyosef malach Adonai avor. laavor od lefanav — lahaloch lihyot lefanav bemakom acher, kemo "vehu avar lifnehem" (Bereshit 33); umidrash aggada yesh betanchuma: ma raa laamod bishlosha mekomot? simane avot herahu:
Sede tzofim. makom gavoah haya shesham hatztzofe omed lishmor im yavo chayil al hair:

Rosh happisga. bilam lo haya kosem kevalak, raa valak sheatida firtza lehipparetz beyisarael misham, shesham met moshe, kesavur shesham tachul alehem hakkelala vezo hi happirtza sheani roe (tanchuma):
Ikkare ko. meet hakkabbah, akarah — leshon itpael:

Vayyasem davar befiv. uma hi hassima hazzot? ume chaser hammikra beomro "shuv el balak vecho tedabber"? ella keshehaya shomea sheeno nirshe lekallel amar ma ani chozer etzel balak letzaaro? venatan lo hakkabbah resen vechakka befiv, keadam happokes behema bechakka leholichah el asher yirtze, amar lo al korchacha tashuv el balak (sham):
Vesare moav itto. ulemala hu omer "vechol sare moav", kevan sherau sheen bo tikva halechu lahem miktzatam velo nisharu ella miktzatam:
Ma dibber Adonai. leshon tzechok hu ze, kelomar enecha virshutecha (sham):
Ki lo nachash beyaakov. ki reuyim hem livracha, sheen bahem menachashim vekosemim:

Kaet yeamer leyaakov vegomer'. od atid lihyot et kaet hazzot asher tiggale chibbatan leen kol, shehen yoshevin lefanav ulemedim tora mippiv umechitztzatan lifnim mimmalache hasharet vehem yishalu lahem ma pal el? vezehu shenneemar (Yeshayahu 30) "vehayu enecha root et morecha". daa — yamar liakab eno leshon atid ella leshon hove, enan tzerichin limnachesh vekosem, ki vechol et shetztzarich leheamer leyaakov uleyisrael ma paal hakkabbah uma gezerotav bammarom, enan menachashim vekosemim ella neemar lahem al pi neviehem ma hi gezerat hammakom, o urim vetummim maggidim lahem (tanchuma); veunkelos lo tirgem ken:

Rosh happeor. kosem gadol haya valak veraa shehen atidin lilkot al yede feor, velo haya yodea bamme, amar shemma hakkelala tachul alehem misham vechen kol hachozim bakkochavim roim veenam yodeim ma roim (Sota 12):

Nofel ugeluy enayim. peshuto chetargumo — sheen nire alav ella ballayla keshehu shochev; umidrasho: keshehaya nigle alav lo haya vo koach laamod al raglav venofel al panav, lefi shehaya arel, umaus lihyot nigle alav bekoma zekufa lefanav:
Laavor et pi Adonai. kan lo neemar "elohay" kemo shenneemar barishona (22 18), lefi sheyyada shennivash behakkabbah venitrad:
Veyodea daat elyon. lechavven hashaa shekkoes bah (sanhedrin kh):
Tzim miyyad kittim. veyaavru chittiyyim, shehen romiyyim, beviraniyyot gedolot al ashur:
Veinnu ever. veinnu otam shebbeever hannahar:
Vegam hu ade oved. vechen peresh daniyyel "ad diketilat cheveta vehuvad gishmah" (Daniel 7):
Vetzim. sefinot gedolot, kedichtiv (Yeshayahu 33) "vetzi addir", targumo "uvureni rabbeta" (Yoma 77):
Peor. al shem sheppoarin lefanav pi hattabbaat umotziin rei, vezo hi avodato (Sanhedrin 60):
Vayyichar af Adonai beyisrael. shalach bahem maggefa:
Hirgu ish anashav. kol echad veechad middayyane yisrael haya horeg shenayim, veddayyane yishorael shemonat ribbo ushemonat alafim kidita vesanhe' (Daf 18:):
Vehinne ish mibbene yisrael ba. nitkabbetzu shivto shel shimon etzel zimri shehaya nasi shellahem, ameru lo, anu niddonin bemita veatta yoshev vechu' kidita beellu hen hannisrafin (Sanhedrin 82):
Et hammidyanit. kozbi vat tzur:
Leene moshe. ameru lo, moshe, zo asura o mutteret? im tomar asura, bat yitro mi hittirah lecha, vechu', kidita hatam:

Vehemma vochim. nitallema mimmennu halacha, gau chullam bivchiyya; baegel amad moshe keneged shishim ribbo, shenneemar "vayyitchan ad asher dak" vego' (Shemot 32), vechan rafu yadav? ella kede sheyyavo finechas veyittol et harauy lo (tanchuma):

Vayyar pinechas. raa maase venizkar halacha — amar lo lemoshe mekubbalni mimmecha habboel arammit kannain pogein bo. amar lo "karyana deiggarta ihu leheve parvanka", miyyad vikach ramach bidv vegomer' (Sanhedrin 82):

Reshit Chokhmah, Gate of Holiness 12:24-: And just as we are obligated to believe in the whole Torah of Moses, so we are obligated to believe in all the words of the Scribes, and what they said in Midrashim and Aggadot - and although it may appear to be something contrary to nature, we must attribute the deficiency to the limitation of our own understanding, and not to their teaching. And whoever mocks anything of their words is punished, as we say in the chapter "Osin Pasin" (Eruvin 21b): Rav Papa said in the name of Rabbah bar Ulla, whoever mocks the words of the Sages is judged with boiling excrement - and so they said in Gittin (57a) - and so we find that that student was punished for mocking Rabbi Yochanan's words, when he said that the Holy One, blessed be He, would in the future bring precious stones thirty by thirty cubits, and so on, as it appears in Bava Batra (75a).

Concerning the punishment of the group of flatterers, they said, of blessed memory, in the chapter "Arvei Pesachim" (113b), that there are three whom the Holy One, blessed be He, hates: one who speaks one thing with his mouth and another with his heart - this is the trait of flattery; one who knows testimony for his fellow and does not testify for him; and one who sees nakedness in his fellow and testifies against him alone.

We read in Sanhedrin (52a): Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish said, what is the meaning of what is written (Psalms 35:16), "with flattering mockers of feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me"? Because of the flattery with which his congregation flattered Korach concerning matters of food, the prince of Gehinnom gnashed his teeth at them. In the chapter "Elu Ne'emarin" (Sotah 41b): Rabbi Elazar said, any person who has flattery in him falls into Gehinnom, as it is said (Isaiah 5:20), "woe to those who call evil good," and so on, and it is written right after it (ibid. 5:24), "therefore, as the tongue of fire devours stubble, and the flame consumes the chaff, their root shall be like rot, and their blossom shall go up like dust," and so on. And Rabbi Elazar said, whoever flatters his fellow will eventually fall into his hand, or into the hand of his son, or into the hand of his grandson - from where do we know this? From Chananiah ben Azzur, the false prophet, who was leading Israel astray, and Jeremiah the prophet said (Jeremiah 28:6), "thus may the LORD do; may the LORD confirm your words" - and because he did not protest but said "may the LORD confirm your words," he fell into the hand of his grandson, as it is said (Jeremiah 37:13), "and when he was at the gate of Benjamin, there was an officer of the guard there, whose name was Yiriyah, son of Shelemiah, son of Chananiah," and so on - "and the princes were angry with Jeremiah, and put him in the prison house." And any congregation that has flattery in it is as despicable as a menstruating woman, as it is said (Job 15:34), "for the congregation of the flatterer shall be desolate [galmud]" - and in the coastal cities they call a menstruating woman "galmuda."

And in the Midrash they said: Rabbi Shimon ben Chalafta said, from the day the fist of flattery grew strong, judgments were perverted and deeds became corrupted, and no person could say to his fellow, my deeds are greater than yours. And even Jehoshaphat was fit to be judged, because he flattered Ahab - and where did he flatter him? As it is said (1 Kings 22:8), "and the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, there is still one more man to inquire of the LORD through him, but I hate him," and so on, "and Jehoshaphat said, let not the king say so" - and because he did not attack him but only said to him "let not the king say so," the prophet said to him (2 Chronicles 19:2), "should you help the wicked," and so on.

And in Midrash Mishlei (chapter 26), on the verse (Proverbs 26:8), "like one who binds a stone in a sling, so is one who gives honor to a fool" - Rabbi Alexandri said, whoever gives honor to a fool is like one who throws a stone at Mercury [an idol] - to this point.

And this evil quality is more despicable in a Torah scholar than in the rest of the people, as it is said (Jeremiah 23:11), "for both prophet and priest have become flatterers [chanfu]," and so on. And they said in Tractate Yoma (72b): Rabbah said, any Torah scholar whose inside is not like his outside is not called a scholar, as it is said (Exodus 25:11), "within and without you shall overlay it [with gold]." Abaye said, he is called an abomination, as it is said (Job 15:16), "how much more one who is abominable and corrupt," and so on.

And they said in Chagigah and Sotah (41b) that the enemies of Israel [euphemism for Israel] were obligated in destruction because they flattered King Agrippa, even though he was a king, humble and God-fearing - all the more so one who flatters the wicked. Rabbi Elazar said, any person who has flattery in him brings wrath to the world, as it is said, "and the flatterers of heart bring wrath" - and not only that, but his prayer is despised, as it is said (Job 36:13), "they do not cry out when He binds them" - Rashi, of blessed memory, explains, when sufferings come upon them, crying out shall not help them - and it is written (Job 27:8), "for what is the hope of the flatterer, though he gains," and so on, and it is written, "will God hear his cry when trouble comes upon him?" Further they said there: Rabbi Elazar said, any person who has flattery in him, even the fetuses in their mothers' wombs curse him, as it is said (Proverbs 24:24), "he who says to the wicked, you are righteous, peoples shall curse him [yikvuhu], nations shall abhor him" - and "yikvuhu" refers only to a curse, as it is said (Numbers 23:8), "how shall I curse [ekov] whom God has not cursed [kabo]" - and "le'umim" [nations] refers only to fetuses, as it is said (Genesis 25:23), "and the one people [le'om] shall be stronger than the other people [le'om]."

Further, they said in Midrash Mishlei (12:21): "no harm shall befall the righteous," when he walks in his integrity, "but the wicked are full of evil" - this refers to one who speaks one thing with his mouth and another with his heart, and the Holy One, blessed be He, calls him an abomination, as it is said, "lying lips are an abomination to the LORD." "But those who act faithfully are His delight" - this is one who conducts his business dealings faithfully - to this point.

And because of the sin of flattery, people fall into the hand of their enemies and their spoil is plundered, as it is said (Isaiah 10:5), "woe to Assyria, the rod of My anger," and so on (10:6), "I will send him against a flattering [chanef] nation," and so on. And because of the sin of flattery, the Holy One, blessed be He, pours out His wrath on the land, and His hand is stretched out over the young men and over orphans and widows, as it is said (Isaiah 9:16), "therefore the LORD shall not rejoice over their young men," and so on, "for everyone is a flatterer [chanef] and an evildoer," and so on.

Flattery is severe, for it is equal to idolatry, forbidden relations, and bloodshed. Idolatry - from where? As it is written (Isaiah 32:6), "to practice flattery [chonef], to speak error [to'ah] against the LORD" - and "to'ah" refers only to idolatry, as it is said (Jeremiah 10:15), "they are vanity, a work of delusions [ta'tu'im]." Forbidden relations - from where? As it is said (Jeremiah 3:1), "behold, if a man sends away his wife," and so on, "would not the land be greatly flattered [chanof techenaf]?" Bloodshed - from where? As it is written (Psalms 106:38), "and the land was flattered [tech'naf] with blood."

And because of the sin of flattery, the rains are withheld, as it is said (Jeremiah 3:2), "and you have flattered the land with your harlotries," and so on, and it is written right after, "and the showers were withheld," and so on. And because of the flattery a person practices in this world, he is judged in Gehinnom forever, for all eternity, as it is said (Isaiah 33:14), "the sinners in Zion are afraid, trembling has seized the flatterers [chanefim]; who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire," and so on.

And in Sotah (41b): Rabbi Yehudah bar Ma'aravaya, and some say Rabbi Shimon ben Pazi, said, it is permitted to flatter the wicked in this world, as it is said (Isaiah 32:5), "the fool shall no longer be called noble, nor the miser said to be generous" - implying that in this world it is permitted. Reish Lakish said, from here (Genesis 33:10), "for I have seen your face, as one sees the face of God, and you have received me favorably" - and this disagrees with Rabbi Levi, who said, and so on.
Reshit Chokhmah, Gate of Holiness 12:36-: Rabbi Yitzchak Aboab, author of Sefer Menorat HaMaor, of blessed memory, wrote (letter 45), in these words: none of this speaks of praising evil qualities one practices, for concerning that they have already said that there are several sins involved. But what it says, "it is permitted to flatter," is this: although it is forbidden to honor the wicked, since they are haters of the Name, as it is written (Psalms 15:4), "in whose eyes a vile person is despised" - meaning that it is fitting for one who dwells in the tent of the LORD and abides on His holy mountain to despise the one who is despised in the eyes of the LORD, namely the wicked, and to honor those who fear the LORD, but not the wicked - and concerning this the sage said that the wicked, whose hand is strong and whose time is favorable, it is permitted to honor them out of fear, as one would honor men of force, but not out of love for them. And so they said in Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer (chapter 36), concerning the matter of Jacob who flattered Esau - from here they said, one may flatter the wicked in this world for the sake of peace, and your mnemonic is "Ahavah" [love], the initials of "flattering the wicked in this world" - and the intent is [that it be done] out of love, so that he may live to fulfill the commandments of his Creator. But whoever has the ability to protest and does protest, and takes his vengeance against the wicked in this world, the Holy One, blessed be He, makes a covenant with him and with his seed after him, as He did for Pinchas.

Further, concerning the punishment of the flatterer, they said, of blessed memory (Avot DeRabbi Natan 29:4), whoever flatters his fellow for the sake of honor will eventually be parted from him easily. And similar to this, the pious author of Chovot HaLevavot wrote (Gate of Sincerity of Deed, chapter 5), concerning one of the arguments of the inclination, that the inclination says one should do things that people will know of, so that a reputation for piety go out for him, until they learn from his deeds. And he answered that one should say to it, perhaps when I direct this in my deeds, the will intended by them will not be achieved through them, and it will occur to people that I am a flatterer in my deeds, and my deeds shall be in vain, in my intent for them being other than God. And it is said of a certain king, why did the reading of so-and-so not please you, though his voice was pleasant and skilled in the cantillation? He said to them, how should his reading please me? He does not read it except so that his reading please me and he find favor in my eyes because of it - but had this intent been for the will of the Creator alone, it would have pleased me. And so it may be said of anyone among those who pray in public, and the masters of the vision [prayer leaders] with new liturgical poems, who intends by his prayer to find favor in the eyes of people rather than the blessed God - it is not accepted by the Creator - to this point. It follows that included in the group of flatterers is one who performs a commandment for the blessed God with his intent being that people honor him for it.

And he wrote in Chovot HaLevavot (Gate of Sincerity of Deed, chapter 4), that one who performs a deed for the honor of people or out of fear of them does not serve the Creator but people, and is found not to recognize the Creator - and so is the matter of the idol-worshipper, that he worships the idols only because of his foolishness, not having recognized the Creator - and he wrote, in these words: and the idol-worshipper has an advantage over the flatterer in four things. The first, that the idol-worshipper nowadays is not warned by a prophet who would clarify to him the corruption of his thought with signs and wonders, but the flatterer within Torah has claims against him, in what he received of the commandments in the service of God and the warning against serving another. The second, that the idol-worshipper worships one who does not rebel against God, but the flatterer worships one who rebels against God, and also one who does not rebel against Him. The third, that the idol-worshipper worships one thing, while the flatterer has no limit to those he worships. The fourth, that the idol-worshipper's matter is not hidden from people, and they guard themselves from him because of the publicity of his denial of God, but the flatterer's denial is not apparent, and people trust him, and it is possible for him to harm them in a way not possible for another - and he is the greatest of the world's diseases, and is called in our language a flatterer, arrogant, and enticer - to this point.

And our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said in the Midrash (Yalkut Mishlei, siman 961): Rabbi Chiya taught, they publicize the flatterers because of the desecration of the Name, as it is said (Proverbs 26:26), "his wickedness shall be revealed before the assembly," and it says (Ezekiel 3:20), "and when a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, I will put a stumbling block before him" - and why did the Holy One, blessed be He, give them evil? In order to publicize their deeds to the creatures, so that nothing happen to him because of transgressions and they cry out against the attribute of judgment - go and learn from Doeg, who was head of the Sanhedrin, as it is said (1 Samuel 21:8), "the chief of Saul's shepherds" - and because he had the trait of slander, Scripture publicized it - to this point.

And in Sefer Menorat HaMaor of Rabbi Yisrael, peace be upon him, he wrote, in these words: the flatterer is more despicable than the thief - for the thief steals money, but the flatterer steals people's minds. And the flatterers divide into three groups. The first group are those who flatter people so as to find favor in their eyes, and do not rebuke them for their evil deeds, but say, you are acting rightly - even though they are doing evil and improper deeds.

The second group is more despicable than the first - these are those who flatter the powerful and the wealthy, and subjugate their souls to them. To the powerful, so that they be made head over the community, and so that they inherit authority, and they strive to be honored through flattering them. To the wealthy, so that they plunder their money, and in order to benefit from it - and they remove their trust from the Holy One, blessed be He, and place their hope and expectation in people, supposing that their wealth will never end and never be lost from their hand - and in this they err, and concerning them it is said (Jeremiah 17:5), "cursed is the man who trusts in man."

The third group is more despicable still - these are those who flatter in religion, showing themselves to be righteous and diligent in synagogues, but their intent is to rise to greatness so that they be appointed leaders over the community, and to remove themselves from taxation, showing piety on their faces while their hearts are full of deceit and trickery - to this point. Some of his words and some of the essence of his wording I have not written, because of length.

Further, Rabbeinu Yonah elaborated in Sha'arei Teshuvah (Gate 3, letter 187) concerning the matter of the flatterers, and wrote nine divisions of them, and whoever wishes to see may find his book available. And the sum of his words is that one should not flatter the wicked or speak in his praise, whether to his face or not to his face, as it is said (Proverbs 28:4), "those who forsake the Torah praise the wicked." And along these lines it is possible to speak of one who appoints someone leader or scholar over the community when that person is unfit, and the Holy One, blessed be He, exacts punishment from the one who appointed him, for that scholar is found to destroy the world with his rulings, wrongly, and the like. And included in flattery is: if one does not wish to rebuke the people of his city, thinking they will not accept it from him, he is called a flatterer - so he wrote.

I found written in a book that speaks of matters of piety, in these words: there are three whom one may flatter - his wife, for the sake of peace in the home; a creditor, so that he not oppress him; his teacher, so that he teach him Torah and commandments. And it is a great commandment to flatter one's students and colleagues so that they learn, and so that they heed his words to accept rebuke and fulfill commandments - and likewise for anyone he thinks he can draw to himself so that they heed him to fulfill the commandments - and if he comes to him angrily, they will not heed him, but through flattery they will accept his rebuke - and behold, it is a great commandment to flatter him, to bring out the precious from the vile.

And there is a person who accepts rebuke and reproof only calmly, as it is said (Ecclesiastes 9:17), "the words of the wise, spoken calmly, are heard." And there is one who needs a rebuke, as it is said (Proverbs 17:10), "a rebuke enters more deeply into a man of understanding [than a hundred blows into a fool]." And there is one for whom even striking will not help, as it is said, "than striking a fool a hundred times." If so, what shall be done? There is no remedy for him, but to expel him.

And there is a very evil kind of flattery, such as a person who speaks with his fellow and flatters him with sweet words, in order to draw him near and have him tell what is in his heart, and after he has trusted him and relies on him, he deals with him deceitfully - and this is as it is said (Proverbs 1:17), "for in vain is the net spread in the eyes of any bird" - (ibid. 1:18) "and they lie in wait for their own blood, they lurk secretly for their own souls" - for hunters scatter wheat in a net so that the birds come to eat, and then they are trapped - and this flatterer resembles this.

And the Sages forbade flattery, and said (Chullin 94a) that a person should not send a gift knowing that the recipient will not accept it, or press his fellow to eat with him knowing that he will not eat; and likewise, if a person wishes to open a barrel of wine to sell, and his fellow comes to buy wine, he should not say to him, I wish to open a barrel for your sake. And all this and the like is called "stealing minds," to flatter and steal people's minds.
Reshit Chokhmah, Gate of Holiness 12:48-: Rabbi Shimon ben Chalafta said, from the day the fist of flattery grew strong, judgments were perverted and deeds became corrupted, and no person could say to his fellow, my deeds are greater than yours. Rabbi Elazar said, any person who has flattery brings wrath to the world, as it is said (Job 36:13), "and the flatterers of heart bring wrath" - and his prayer is not heard - even the fetuses in their mothers' wombs curse him in Gehinnom. And whoever flatters the wicked will eventually fall into his hand, and if he does not fall into his hand, he falls into the hand of his son or the hand of his grandson. And any woman who has flattery in her is as despicable as a menstruating woman, and in the end she is exiled (Sotah 42a).

Therefore a person shall distance himself from flattery, and shall not flatter a person to strengthen him in his wickedness - even if he stands to receive benefits from him, he should not flatter him - and he should not flatter his relatives or his children when they do not walk in a good path, for how many people remain in their wickedness because they see that they feel no shame for their ugly ways, and because they see that people flatter them. And there is nothing in the world that closes the gates of repentance like flattery.

And there was a story of a certain worthy man who had a daughter to marry off, and there were in his city two young men, each of whom desired to take his daughter - and that worthy man went to judge between them, in order to test them, and he arranged for a certain man to pick a quarrel with him, so that afterward they would be brought to judge between the litigant and himself, in order to test them, and so they did. And of these two, one flattered that worthy man in order to marry his daughter, and would justify him in all his ways - and then he went and gave his daughter to the one who had found him liable, [saying] "for he is a good man," so said the worthy man, "because he did not flatter me and did not show me favoritism" (Sefer Chasidim, siman 942).

Therefore a leader, judge, or charity collector must not be a flatterer - for if he flatters someone and does not rebuke him to do good and turn from evil, then the whole community will be corrupted by him, each saying, the leader flatters so-and-so, so why should he rebuke me, since he flatters so-and-so? - and they will not accept his rebukes. And likewise a judge who flatters one of the litigants, then the words of the other will be stifled and he will not know how to argue properly, and the judgment will not come out true. And likewise charity collectors who flatter will give charity to one who flatters them, or whom they flatter, and give to him even though he is unworthy of it. Therefore the righteous person must distance himself greatly from flattery, neither flattering others nor accepting flattery from others. And he should be very careful, when he does good deeds, not to intend by them to flatter others, but to do them for the sake of the Holy One, blessed be He.

And the worst of all flattery is one who flatters his fellow so as to cause him to sin - such as one who has a dispute with people and the law is not with him, and he flatters people to assist him and support his error; or one who pursues transgressions, such as licentiousness and other transgressions, and flatters his fellow so that he does likewise. Jeroboam son of Nebat merited kingship because he did not flatter King Solomon but rebuked him concerning the matter of the Millo (Sanhedrin 101b).

Whoever wishes to be saved from flattery should be careful to distance himself from honor, for whoever does not care about being honored will not need flattery. And he must also be careful of others, for most flatterers flatter a person from whom they suppose they will derive benefit. Therefore whoever distances himself from these two things - benefit and honor - is saved from several transgressions, for many people do good deeds in order to receive honor from people, and this matter corrupts all of a person's service - for how many people pray with a pleasant voice, and think in their heart during prayer, how pleasant is my voice and how many people enjoy hearing me - and this is the way of the evil inclination, and it does this in order to catch a person in its net so that his deeds not be for the sake of Heaven. And likewise concerning benefit - one who benefits from his fellow, even if he sees him transgressing all the transgressions in the world, will not dare rebuke him, fearing that he will no longer benefit from him. And this matter is the stumbling block of the sages of the generation, for they pursue benefit from the people, and therefore flatter them so that they hold them in great esteem - and it is not enough that they do not rebuke them concerning their affairs, but by flattering them they themselves come to hold their deeds and follow after them - to this point. Rabbeinu Moshe [Maimonides] wrote this in Hilchot De'ot.

In explaining the group of liars, that is, the group of falsehood - the liar and the deceiver are hated and abhorred before the Holy One, blessed be He, as it is said (Proverbs 6:16), "these six the LORD hates," and so on: "haughty eyes, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood, a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are swift [to run to evil], a false witness who breathes out lies, and one who sows discord among brothers" - and of these seven things, three of them concern falsehood: "a lying tongue," "breathes out lies," "a false witness."

And our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said that these seven evil qualities all hang upon falsehood, from which they all cascade. How so? "Haughty eyes" - the essence of pride is falsehood, for he says he is wise when he is a fool, mighty when he is weak, a prince when he is lowly, and boasts before people with these false qualities - as Absalom said (2 Samuel 15:4), "and let everyone who has a suit or cause come to me, and I would give him justice," and he was stealing people's minds through falsehood.

"A lying tongue" - falsehood itself. "And hands that shed innocent blood" - from Joab, who sent a false message in David's name and brought back Abner and killed him, as it is said (2 Samuel 3:26), "and he sent messengers after Abner," and so on. "A false witness who breathes out lies" - behold the bodies of falsehood. "And one who sows discord among brothers" - as it is said (Psalms 55:10), "swallow up, O LORD, and divide their tongue," and so on, and right after it, "wickedness and mischief are in the midst of it; deceit and guile do not depart from its streets."

Come and see how they lied and were punished. Gehazi lied, and he and his seed were struck with leprosy, as it is said (2 Kings 5:25), "and Elisha said to him, where have you been, Gehazi? And he said, your servant did not go anywhere," and he said to him, "did my heart not go [with you]," and so on (5:27), "the leprosy of Naaman shall cling to you and to your seed forever - and he went out from before him leprous like snow." Amnon lied, and was killed, as it is said (2 Samuel 13:5), "let Tamar my sister come and make cakes before my eyes," and so on, "and he lay with her," and Absalom killed him.

And whoever falsifies in his speech is as though he worships idols, as it is said (Genesis 27:12), "perhaps my father will feel me, and I shall seem to him as a deceiver [metate'a]," and it is written concerning idolatry (Jeremiah 51:18), "they are vanity, a work of delusions [ta'tu'im]" (Sanhedrin 92a). And Rabbi Yitzchak Aboab explained in Sefer Menorat HaMaor (letter 37), concerning this matter, why he should be like an idol-worshipper - the intent being that because he misleads his fellow with falsehood, along these lines whoever misleads his fellow in any manner is likewise, since he resembles idols, which also mislead people by saying that they have power.

Rabbi Elazar said, the Holy One, blessed be He, created everything except falsehood, which He did not create, but people invent it from their own hearts (Tanna DeVei Eliyahu Zuta, chapter 3). And we read in the Midrash: the spirit of Naboth the Jezreelite did not merit a supernal dwelling, but only because Ahab killed him, innocent blood; and it was excluded because it contemplated speaking falsehoods, as it is said (1 Kings 22:20), "who shall entice Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth [Gilead]," and so on, "and the spirit came forward and said, I will entice him," and so on, "and He said, go out" - what is "the spirit"? This is the spirit of Naboth. What is "go out"? Go out from My partition - because of the "speaker of falsehoods, who shall not be established before My eyes" (Psalms 101:7).

And the sage said, a person who lies is accounted as dead, for people do not heed his word since it is his way to lie - his life and his death are equal. And they said, of blessed memory (Sanhedrin 89b), this is the punishment of a liar - that even when he speaks the truth, they do not listen to him. And when Jeremiah rebuked Israel, he rebuked them only concerning falsehood, as it is said (Jeremiah 9:4), "they have taught their tongue to speak falsehood" - falsehood became like a nature for them, and they could not depart from it, and they wearied themselves trying to bend from the way of falsehood to the way of truth.
Reshit Chokhmah, Gate of Holiness 12:61-: Rav Huna said, we find that Israel were exiled from their land only because they transgressed this verse (Exodus 23:7), "keep far from a false matter" - and in the Book of Lamentations this is alluded to in three places. In the alphabetic acrostic of "Eichah ya'iv be-apo," the Peh precedes the Ayin - meaning, they spoke with their mouths what they had not seen with their eyes, as it is written (Lamentations 2:16), "they have opened their mouth wide against you," and afterward (2:17), "the LORD has done what He devised." And in the alphabetic acrostic of "Ani ha-gever," "they have opened their mouth wide against us" (3:46), and afterward "my eye pours down" (3:49). And in the alphabetic acrostic of "Eichah yu'am zahav," "the presence of the LORD has divided them" (4:16), and afterward (4:17), "still our eyes fail."

And we read in "HaBa al Yevimto" (Yevamot 63a): Rav Huna's wife would vex him - when he told her, prepare me lentils, she prepared him chickpeas; [when he said,] chickpeas, she prepared him lentils. When his son Chiya grew up, he would reverse [the instruction to her]. He [Rav Huna] said to him, your mother has improved! He said to him, I am the one who reverses it [before giving it to her]. He said to him, this is what people say, "what comes from you teaches you" - but you should not do this, for it is said, "they have taught their tongue to speak falsehood." Therefore let a person train his tongue to speak truth.

And Rabbeinu Yonah wrote in Sha'arei Teshuvah (Gate 3, letter 181), that this is what King Solomon, peace be upon him, said (Proverbs 6:19), "a false witness who breathes out lies" - meaning, one accustomed to speaking falsehood even in ordinary matters, all the more so will he lie and speak falsely to testify against his fellow, because of his nature and the habit of his tongue.
